```{r setup}
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Cache check: files exist, no CLIF input newer than the cache, parameters and code version unchanged
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
cache_ok <- function(cache_file, meta_file, params, label) {
  if (!file.exists(cache_file) || !file.exists(meta_file)) return(FALSE)
  meta <- readRDS(meta_file)
  inputs <- list.files(data_dir, full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)   # recursive: catches tables in subfolders
  newer  <- inputs[file.mtime(inputs) > meta$saved_at]
  if (length(newer)) { message(label, " cache is older than: ", paste(basename(newer), collapse = ", "), " -> rebuilding"); return(FALSE) }
  if (!identical(meta$params, params)) {
    changed <- names(params)[!mapply(identical, params, meta$params[names(params)])]
    message(label, " parameters/code changed (", paste(changed, collapse = ", "), ") -> rebuilding"); return(FALSE)
  }
  TRUE
}

restore_tz <- function(dt) {   # parquet returns times in UTC; put them back in the site's time zone
  for (cc in names(dt)[sapply(dt, inherits, "POSIXct")]) set(dt, j = cc, value = lubridate::with_tz(dt[[cc]], time_zone))
  dt
}
save_cache <- function(dt, cache_file, meta_file, params, extras = list()) {
  arrow::write_parquet(dt, cache_file)
  saveRDS(list(saved_at = Sys.time(), params = params, n_rows = nrow(dt), extras = extras), meta_file)
  message("Cache saved: ", basename(cache_file), " (", format(nrow(dt), big.mark = ","), " rows)")
}

if (use_cohort_cache && !use_laps_cache) {

}
if (use_laps_cache) {

  list2env(readRDS(cohort_meta)$extras, envir = environment())
  list2env(readRDS(laps_meta)$extras, envir = environment())
}
```

#PART ZERO: Fix Hospitalization
```{r}
# This block adjusts for hospitalizations that are continuous within a health system.
# It looks at patient_id, discharge_dttm, and admission_dttm for hospitalization_ids
# that are close in time, creates new chronological hospitalization_ids, and builds
# a crosswalk (hosp_map) used by read_data() to remap all downstream tables

#Function to Normalize DTTM columns to site time_zone
normalize_dttm <- function(dt, tz = time_zone, verbose = TRUE, end_of_day_cols = "death_dttm") {
  for (var in grep("dttm$", names(dt), value = TRUE)) { #Identify all _dttm columns and then loop through
    col <- dt[[var]] #Pull out the current column to be checked
    eod <- var %in% end_of_day_cols #Check if column is an EOD column -> 23:59 instead of 00:00
    if (inherits(col, "POSIXct")) { #Is the column already a date-time?
      old <- attr(col, "tzone") #The current time zone in the dttm column
      if (is.null(old) || !nzchar(old)) { #If it's blank then use force_tz to stamp the time_zone
        new <- lubridate::force_tz(col, tzone = tz); how <- paste0("blank tzone: stamped with ", tz, " (no clock shift) ✅ ")
      } else if (old == tz) { #If timezone is consistent with yaml then move on
        next
      } else if (old %in% c("UTC", "GMT", "Etc/UTC")) { #If timezone is in UTC then shift to time_zone using with_tz
        new <- lubridate::with_tz(col, tzone = tz);  how <- paste0(old, ": converted to ", tz, " (clock shifted) ✅ ")
      } else { #If more than one timezone is present than warm and leave as is
        warning(var, ": tzone is '", old, "', differs from '", tz, "'. Leaving as-is. ⚠️⚠️⚠️"); next
      }
    } else if (inherits(col, "Date")) { #If dttm column is only date and missing time then stamp as midnight local time if non-EOD and 23:59 if EOD
      new <- lubridate::force_tz(as.POSIXct(col), tzone = tz)
      if (eod) new <- new + lubridate::hours(23) + lubridate::minutes(59)
      how <- paste0("📅 Date -> local ", if (eod) "23:59" else "midnight", " in ", tz)
    } else {
      txt <- if (is.factor(col)) as.character(col) else col #If column is factor convert to text for parsing 
      new <- suppressWarnings(lubridate::ymd_hms(txt, tz = tz, quiet = TRUE)) #Parse directly as local time
      bad <- is.na(new) & !is.na(txt) & nzchar(trimws(txt)) #Find values that failed but weren't blank
      if (any(bad)) { #Retry bad values as date only with midnight time stamp, if unable to parse then use NA
        d <- suppressWarnings(lubridate::ymd(txt[bad], tz = tz, quiet = TRUE))
        if (eod) d <- d + lubridate::hours(23) + lubridate::minutes(59) #Use same date logic as above
        new[bad] <- d
      }
      n_fail <- sum(is.na(new) & !is.na(txt) & nzchar(trimws(txt))) #Number of values that couldn't be parsed
      how <- how <- paste0("parsed from text as ", tz, " time",
              if (n_fail) paste0(" (", n_fail, " unparseable -> NA ⚠️⚠️⚠️)") else "")
    }
    set(dt, j = var, value = new)
    if (verbose) message("  ", var, ": ", how)
  }
  invisible(dt)
}



read_data_start <- function(file_path, select = NULL, tz = time_zone, verbose = TRUE) { #Use path to CLIF table and check every column (NULL); verbose for printed output
  #Determine the file type
  ext <- sub(".*\\.(csv\\.gz|csv|parquet|fst)$", "\\1", tolower(file_path)) #sub() finds the pattern
  #Upload tables using fread, arrow, or fst_read
  dt <- switch(ext, #Use switch instead of if/else since we determined extension above
    "csv" = , "csv.gz" = fread(file_path, select = select, tz = ""),   #tz = "": keep unmarked datetimes as text
    "parquet" = if (is.null(select)) arrow::read_parquet(file_path) #If null is TRUE then read all of the columns using arrow
                else arrow::read_parquet(file_path, col_select = dplyr::all_of(select)), #If null is FALSE then only read the selected columns
    "fst" = fst::read_fst(file_path, columns = select),
    stop("Unsupported file format. Only CSV, Parquet, and FST are supported."))
  setDT(dt) #Convert dt to data.table regardless of file type - faster than as.data.table
  normalize_dttm(dt, tz = tz, verbose = verbose) #Use normalize_dttm function above
  if (verbose) dplyr::glimpse(dt) #Show us the summary
  dt[] #Return the table
}

# Load and clean hospitalization table
link_hours <- 6   # admissions starting < 6 h after the encounter's latest discharge are joined, easier for possible future sensitivity analyses questioning this design choice

#Baseline hospitalization table before linkage
clif_hospitalization_start <- read_data_start(
  paste0(data_dir, "clif_hospitalization", file_type),
  select = c("hospitalization_id", "patient_id", "admission_dttm", "discharge_dttm",
             "age_at_admission", "discharge_category"))

#Lowercase only the text categories (IDs must keep their original form to match other tables)
clif_hospitalization_start[, discharge_category := tolower(discharge_category)]

#Safety check: make sure no duplicate hospitalization_id values and every row has an admission_dttm
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(clif_hospitalization_start$hospitalization_id),
          !anyNA(clif_hospitalization_start$admission_dttm))
#How many hospitalizations are missing a discharge time?
message(sum(is.na(clif_hospitalization_start$discharge_dttm)), " hospitalizations with no discharge time")

#Build Encounter Blocks
setorder(clif_hospitalization_start, patient_id, admission_dttm)

#Work from the inside out to determine the latest discharge_dttm seen in patient's history (block_end)
#For missing discharge_dttm we are using admission_dttm as the discharge_dttm
clif_hospitalization_start[, block_end := cummax(as.numeric(fcoalesce(discharge_dttm, admission_dttm))),
                           by = patient_id] #Using as.numeric to convert to seconds then cummax to get largest value

#Determine when a new block begins
  #If patient's first hospitalization (i.e. they have no previous block_end) the shift is NA
  #If admission begins at least 6 hours (in seconds) after the latest prior discharge then start new block
clif_hospitalization_start[, new_block := is.na(shift(block_end)) |
                             as.numeric(admission_dttm) - shift(block_end) >= link_hours * 3600,
                           by = patient_id]

#For each patient_id count and group the blocks using cumsum
#.GRP gives each group a unique number across the whole table
clif_hospitalization_start[, encounter_block := .GRP, by = .(patient_id, cumsum(new_block))]
clif_hospitalization_start[, c("block_end", "new_block") := NULL] #Drop the helper columns

#Collapse to one row per encounter
clif_hospitalization <- clif_hospitalization_start[, {
  open <- anyNA(discharge_dttm) #Identify open encounters where patient is still admitted to some hospital
  last <- if (open) .N else which.max(discharge_dttm) #If it's an open encounter take that data if not then take max discharge_dttm
  .(hospitalization_id = hospitalization_id[1], #Rows are ordered by admission_dttm [1] = earliest - becomes encounter ID
    age_at_admission   = age_at_admission[1],
    admission_dttm     = admission_dttm[1],
    discharge_dttm     = if (open) discharge_dttm[NA_integer_] else discharge_dttm[last], #Keep missing discharge_dttm as NA
    discharge_category = discharge_category[last]) 
}, by = .(patient_id, encounter_block)] #Join by patient_id and encounter_block
clif_hospitalization[, clif_hospitalizations_joined_id := .I] #Give each encounter a new sequential ID

#Crosswalk from original hospitalization_id to encounter_block
hosp_map <- clif_hospitalization_start[, .(patient_id, encounter_block, old_hosp_id = hospitalization_id)][
  clif_hospitalization[, .(encounter_block,
                           new_hosp_id              = clif_hospitalizations_joined_id,
                           final_admit              = admission_dttm,
                           final_discharge          = discharge_dttm,
                           final_discharge_category = discharge_category)],
  on = "encounter_block"]

#Check to make sure the crosswalk has exactly one row per original hospitalization and every hospitalization_id maps to an encounter block
stopifnot(nrow(hosp_map) == nrow(clif_hospitalization_start), !anyNA(hosp_map$new_hosp_id))
message(nrow(clif_hospitalization_start), " hospitalizations -> ", nrow(clif_hospitalization), " encounters")

#Convert IDs to text and slim down to only the columns needed for remapping
hosp_map <- hosp_map[, .(old_hosp_id              = as.character(old_hosp_id),
                         new_hosp_id              = as.character(new_hosp_id),
                         final_admit, final_discharge, final_discharge_category,
                         first_in_block           = old_hosp_id %in% clif_hospitalization$hospitalization_id)]
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(hosp_map$old_hosp_id)) #Each OG ID must appear once
```


# PART ONE: Upload clif tables
```{r}
read_data <- function(file_path, select = NULL, tz = time_zone, verbose = TRUE,
                      hosp_map = if (exists("hosp_map", envir = .GlobalEnv)) get("hosp_map", envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
  #1) Read - use the same code/logic as in read_data_start above
  ext <- sub(".*\\.(csv\\.gz|csv|parquet|fst)$", "\\1", tolower(file_path))
  dt <- switch(ext,
    "csv" = , "csv.gz" = data.table::fread(file_path, select = select, tz = ""),
    "parquet" = if (is.null(select)) arrow::read_parquet(file_path)
                else arrow::read_parquet(file_path, col_select = tidyselect::all_of(select)),
    "fst" = fst::read_fst(file_path, columns = select),
    stop("Unsupported file format. Only CSV, Parquet, and FST are supported."))
  setDT(dt)
  if (verbose) message("Read ", basename(file_path), ": ", format(nrow(dt), big.mark = ","), " rows") #Read in how many rows are in table

  #2) Normalize time zones first, so remapped and original times are on the same footing
  normalize_dttm(dt, tz = tz, verbose = verbose)

  #3) Remap hospitalization_id to the joined encounter ID
  if (!is.null(hosp_map) && "hospitalization_id" %in% names(dt)) { #Only remap if hosp_map exists and table has hospitalization_id column
    idx <- match(as.character(dt$hospitalization_id), hosp_map$old_hosp_id)   #Map hospitalization_id in the dt to the old_hosp_id by row - creates a vector of row numbers to refer to, gives NA for missing values
    n_orphan <- sum(is.na(idx)) #Count the number of hosp_ids not in the map and report it
    if (n_orphan) {
      if (verbose) message("  dropping ", format(n_orphan, big.mark = ","), " rows whose hospitalization_id is not in hosp_map")
      keep <- !is.na(idx); dt <- dt[keep]; idx <- idx[keep] #Keep the rows that have an idx value
    }
    set(dt, j = "hospitalization_id", value = hosp_map$new_hosp_id[idx]) #Now replace OG hospitalization_id with new encounter ID

    if (all(c("admission_dttm", "discharge_dttm") %in% names(dt))) {    #Only used on hospitalization table itself
      set(dt, j = "admission_dttm", value = hosp_map$final_admit[idx]) #Map the encounter admission_dttm
      set(dt, j = "discharge_dttm", value = hosp_map$final_discharge[idx]) #Map discharge_dttm, keep NA discharge_dttm as is
      if ("discharge_category" %in% names(dt))
        set(dt, j = "discharge_category", value = hosp_map$final_discharge_category[idx])
      set(dt, j = "first_in_block", value = hosp_map$first_in_block[idx]) #TRUE/FALSE if row is earliest encounter - helps make sure that age, admission_category, etc are from first hosp_id
      if (verbose) message("  remapped hospitalization_id, admission, discharge")
    } else if (verbose) message("  remapped hospitalization_id")
  }

  #4) Peek and return
  if (verbose && nrow(dt) > 0) utils::str(head(dt)) #Verbose summary of first rows
  dt[] #Return the final table
}

  .N, by = language_category][, percent := 100 * N / sum(N)][
  , `:=`(
    N_display = fifelse(N < 10, "less than 10", as.character(N)),
    percent_display = fifelse(N < 10, "less than 10", sprintf("%.1f", percent))
  )][order(-N)]
fwrite(language_counts_hospital_system[, .(language_category, N = N_display, percent = percent_display)],  file.path(cohort_characteristics, paste0(institution, "_hospital_system_language_counts.csv")))

# QC Check: All language_name x language_category combinations
language_name_category_combos <- unique(patient_demographics[, 
  .(language_name, language_category)])[order(language_category, language_name)][,
  institution := institution]

fwrite(language_name_category_combos, 
  file.path(audit_dir, paste0(institution, "_language_name_category_qc.csv")))

################################################################################
# HOSPITAL-LEVEL LANGUAGE COUNTS (R1.2) - all adult admissions, not just the cohort
# Output: cohort_characteristics/<site>_hospital_language_counts.csv - read by 01_analysis_rr section 9d-2.
################################################################################
hl_adm <- as.data.table(hospitalization)[, .(hospitalization_id, patient_id, admission_dttm, age_at_admission)]
hl_adm <- hl_adm[age_at_admission >= 18]
if (exists("cutoff_time")) hl_adm <- hl_adm[admission_dttm <= cutoff_time]     # same study-period end as the cohort

# Hospital = hospital of the FIRST ADT row of the admission (the admitting hospital)
hl_first <- as.data.table(adt)[!is.na(in_dttm) & !is.na(hospital_id), .(hospitalization_id, in_dttm, hospital_id)]
setorder(hl_first, hospitalization_id, in_dttm)
hl_first <- hl_first[, .SD[1], by = hospitalization_id][, .(hospitalization_id, hospital_id)]
hl_adm <- merge(hl_adm, hl_first, by = "hospitalization_id")                  # admissions with no ADT hospital drop

hl_adm <- merge(hl_adm, as.data.table(patient_demographics)[, .(patient_id, language_category)], by = "patient_id", all.x = TRUE)
hl_adm[, lang := tolower(trimws(as.character(language_category)))]
hl_adm[, lang_group := "other"]
hl_adm[lang %in% "english", lang_group := "english"]
hl_adm[lang %in% "spanish", lang_group := "spanish"]
hl_adm[is.na(lang) | lang %in% c("", "unknown or na", "unknown_or_na", "unknown"), lang_group := "missing"]

hospital_language_counts <- hl_adm[, .(
  n_admissions = .N,
  n_english    = sum(lang_group == "english"),
  n_spanish    = sum(lang_group == "spanish"),
  n_other      = sum(lang_group == "other"),
  n_missing    = sum(lang_group == "missing")), by = hospital_id]
hospital_language_counts[, `:=`(
  pct_spanish            = round(100 * n_spanish / n_admissions, 2),                    # of all adult admissions
  pct_spanish_known_lang = round(100 * n_spanish / (n_admissions - n_missing), 2))]     # of admissions with a recorded language
# Small-cell rule (this file is in an upload folder): hide counts 1-9 and the percentages built on them
for (cc in c("n_english", "n_spanish", "n_other", "n_missing")) {
  small <- which(hospital_language_counts[[cc]] > 0 & hospital_language_counts[[cc]] < 10)
  if (cc == "n_spanish" && length(small)) set(hospital_language_counts, small, c("pct_spanish", "pct_spanish_known_lang"), list(NA_real_, NA_real_))
  set(hospital_language_counts, j = cc, value = as.character(hospital_language_counts[[cc]]))
  set(hospital_language_counts, small, cc, "<10")
}
hospital_language_counts[n_admissions < 10, n_admissions := NA_integer_]
hospital_language_counts[, site := institution]
setcolorder(hospital_language_counts, c("site", "hospital_id"))
print(hospital_language_counts[order(-n_admissions)])
fwrite(hospital_language_counts, file.path(cohort_characteristics, paste0(institution, "_hospital_language_counts.csv")))
rm(hl_adm, hl_first)

# HOSPITALIZATIONS BY LANGUAGE AND YEAR (descriptive)
# Output (cohort_characteristics/):
#   <site>_hospitalizations_by_language_year.csv      - all hospitalizations
#   <site>_hospitalizations_by_language_year_icu.csv  - hospitalizations with at least one ICU ADT row
#   <site>_hospitalizations_by_language_era.csv       - same, by era (pre-pandemic / pandemic / endemic)
#   <site>_hospitalizations_by_language_era_icu.csv
################################################################################
ly_adults_only <- TRUE    # TRUE = age_at_admission >= 18 (the study population); FALSE = all ages
ly_missing_vals <- if (exists("missing_language_vals")) missing_language_vals else
  c("", "unknown or na", "unknown_or_na", "unknown", "sign language", "sign_language")
 
ly <- as.data.table(hospitalization)[, .(hospitalization_id, patient_id, admission_dttm, discharge_dttm, age_at_admission)]
if (ly_adults_only) ly <- ly[age_at_admission >= 18]
# Study window: hospitalizations discharged before 1 Jan 2026 00:00:00 in the site's time zone
# (still-admitted hospitalizations with no discharge_dttm are excluded)
ly_discharge_end <- as.POSIXct("2026-01-01 00:00:00", tz = time_zone)
ly <- ly[!is.na(discharge_dttm) & discharge_dttm < ly_discharge_end]

# Eras: the same cut points as 01_analysis_rr.Rmd (pandemic = [1 Mar 2020, 1 Jan 2022), in the site's time zone)
ly_era_breaks <- if (exists("era_breaks")) era_breaks else
  as.POSIXct(c("2020-03-01 00:00:00", "2022-01-01 00:00:00"), tz = time_zone)
ly[, era := "endemic"]
ly[admission_dttm < ly_era_breaks[2], era := "pandemic"]
ly[admission_dttm < ly_era_breaks[1], era := "pre_pandemic"]

            by = "patient_id", all.x = TRUE)
ly[, lang := tolower(trimws(as.character(language_category)))]
ly[, lang_group := "onelp"]                                                   # recorded, not English or Spanish
ly[lang %in% "english", lang_group := "elp"]
ly[lang %in% "spanish", lang_group := "slp"]
ly[is.na(lang) | lang %in% ly_missing_vals, lang_group := "missing"]
 
# ICU: any ADT row in an ICU during the hospitalization
icu_ids <- unique(as.data.table(adt)[tolower(trimws(location_category)) == "icu", hospitalization_id])
ly[, any_icu := hospitalization_id %in% icu_ids]
 
count_by <- function(d, by_col) {
  out <- d[, .(n_ELP = sum(lang_group == "elp"), n_SLP = sum(lang_group == "slp"), n_ONELP = sum(lang_group == "onelp"),
               n_missing_language = sum(lang_group == "missing"), n_total = .N), by = by_col]
  if (by_col == "era") out <- out[order(match(era, c("pre_pandemic", "pandemic", "endemic")))] else setorderv(out, by_col)
  # Small-cell rule (upload folder): hide counts 1-9; in a row with a hidden count also hide n_total, otherwise a
  # single hidden count could be recovered as total minus the others
  grp_cols <- c("n_ELP", "n_SLP", "n_ONELP", "n_missing_language")
  hide_row <- out[, Reduce(`|`, lapply(.SD, function(v) v > 0 & v < 10)), .SDcols = grp_cols]
  for (cc in c(grp_cols, "n_total")) {
    v <- out[[cc]]; set(out, j = cc, value = ifelse(v > 0 & v < 10, "<10", as.character(v)))
  }
  out[hide_row, n_total := "suppressed"]
  out[, site := institution]
  setcolorder(out, c("site", by_col))
  out
}
lang_year_all <- count_by(ly, "year")
lang_year_icu <- count_by(ly[any_icu == TRUE], "year")
lang_era_all  <- count_by(ly, "era")
lang_era_icu  <- count_by(ly[any_icu == TRUE], "era")
cat("All hospitalizations:\n"); print(lang_year_all)

fwrite(lang_year_icu, file.path(cohort_characteristics, paste0(institution, "_hospitalizations_by_language_year_icu.csv")))
cat("All hospitalizations, by era:\n"); print(lang_era_all)
cat("Hospitalizations with an ICU stay, by era:\n"); print(lang_era_icu)
fwrite(lang_era_all, file.path(cohort_characteristics, paste0(institution, "_hospitalizations_by_language_era.csv")))
fwrite(lang_era_icu, file.path(cohort_characteristics, paste0(institution, "_hospitalizations_by_language_era_icu.csv")))
#rm(ly, icu_ids)

ly[, any_imv := hospitalization_id %in% imv_ids]

icu_imv_row <- function(d, period_type, period) data.table(
  period_type = period_type, period = period,
  n_hospitalizations     = nrow(d),
  n_icu_hospitalizations = d[any_icu == TRUE, .N],
  n_icu_with_imv         = d[any_icu == TRUE & any_imv == TRUE, .N],
  n_imv_any_location     = d[any_imv == TRUE, .N])          # all hospitalizations with IMV, ICU or not

icu_imv_counts <- rbindlist(c(
  list(icu_imv_row(ly, "all", "all")),
  lapply(sort(unique(ly$year)), function(y) icu_imv_row(ly[year == y], "year", as.character(y))),
  lapply(c("pre_pandemic", "pandemic", "endemic"), function(e) icu_imv_row(ly[era == e], "era", e))))
icu_imv_counts[, `:=`(pct_icu_of_hospitalizations = round(100 * n_icu_hospitalizations / n_hospitalizations, 2),
                      pct_icu_with_imv            = round(100 * n_icu_with_imv / n_icu_hospitalizations, 2))]

# Small-cell rule (upload folder): hide counts 1-9 and the percentages built on them
cnt_cols <- c("n_hospitalizations", "n_icu_hospitalizations", "n_icu_with_imv", "n_imv_any_location")
small <- icu_imv_counts[, Reduce(`|`, lapply(.SD, function(v) v > 0 & v < 10)), .SDcols = cnt_cols]
icu_imv_counts[small, c("pct_icu_of_hospitalizations", "pct_icu_with_imv") := NA_real_]
for (cc in cnt_cols) { v <- icu_imv_counts[[cc]]; set(icu_imv_counts, j = cc, value = ifelse(v > 0 & v < 10, "<10", as.character(v))) }
icu_imv_counts[, site := institution]
setcolorder(icu_imv_counts, "site")
cat("ICU hospitalizations and IMV:\n"); print(icu_imv_counts)
fwrite(icu_imv_counts, file.path(cohort_characteristics, paste0(institution, "_icu_imv_counts.csv")))
rm(ly, icu_ids, imv_ids, icu_imv_counts, small)
```

# PART TWO: Build Hospitalization, Location, IMV timeline for HFD, ICUFD, VFD
```{r}
if (!use_cohort_cache) {
# Identify All Hospitalizations with documented IMV
resp_supp_imv_id <- respiratory_support[device_category == "imv"]
imv_hospitalizations <- hospitalization[hospitalization_id %in% resp_supp_imv_id$hospitalization_id]

# Filter Only for Hospitalizations with discharge_dttm before January 1st 2026
cutoff_time <- as.POSIXct("2025-12-31 23:59:59", tz = time_zone)
imv_hospitalizations <- imv_hospitalizations[discharge_dttm <= cutoff_time]

# Pull All previous/future hospitalizations for patients with an imv hospitalization
imv_pat_id <- unique(imv_hospitalizations$patient_id)
imv_hospitalizations_full_hx <- hospitalization[patient_id %in% imv_pat_id]

resp_supp_full_hx <- respiratory_support[hospitalization_id %in% imv_hospitalizations_full_hx$hospitalization_id]

# Guard: one row per hospitalization, complete and ordered timestamps
stopifnot(
  imv_hospitalizations_full_hx[, .N, by = hospitalization_id][N > 1, .N] == 0,
  imv_hospitalizations_full_hx[is.na(admission_dttm) | is.na(discharge_dttm), .N] == 0,
  imv_hospitalizations_full_hx[discharge_dttm < admission_dttm, .N] == 0
)

# Create Table of Hospital Days, using calendar day as the index
hospital_days <- imv_hospitalizations_full_hx[, {

  # tz explicit: as.Date() on a POSIXct defaults to UTC, which shifts
  # evening timestamps to the following calendar day
  admit_date     <- as.Date(admission_dttm, tz = time_zone)
  discharge_date <- as.Date(discharge_dttm, tz = time_zone)

  all_dates <- seq(admit_date, discharge_date, by = "day")
  n_days <- length(all_dates)

  tz_use <- attr(admission_dttm, "tzone")
  if (is.null(tz_use) || length(tz_use) == 0 || tz_use == "") tz_use <- time_zone

  # as.POSIXct() on a Date reads it as UTC midnight and only *labels* it with
  # tz, so build from a string to get true local midnight
  calendar_starts <- as.POSIXct(paste0(all_dates,     " 00:00:00"), tz = tz_use)
  next_day_starts <- as.POSIXct(paste0(all_dates + 1, " 00:00:00"), tz = tz_use)

  day_start_time <- calendar_starts
  day_end_time   <- next_day_starts

  day_start_time[1] <- admission_dttm
  day_end_time[n_days] <- discharge_dttm

  data.table::data.table(
    hospitalization_id = hospitalization_id,
    patient_id = patient_id,
    hospital_day_id = seq_len(n_days),
    # as.numeric round-trip forces consistent double storage across groups
    calendar_date = as.Date(as.numeric(all_dates), origin = "1970-01-01"),
    day_start_time = day_start_time,
    day_end_time = day_end_time
  )
}, by = hospitalization_id]

# Guard: calendar_date and day_start_time must describe the same local day
stopifnot(
  hospital_days[hospital_day_id > 1 &
                calendar_date != as.Date(day_start_time, tz = time_zone), .N] == 0
)

# Identify ICU days using ADT table - any hospital day where at least part of it is spent in the ICU counts as an ICU day
adt_icu <- adt[location_category == "icu"]

icu_overlap <- adt_icu[
  hospital_days,
  on = .(
    hospitalization_id,
    in_dttm < day_end_time,
    out_dttm > day_start_time
  ),
  nomatch = 0,
  allow.cartesian = TRUE
]

icu_days_flag <- icu_overlap[
  , .(icu_day = TRUE),
  by = .(hospitalization_id, hospital_day_id)
]

hospital_days <- icu_days_flag[
  hospital_days,
  on = .(hospitalization_id, hospital_day_id)
]

hospital_days[is.na(icu_day), icu_day := FALSE]

# Identify Ventilator Days - any day where patient has a device_category = imv 
#   and at least 2 vent settings counts as a day not liberated from the vent
# Define the IMV settings columns
imv_setting_cols <- c(
  "mode_category",
  "fio2_set",
  "tidal_volume_set",
  "resp_rate_set",
  "peep_set",
  "pressure_control_set",
  "pressure_support_set",
  "flow_rate_set",
  "inspiratory_time_set",
  "peak_inspiratory_pressure_set"
)

# Count how many IMV setting columns are non-missing for each row
resp_supp_full_hx[, n_imv_settings_present :=
  rowSums(!is.na(.SD)),
  .SDcols = imv_setting_cols
]

# Keep rows that meet ventilator rule
resp_imv_valid <- resp_supp_full_hx[
  device_category == "imv" & n_imv_settings_present >= 2
]

# Join qualifying respiratory support rows to hospital days
vent_day_matches <- hospital_days[
  resp_imv_valid,
  on = .(
    hospitalization_id,
    day_start_time <= recorded_dttm,
    day_end_time > recorded_dttm
  ),
  nomatch = 0,
  allow.cartesian = TRUE
]

# Collapse to day-level flag
vent_day_flag <- vent_day_matches[
  , .(vent_day = TRUE),
  by = .(hospitalization_id, hospital_day_id)
]

# Merge back to hospital_days
hospital_days <- vent_day_flag[
  hospital_days,
  on = .(hospitalization_id, hospital_day_id)
]

# Final table of hospital, icu, and vent days for all hospitalizations for
#   patients with documented IMV
hospital_days[is.na(vent_day), vent_day := FALSE]
setorder(hospital_days, patient_id, calendar_date)
}
```

#PART THREE: Identify Trach Times, IMV runs, and adjusted end_imv for trach, death, discharge
```{r}
if (!use_cohort_cache) {
#Identify patients with documented IMV
resp_imv <- respiratory_support %>%
  filter(device_category == "imv")

################################################################################
#Identify trach times through ICD codes, device_category, and tracheostomy data
################################################################################
min_trach_records <- 2                  #2 rows needed
trach_window_days <- 182                #within 6 months before admission
trach_devices     <- c("trach collar", "trach_collar") #device_category values

#1) Diagnosis evidence: tracheostomy status/complications (ICD-10 and 9)
trach_dx_ids <- unique(hospital_diagnosis[toupper(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "", diagnosis_code)) %like% "^Z930|^J950|^V440",
                                          hospitalization_id])

#2) Time-stamped evidence: tracheostomy flag or trach collar
trach_evidence <- unique(respiratory_support[!is.na(recorded_dttm) &
                                        (tracheostomy %in% 1 | tolower(device_category) %in% trach_devices),
                                       .(hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm)])
trach_ev_sum <- trach_evidence[, .(n_times = .N, first_trach_dttm = min(recorded_dttm)), by = hospitalization_id] #Calculate how many times each hospitalization_id has trach evidence

#Create a summary of all known trach status data
enc_trach <- hospitalization[, .(hospitalization_id, patient_id, admission_dttm, discharge_dttm)] #copy hospitalization for use in later filtering
enc_trach[trach_ev_sum, on = "hospitalization_id", `:=`(n_times = i.n_times, first_trach_dttm = i.first_trach_dttm)] #merge in trach_ev_sum
enc_trach[, `:=`(n_times = fcoalesce(n_times, 0L), has_dx = hospitalization_id %in% trach_dx_ids)] #TRUE/FALSE if they have an ICD code
enc_trach[, timed_trach := n_times >= min_trach_records | (n_times >= 1 & has_dx)]   #Do we have sufficient time evidence to support there was a trach? Either >1 documented respiratory records or 1 + an ICD code
enc_trach[!(timed_trach), first_trach_dttm := NA] #Set all dttms to NA if timed_trach is FALSE
enc_trach[, trach_any := timed_trach | has_dx] #TRUE/FALSE for trusted trach evidence - either timed_trach or an ICD code

# When the trach is known to exist, for judging LATER encounters:
  # time-stamped -> first record
  # code only -> that encounter's discharge (latest point it for sure existed)
enc_trach[, trach_known_by := first_trach_dttm]
enc_trach[!(timed_trach) & has_dx, trach_known_by := discharge_dttm]

#Define trach times
trach_times <- enc_trach[timed_trach == TRUE, .(hospitalization_id, first_trach_dttm)]

###############################################################################
#First Documented IMV Time Using respiratory_support
#Define the IMV settings columns
imv_setting_cols <- c("mode_category", "fio2_set", "tidal_volume_set", 
                      "resp_rate_set", "peep_set",
                      "pressure_control_set", "pressure_support_set", "flow_rate_set",
                      "inspiratory_time_set", "peak_inspiratory_pressure_set")
gap_end_hours  <- 24     #no IMV evidence for this long ends a run
non_imv_to_end <- 2      #this many consecutive explicit non-IMV rows end a run
min_imv_rows   <- 3      #runs need at least this many IMV rows

#1) Filter only for those with hosp_id in resp_imv
rs_imv <- respiratory_support[hospitalization_id %in% resp_imv$hospitalization_id & !is.na(recorded_dttm),
                              c("hospitalization_id", "recorded_dttm", "device_category", imv_setting_cols), with = FALSE] #drop any rows with missing recorded_dttm
rs_imv[device_category == "", device_category := NA] #Fill in blanks with NA
rs_imv[, n_set := rowSums(!is.na(.SD)), .SDcols = imv_setting_cols] #Count # of imv_settings per row

#2) Order the table chronologically, one row per encounter x timestamp
    #This corrects resp_support tables that may not have columns collapsed to a single dttm
rs_imv <- rs_imv[, .(device_category = if (any(device_category %in% "imv")) "imv" else device_category[!is.na(device_category)][1], #Choose imv if combining rows
             n_set = max(n_set)), #Recount after collapse down
         by = .(hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm)] 
setorder(rs_imv, hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm) #Set in chronologic order


#3) Calculate the row-level signals
rs_imv[, imv_signal := device_category %in% "imv" & n_set >= 2] #IMV signal = imv + 2 settings
rs_imv[, explicit_non_imv := !is.na(device_category) & device_category != "imv"] #Non-imv signal =/= "imv"
#Rows with no device recorded inherit the previous row's IMV signal using LOCF
rs_imv[, imv_signal_locf := fifelse(is.na(device_category), NA, imv_signal)]
rs_imv[, imv_signal_locf := as.logical(nafill(as.integer(imv_signal_locf), type = "locf")), by = hospitalization_id]
rs_imv[is.na(imv_signal_locf), imv_signal_locf := FALSE]

#4) Identify imv_runs
#Function to find runs
find_imv_runs <- function(t, sig, non) {
  t <- as.numeric(t); n <- length(t)
  begin <- end <- numeric(0); nrows <- integer(0); k <- 0L
  in_run <- FALSE; i <- 1L
  while (i <= n) {
    if (!in_run) {
      if (sig[i]) { in_run <- TRUE; s <- t[i]; last <- t[i]; cnt <- 1L; streak <- 0L }
      i <- i + 1L; next
    }
    gap <- (t[i] - last) / 3600 >= gap_end_hours          # checked BEFORE this row can extend the run
    if (sig[i] && !gap) { last <- t[i]; cnt <- cnt + 1L; streak <- 0L
    } else if (non[i]) streak <- streak + 1L
    if (gap || streak >= non_imv_to_end) {
      k <- k + 1L; begin[k] <- s; end[k] <- last; nrows[k] <- cnt; in_run <- FALSE
      if (gap) next                                          # re-check this row: it may start a new run
    }
    i <- i + 1L
  }
  if (in_run) { k <- k + 1L; begin[k] <- s; end[k] <- last; nrows[k] <- cnt }
  list(begin_imv_resp = begin, end_imv = end, n_imv_rows = nrows)
}
imv_runs <- rs_imv[, find_imv_runs(recorded_dttm, imv_signal_locf, explicit_non_imv), by = hospitalization_id]
imv_runs[, `:=`(begin_imv_resp = .POSIXct(begin_imv_resp, tz = time_zone),
                end_imv        = .POSIXct(end_imv,        tz = time_zone))]

#5) Keep real runs, then compute run-level fields on the runs that remain
#Calculate run times
imv_runs[, imv_duration_hours := as.numeric(difftime(end_imv, begin_imv_resp, units = "hours"))]
#Keep only rows with a duration greater than 0 and 3 or more rows of IMV data
imv_runs <- imv_runs[imv_duration_hours > 0 & n_imv_rows >= min_imv_rows]

#5b) CONSORT boxes A-C (added for the R&R cohort definition)
#  A = all hospitalizations, B = hospitalizations with an ICU ADT location, C = IMV episodes in B.
#  Procedural-only episodes are ported from the old pipeline: an episode that overlaps exactly one
#  ADT row whose location_category is "procedural" (OR/procedure-only intubation) is not counted as
#  an IMV episode. Set drop_procedural_only <- FALSE to turn this off.
drop_procedural_only <- TRUE
#Raw IMV runs (before the ICU, procedural, and trach steps) - used in Part Six for 28-day IMV hours,
#which the old pipeline deliberately did NOT truncate at tracheostomy. Saved for cached runs.
imv_runs_raw <- imv_runs[, .(hospitalization_id, begin_imv_resp, end_imv)]
arrow::write_parquet(imv_runs_raw, file.path(intermediate_dir, "imv_runs_raw.parquet"))
norm_cat <- function(x) tolower(trimws(as.character(x)))
pts_of   <- function(ids) uniqueN(hospitalization[hospitalization_id %in% ids, patient_id])

all_hosp_ids    <- unique(hospitalization$hospitalization_id)
#Study period: discharged on/before cutoff_time from Part Two (the old pipeline applied this via imv_hospitalizations)
if (!exists("cutoff_time")) stop("cutoff_time (Part Two) is not defined")
period_hosp_ids <- unique(hospitalization[!is.na(discharge_dttm) & discharge_dttm <= cutoff_time, hospitalization_id])
icu_hosp_ids    <- intersect(unique(adt[norm_cat(location_category) == "icu", hospitalization_id]), period_hosp_ids)
any_imv_icu_ids <- intersect(unique(resp_imv$hospitalization_id), icu_hosp_ids) #any device_category == "imv" row (info only)

imv_runs   <- imv_runs[hospitalization_id %in% icu_hosp_ids] #Keep only ICU hospitalizations
n_ep_icu   <- nrow(imv_runs)
ids_ep_icu <- unique(imv_runs$hospitalization_id)

if (drop_procedural_only) {
  #ADT rows in numeric seconds; a missing out_dttm is open until the next ADT row (same convention as the location section)
  adt_p <- adt[hospitalization_id %in% ids_ep_icu & !is.na(in_dttm),
               .(hospitalization_id, loc = norm_cat(location_category),
                 in_s = as.numeric(in_dttm), out_s = as.numeric(out_dttm))]
  setorder(adt_p, hospitalization_id, in_s)
  adt_p[, next_in_s := shift(in_s, type = "lead"), by = hospitalization_id]
  adt_p[is.na(out_s), out_s := fifelse(!is.na(next_in_s), next_in_s, Inf)]
  adt_p <- adt_p[out_s >= in_s] #drop rows whose out_dttm precedes in_dttm
  #Every ADT row that overlaps each episode (closed intervals, same as the old foverlaps type = "any")
  runs_p <- imv_runs[, .(hospitalization_id, begin_imv_resp,
                         b_s = as.numeric(begin_imv_resp), e_s = as.numeric(end_imv))]
  ov <- adt_p[runs_p, on = .(hospitalization_id, in_s <= e_s, out_s >= b_s), nomatch = 0L,
              .(hospitalization_id, begin_imv_resp = i.begin_imv_resp, loc = x.loc)]
  proc_only <- ov[, .(n_rows = .N, all_proc = all(loc %in% "procedural")),
                  by = .(hospitalization_id, begin_imv_resp)][n_rows == 1L & all_proc == TRUE]
  imv_runs <- imv_runs[!proc_only, on = .(hospitalization_id, begin_imv_resp)] #Remove procedural-only episodes
}

#Counts for the top of the CONSORT diagram (remaining after each step)
consort_top <- data.table(
  box  = c("A", "A1", "B", "info", "C", "C1"),
  step = c("Total hospitalizations",
           paste0("Hospitalizations discharged on or before ", format(cutoff_time, "%Y-%m-%d")),
           "Hospitalizations with an ICU ADT location",
           "ICU hospitalizations with any device_category = imv row",
           "IMV episodes in ICU hospitalizations (>= 3 IMV rows, duration > 0)",
           "IMV episodes after removing procedural-only episodes"),
  episodes         = c(NA, NA, NA, NA, n_ep_icu, nrow(imv_runs)),
  hospitalizations = c(length(all_hosp_ids), length(period_hosp_ids), length(icu_hosp_ids), length(any_imv_icu_ids),
                       length(ids_ep_icu), uniqueN(imv_runs$hospitalization_id)),
  patients         = c(pts_of(all_hosp_ids), pts_of(period_hosp_ids), pts_of(icu_hosp_ids), pts_of(any_imv_icu_ids),
                       pts_of(ids_ep_icu), pts_of(unique(imv_runs$hospitalization_id))))
print(consort_top)
fwrite(consort_top, file.path(intermediate_dir, "consort_top.csv")) #stable name, read by Part Five on cached runs


setorder(imv_runs, hospitalization_id, begin_imv_resp)
#Create run_id
imv_runs[, run_id := seq_len(.N), by = hospitalization_id]
#Calculate time between runs
imv_runs[, time_to_next_imv_hours := as.numeric(difftime(shift(begin_imv_resp, type = "lead"), end_imv, units = "hours")),
         by = hospitalization_id]
#Define Reintubation
imv_runs[, reintubation := as.integer(.N > 1), by = hospitalization_id]
#Put everything in legible order
setcolorder(imv_runs, c("hospitalization_id", "begin_imv_resp", "end_imv", "time_to_next_imv_hours",
                        "imv_duration_hours", "run_id", "n_imv_rows"))

##################################################################################

#Merge each run's own-encounter trach time (used by Rules 1, 2, 4)
imv_runs_merged <- copy(imv_runs)
imv_runs_merged[trach_times, on = "hospitalization_id", trach_this_admission_dttm := i.first_trach_dttm]

#Add encounter details to every run
imv_runs_merged[hospitalization, on = "hospitalization_id",
                `:=`(patient_id              = i.patient_id,
                     admission_dttm          = i.admission_dttm,
                     discharge_dttm          = i.discharge_dttm,
                     age_at_admission        = i.age_at_admission,
                     admission_type_category = i.admission_type_category,
                     discharge_category      = i.discharge_category)]
stopifnot(imv_runs_merged[is.na(discharge_dttm), .N] == 0) # every episode now has discharge info

#Log of trach info for later use in cleaning analysis
trach_flow <- list() #create an empty list
log_trach <- function(step, dt) trach_flow[[length(trach_flow) + 1L]] <<-
  data.table(step = step, runs = nrow(dt), hospitalizations = uniqueN(dt$hospitalization_id))
log_trach("0 merged", imv_runs_merged) #record the starting point
imv_runs_merged[, end_imv_trach_corrected := end_imv[NA_integer_]]   # empty date-time column; Rule 1 fills it

#Rule 1: trach time falls within the run -> cap end_imv at that trach time
imv_runs_merged[!is.na(trach_this_admission_dttm) &
                  trach_this_admission_dttm >= begin_imv_resp &
                  trach_this_admission_dttm <= end_imv,
                end_imv_trach_corrected := trach_this_admission_dttm]

log_trach("1 run end capped at trach time (no runs removed)", imv_runs_merged) #log it
n_capped <- imv_runs_merged[!is.na(end_imv_trach_corrected), .N]    # report this in the flow / methods

#Rule 2: trach before the run begins -> drop
imv_runs_merged_filt <- imv_runs_merged[is.na(trach_this_admission_dttm) | trach_this_admission_dttm >= begin_imv_resp]
log_trach("2 excl. trach before run start", imv_runs_merged_filt) #Log it

#Rule 3: trach in the 6 months before admission -> drop
prior <- enc_trach[trach_any == TRUE, .(patient_id, prior_id = hospitalization_id, trach_known_by)] #Look at enc_trach for previous trach_dttm values
cur   <- enc_trach[, .(patient_id, hospitalization_id, admission_dttm,
                 win_start = admission_dttm - trach_window_days * 86400)] #For every row in enc_trach calculate when 6-months before admission_dttm is (in seconds)
prior_hits <- prior[cur, on = .(patient_id, trach_known_by >= win_start, trach_known_by < admission_dttm),
                    nomatch = 0L, .(hospitalization_id = i.hospitalization_id, prior_id = x.prior_id)] #Match each encounter with the earlier trach events within the window 
prior_trach_ids <- unique(prior_hits$hospitalization_id) #List of IDs
#Filter out the trachs within 6-months
imv_runs_merged_filt <- imv_runs_merged_filt[!hospitalization_id %in% prior_trach_ids]
log_trach("3 excl. trach within 6 months before admission", imv_runs_merged_filt) #log it

#Rule 4: trach within 72 hours of starting IMV -> drop
imv_runs_merged_filt <- imv_runs_merged_filt[is.na(trach_this_admission_dttm) |
                                               abs(as.numeric(difftime(trach_this_admission_dttm, begin_imv_resp, units = "hours"))) > 72]
log_trach("4 excl. trach within 72 h of IMV start", imv_runs_merged_filt) #log it

#Rule 5: missed tracheostomies -> drop 
  #Post-acute destinations where somebody with a trach may go
post_acute_categories <- c(
  "skilled nursing facility (snf)", "acute inpatient rehab facility", "long term care hospital (ltach)",   # CLIF 2.1
  "snf", "acute_ip_rehab", "ltach"                                                                       # CLIF 3.0
)
#Create list of IDs with ICD code of trach without any documented respiratory trach values
dx_untimed_ids <- enc_trach[has_dx & !timed_trach, hospitalization_id]


imv_runs_merged_filt[, `:=`(
  trach_documented = hospitalization_id %in% trach_times$hospitalization_id,   #time-stamped trach this encounter
  ventilated_at_discharge = fcoalesce(end_imv_trach_corrected, end_imv) >= discharge_dttm - 3600,  #still on the vent within 1 h of discharge
  post_acute_dc = tolower(trimws(discharge_category)) %in% post_acute_categories, #evidence of DC to a trach facility
  trach_code_untimed = hospitalization_id %in% dx_untimed_ids                 #trach ICD code, no time-stamped trach
)]

# 5a: IMV run continues to discharge, the patient goes to a post-acute facility, and no trach is documented at any point in hospitalization
imv_runs_merged_filt[, missed_trach_5a := ventilated_at_discharge %in% TRUE & post_acute_dc & !trach_documented]

# 5b: trach diagnosis in this encounter but no time-stamped documentation -> every run in the encounter
imv_runs_merged_filt[, missed_trach_5b := trach_code_untimed]

runs_excluded_5b <- imv_runs_merged_filt[missed_trach_5b & !missed_trach_5a]    #saved for possible sensitivity analysis

imv_runs_merged_filt <- imv_runs_merged_filt[!(missed_trach_5a)] #Filter out rule 5a
log_trach("5a excl. ventilated at discharge to post-acute facility, no trach documented", imv_runs_merged_filt) #log it

imv_runs_merged_filt <- imv_runs_merged_filt[!(missed_trach_5b)] #Filter out rule 5b
log_trach("5b excl. trach diagnosis without time-stamped documentation", imv_runs_merged_filt) #log it

trach_flow <- rbindlist(trach_flow)
trach_flow[, runs_removed := shift(runs) - runs]
print(trach_flow)
fwrite(trach_flow, file.path(audit_dir, paste0("trach_exclusion_flow_", stamp, institution, ".csv")))

#Trach audit data
ever_imv_ids <- unique(resp_imv$hospitalization_id)
cohort_ids   <- unique(imv_runs_merged_filt$hospitalization_id)     # after trach rules 2-5b

enc_trach[, trach_evidence := fcase(
  timed_trach & n_times >= min_trach_records,        "timed: 2+ time-stamped records",
  timed_trach & n_times == 1,                        "timed: 1 record confirmed by code",
  !timed_trach & has_dx,                             "code only, no time-stamped record",
  !timed_trach & n_times == 1,                       "single record, no code (artifact, not a trach)",
  default =                                          "no trach evidence")]

trach_audit <- enc_trach[, .(all_encounters      = .N,
                             ever_ventilated     = sum(hospitalization_id %in% ever_imv_ids),
                             in_cohort_post_rules = sum(hospitalization_id %in% cohort_ids)),
                         by = trach_evidence][order(trach_evidence)]
print(trach_audit)

fwrite(trach_audit, file.path(audit_dir, paste0("trach_evidence_audit_", stamp, institution, ".csv")))

#Optional, local only: the encounter IDs for the artifact group, for site-based  spot checks
fwrite(enc_trach[trach_evidence == "single record, no code (artifact, not a trach)", .(hospitalization_id)],
       file.path(intermediate_dir, paste0("trach_single_record_ids_", stamp, institution, ".csv")))

################################################################################


#Now pull patient demographics data for the selected IMV runs
demo_lookup <- patient_demographics[, .(
  patient_id, sex_category, race_category, ethnicity_category, language_category, death_dttm
)]
#Merge imv_runs and the demographic info
imv_runs_merged_filt <- merge(imv_runs_merged_filt, demo_lookup, by = "patient_id", all.x = TRUE)
#Use time_zone from end_imv for further labeling
tz_label <- attr(imv_runs_merged_filt$end_imv, "tzone")

#Create end_imv_death_corrected
  # Death Rule 1: death_dttm has a real time component and falls within THIS run (begin_imv_resp <= death_dttm < end_imv)
imv_runs_merged_filt[, death_has_time := !is.na(death_dttm) & !format(death_dttm, "%H:%M:%S") %in% c("00:00:00", "23:59:00")]

imv_runs_merged_filt[, death_dttm_candidate := as.POSIXct(NA)] #Create empty column
imv_runs_merged_filt[
  death_has_time & death_dttm >= begin_imv_resp & death_dttm < end_imv,
  death_dttm_candidate := death_dttm
] #Fill in death_dttm_candidate only when death_dttm falls within imv run

  # Death Rule 2: discharge_category is expired/hospice and discharge_dttm falls within THIS run
imv_runs_merged_filt[, discharge_death_candidate := as.POSIXct(NA)] #Create empty column
imv_runs_merged_filt[
  tolower(discharge_category) %in% c("expired", "hospice") &
    discharge_dttm >= begin_imv_resp & discharge_dttm < end_imv,
  discharge_death_candidate := discharge_dttm
] #Fill in death_dttm_candidate only when discharge_dttm falls within imv run

# Take the earliest of the two, if either exists
imv_runs_merged_filt[, end_imv_death_corrected :=
  pmin(death_dttm_candidate, discharge_death_candidate, na.rm = TRUE)
] #Create end_imv_death_corrected
imv_runs_merged_filt[, end_imv_death_corrected :=
  lubridate::with_tz(end_imv_death_corrected, tz_label)
]
#Drop unneeded columns
imv_runs_merged_filt[, c("death_has_time", "death_dttm_candidate", "discharge_death_candidate") := NULL]

#Create end_imv_discharge_corrected (bounded to THIS run as well)
imv_runs_merged_filt[, end_imv_discharge_corrected := as.POSIXct(NA)]
imv_runs_merged_filt[
  !is.na(discharge_dttm) & discharge_dttm >= begin_imv_resp & discharge_dttm < end_imv,
  end_imv_discharge_corrected := discharge_dttm
]
imv_runs_merged_filt[, end_imv_discharge_corrected :=
  lubridate::with_tz(end_imv_discharge_corrected, tz_label)
]

#Determine end_obs based off of earliest timestamp from these columns
imv_runs_merged_filt[, end_obs := pmin(end_imv, end_imv_trach_corrected, end_imv_death_corrected,
                                       end_imv_discharge_corrected, na.rm = TRUE)]
imv_runs_merged_filt[, end_imv_source := fcase(
  end_obs == end_imv,                                                          "resp",
  !is.na(end_imv_trach_corrected)     & end_obs == end_imv_trach_corrected,     "trach",
  !is.na(end_imv_death_corrected)     & end_obs == end_imv_death_corrected,     "death/hospice",
  !is.na(end_imv_discharge_corrected) & end_obs == end_imv_discharge_corrected, "discharge")]
stopifnot(imv_runs_merged_filt[end_obs < begin_imv_resp, .N] == 0)
}
```

#Part FOUR: Identify time of RSI and Infusions associated with intubation and use this data to correct any begin_imv errors
  # Use evidence of RSI or continuous meds only given while intubated
```{r}
if (!use_cohort_cache) {
#Define baseline variables for establishing earlier intubation times
rsi_window_before <- 5      #paralytic may be charted up to 5 min BEFORE the sedative
rsi_window_after  <- 10     #or up to 10 min after
rsi_episode_gap   <- 60     #sedative pushes > 60 min apart start a new RSI episode
drip_gap_hours    <- 6      #infusion charting gap that ends a drip run
begin_lookback_h  <- 1      #RSI/drip may move a run's start earlier by at most this many hours
rsi_sed_groups    <- c("sedation", "anxiolytic")
rsi_para_groups   <- c("paralytic", "paralytics")
drip_meds         <- c("propofol", "cisatracurium", "vecuronium", "rocuronium")
imv_ids <- unique(imv_runs_merged_filt$hospitalization_id) #List of hosp_ids cleaned thus far

#)1 Identify RSI episodes: a sedative push with a paralytic push within -5/+10 min
#Filter intermittent meds
im_rsi <- intermittent_meds[hospitalization_id %in% imv_ids & med_dose > 0 &
                        med_group %in% c(rsi_sed_groups, rsi_para_groups),
                        .(hospitalization_id, admin_dttm, med_group, med_category)]
#Sedative meds
sed  <- im_rsi[med_group %in% rsi_sed_groups,
           .(hospitalization_id, sed_time = admin_dttm, sed_med = med_category,
             win_lo = admin_dttm - rsi_window_before * 60, win_hi = admin_dttm + rsi_window_after * 60)]
#Paralytic meds
para <- im_rsi[med_group %in% rsi_para_groups, .(hospitalization_id, para_time = admin_dttm, para_med = med_category)]
#Identify RSI pairs - merge sed and para
rsi_pairs <- para[sed, on = .(hospitalization_id, para_time >= win_lo, para_time <= win_hi), nomatch = 0L,
                  .(hospitalization_id, sed_time = i.sed_time, sed_med = i.sed_med,
                    para_time = x.para_time, para_med = x.para_med)]
setorder(rsi_pairs, hospitalization_id, sed_time, para_time)
#Calculate the time between Paralytic and Sedative and define episode
rsi_pairs[, episode := cumsum(c(TRUE, diff(as.numeric(sed_time)) > rsi_episode_gap * 60)), by = hospitalization_id]
#Choose earliest pair per episode
rsi_episodes <- rsi_pairs[rsi_pairs[, .I[1], by = .(hospitalization_id, episode)]$V1]

#2) Use drips to identify earlier intubation time
#Filter continuous meds for drips we want
drips <- meds[hospitalization_id %in% imv_ids & tolower(med_category) %in% drip_meds & med_dose > 0,
              .(hospitalization_id, admin_dttm, med_category)]
setorder(drips, hospitalization_id, admin_dttm)
#Define runs of continuous meds
drips[, new_run := is.na(shift(admin_dttm)) |
                   as.numeric(difftime(admin_dttm, shift(admin_dttm), units = "hours")) > drip_gap_hours,
      by = hospitalization_id]
#Give each run a number
drips[, drip_run := cumsum(new_run), by = hospitalization_id]
#Collapse down to one row per infusion run
drip_runs <- drips[, .(begin_drip = min(admin_dttm), end_drip = max(admin_dttm), n_rows = .N,
                       meds_involved = paste(sort(unique(med_category)), collapse = ", ")),
                   by = .(hospitalization_id, drip_run)]

#3) Earliest valid IMV evidence in the hour 
#Create a version of our part 2 result and calculate the earliest window (win_lo)
runs_win <- imv_runs_merged_filt[, .(hospitalization_id, run_id, begin_imv_resp,
                                            win_lo = begin_imv_resp - begin_lookback_h * 3600)]
#Split sed_time and para_time
rsi_times <- rbind(rsi_episodes[, .(hospitalization_id, t = sed_time)],
                   rsi_episodes[, .(hospitalization_id, t = para_time)])
#Determine earliest time within window for either sedative or paralytic
rsi_fix <- rsi_times[runs_win, on = .(hospitalization_id, t >= win_lo, t < begin_imv_resp), nomatch = 0L,
                     .(hospitalization_id, run_id, t = x.t)][, .(begin_imv_rsi_corrected = min(t)),
                                                             by = .(hospitalization_id, run_id)]
#Determine earliest time within window for drip
drip_fix <- drip_runs[runs_win, on = .(hospitalization_id, begin_drip >= win_lo, begin_drip < begin_imv_resp), nomatch = 0L,
                      .(hospitalization_id, run_id, t = x.begin_drip)][, .(begin_imv_drip_corrected = min(t)),
                                                                       by = .(hospitalization_id, run_id)]

#Form total evidence table
all_evidence <- copy(imv_runs_merged_filt)
#Merge in rsi_fix and drip_fix
all_evidence[rsi_fix,  on = .(hospitalization_id, run_id), begin_imv_rsi_corrected  := i.begin_imv_rsi_corrected]
all_evidence[drip_fix, on = .(hospitalization_id, run_id), begin_imv_drip_corrected := i.begin_imv_drip_corrected]
#Verify columns exist - if it doesnt then create it with every column as NA
if (!"begin_imv_rsi_corrected"  %in% names(all_evidence)) all_evidence[, begin_imv_rsi_corrected  := begin_imv_resp[NA_integer_]]
if (!"begin_imv_drip_corrected" %in% names(all_evidence)) all_evidence[, begin_imv_drip_corrected := begin_imv_resp[NA_integer_]]

#Determine begin_obs by choosing the earliest of the begin_imv columns
all_evidence[, begin_obs := pmin(begin_imv_resp, begin_imv_rsi_corrected, begin_imv_drip_corrected, na.rm = TRUE)]
#Document the source for auditing
all_evidence[, begin_imv_source := fcase(
  !is.na(begin_imv_rsi_corrected)  & begin_obs == begin_imv_rsi_corrected,  "rsi",
  !is.na(begin_imv_drip_corrected) & begin_obs == begin_imv_drip_corrected, "drip",
  default = "resp")]
print(all_evidence[, .N, by = begin_imv_source]) #PEAK

################################################################################
# Form the Baseline Table
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs <- all_evidence[, .(
  hospitalization_id,  run_id, begin_obs,  end_obs,  begin_imv_source,  end_imv_source,
  admission_dttm,  discharge_dttm,  admission_type_category,  discharge_category,
  age_at_admission,  sex_category,  race_category,  ethnicity_category,  language_category,
  death_dttm,  reintubation,  trached = as.integer(trach_documented)
)]
setorder(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs, hospitalization_id, begin_obs, end_obs)

#Define minimum run length
min_run_hours <- 0 #0 = no minimum: the <4 h criterion in Part Five applies to the index episode (old-pipeline behaviour)
#Calculate ns for auditing
n_start <- nrow(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs)
h_start <- uniqueN(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs$hospitalization_id)

#Merge overlapping runs (an earlier begin_obs can now reach back into a previous run)
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, prev_max_end := shift(cummax(as.numeric(end_obs))), by = hospitalization_id] #Calculate time of current end_obs in seconds
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, episode := cumsum(is.na(prev_max_end) | as.numeric(begin_obs) >= prev_max_end),
                                by = hospitalization_id] #Create episodes of IMV and see if begin_obs for one row comes after the end_obs of another
#Find the latest end of each episode
ep_end <- baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, .(ep_end_obs = max(end_obs),
                                              ep_end_src = end_imv_source[which.max(end_obs)]), #Document the source
                                          by = .(hospitalization_id, episode)]

#Keep only the first row for an episode to help distinguish start times
first_rows <- baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, .I[1], by = .(hospitalization_id, episode)]$V1
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs <- baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[first_rows]

#Merge with ep_end to also get the greatest end_obs and then re-label
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[ep_end, on = .(hospitalization_id, episode),
                                `:=`(end_obs = i.ep_end_obs, end_imv_source = i.ep_end_src)]
#Drop unnecessary columns
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, c("episode", "prev_max_end") := NULL]
 # Calculate ns for auditing
n_after_merge <- nrow(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs)
h_after_merge <- uniqueN(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs$hospitalization_id)


####Filter out runs that are shorter than the min_run_hours
 # Calculate run hours
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, run_hrs := as.numeric(difftime(end_obs, begin_obs, units = "hours"))]
print(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, .N, by = .(dur = cut(run_hrs, c(-Inf, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 12, 24, Inf)))][order(dur)]) #Peak
stopifnot(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[is.na(run_hrs), .N] == 0) #If there are any NA run_hrs then stop
 # Filter for min_run_hours
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs <- baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[run_hrs >= min_run_hours]
setorder(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs, hospitalization_id, begin_obs)
 # n for auditing
n_after_min <- nrow(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs)

####Finalize table
 # Number the run of each encounter for reintubation determination
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, run_id := seq_len(.N), by = hospitalization_id]
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, reintubation := as.integer(.N > 1), by = hospitalization_id]

 # Build a permanent run_id for building hourly table later
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, imv_run_id := sprintf("%s_%.0f", hospitalization_id, as.numeric(begin_obs))]

 # Verify every ID is Unique
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs$imv_run_id))

#######Create the full cohort flowchart with trach exclusions and run cleanup
cleanup_flow <- data.table(
  step             = c("6 start of run cleanup", "7 overlapping runs merged", paste0("8 runs >= ", min_run_hours, " h (eligible runs)")),
  runs             = c(n_start, n_after_merge, n_after_min),
  hospitalizations = c(h_start, h_after_merge, uniqueN(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs$hospitalization_id)))
cohort_flow <- rbind(trach_flow[, .(step, runs, hospitalizations)], cleanup_flow)
cohort_flow[, runs_removed := shift(runs) - runs]
print(cohort_flow)

#Save it
fwrite(cohort_flow, file.path(cohort_characteristics, paste0("cohort_flow_", stamp, institution, ".csv")))
fwrite(cohort_flow, file.path(intermediate_dir, "cohort_flow.csv"))   # stable name, readable on cached runs

}
```

# PART FIVE: Establish other baseline patient characteristics
  # Height [x]
  # Weight [x]
  # Elixhauser [x]
  # Location of intubation [x]
  # Hospital type - academic vs community [x]
  # Are there any other features that we need to consider for patient removal? Leaving people in regardless of missing features or length of IMV as long as it's real. I suppose we can cut people with less than 1 hour of IMV? Can calculate how many of those there are
```{r}
if (!use_cohort_cache) {
################################################################################
# PART FOUR: HEIGHT
################################################################################

#Set baseline tolerance, high and low ambiguous values, review range, etc
tol_cm          <- 7.5      # two hospitalizations "agree" on a height if within this many cm
amb_lo          <- 30       # raw values in [amb_lo, amb_hi) could be inches OR 2-digit feet-inches
amb_hi          <- 85       # shorthand (e.g., 54 = 5'4")
ft_digit_range  <- c(4, 6)  # plausible adult feet digit when reading a 2-digit value as feet+inches
review_range_cm <- 10       # flag patients whose hospitalization heights still differ by more than this
big_gap_cm      <- 20       # patients with a gap larger than this get the typo / unexplained-gap checks
height_upstream_inches <- NA   # NA = detect automatically; TRUE/FALSE to force it for a site

#1) Pull all of the cohort hospitalizations, define cohort admission_dttm and +/-12 month windows
cohort_hosp_ids <- unique(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs$hospitalization_id)

cohort_hosp <- hospitalization[hospitalization_id %in% cohort_hosp_ids,
  .(patient_id,
    cohort_hospitalization_id = hospitalization_id,
    cohort_admission_dttm     = admission_dttm)]
cohort_hosp[, cohort_admission_dttm := as.POSIXct(cohort_admission_dttm, tz = time_zone)]
cohort_hosp[, `12_months_after`  := add_with_rollback(cohort_admission_dttm, months(12))]
cohort_hosp[, `12_months_before` := add_with_rollback(cohort_admission_dttm, months(-12))]
#List of all cohort patient_id values
cohort_patients <- unique(cohort_hosp[, .(patient_id)])

#All hospitalizations for cohort patients that fall within +/-12 months of a cohort admission
all_pat_hosp <- hospitalization[patient_id %in% cohort_hosp$patient_id,
  .(hospitalization_id, patient_id, admission_dttm)]
#Merge all hospitalizations with window values and filter
pat_hosp_window <- merge(all_pat_hosp, cohort_hosp, by = "patient_id", allow.cartesian = TRUE)
pat_hosp_window <- pat_hosp_window[
  admission_dttm >= `12_months_before` & admission_dttm <= `12_months_after`
]
window_hosp_ids <- unique(pat_hosp_window$hospitalization_id) #hospitalization_ids within window

#2) Pull raw height readings from all hospitalizations within window
height_vitals <- vitals[
  vital_category == "height_cm" & hospitalization_id %in% window_hosp_ids & !is.na(vital_value),
  .(hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm, height_raw = vital_value)
]
height_vitals <- unique(height_vitals)
#Merge to also add in patient_id
height_vitals <- merge(height_vitals, hospitalization[, .(hospitalization_id, patient_id)],
                       by = "hospitalization_id")

#3A) Raw distribution diagnostics - quick visualization while building the code
quantile(height_vitals$height_raw, probs = c(0, .001, .01, .05, .5, .95, .99, .999, 1))
print(height_vitals[height_raw < 100, .N,
  by = .(bucket = cut(height_raw, breaks = c(-Inf, 1, 3, 9, 30, 55, 85, 100)))][order(bucket)])
print(height_vitals[height_raw > 250, .N,
  by = .(bucket = cut(height_raw, breaks = c(250, 300, 500, 1000, 3000, Inf)))][order(bucket)])
print(height_vitals[height_raw > 3 & height_raw < 30, .N, by = .(as_typed = round(height_raw / 2.54, 2))][order(-N)][1:20])

#3B)
#Undo the upstream inches->cm conversion to see what was typed (e.g., 14.22 cm -> 5.6)
height_vitals[, typed_in  := round(height_raw / 2.54, 2)]
height_vitals[, ftin_frac := round((typed_in - floor(typed_in)) * 100)]                   # 5.6 -> 60, 5.11 -> 11, 5.1 -> 10
height_vitals[, ftin_in   := fifelse(ftin_frac %% 10 == 0, ftin_frac / 10, ftin_frac)]    # inches: 60 -> 6, 11 -> 11

#3C)
#Detect whether this site's heights were entered in inches and converted to cm upstream:
  # if so, most plausible readings are whole inches x 2.54 (e.g., 170.18 = 67 in)
plaus     <- height_vitals[height_raw >= 100 & height_raw <= 250, height_raw]
pct_whole <- mean(abs(plaus / 2.54 - round(plaus / 2.54)) < 0.025)      # 0.025 in allows for rounding to 0.1 cm
if (is.na(height_upstream_inches)) height_upstream_inches <- pct_whole > 0.5
message(sprintf("Heights at whole-inch values: %.1f%% -> upstream inches conversion assumed: %s",
                100 * pct_whole, height_upstream_inches))

#4) Classify each reading by what it most plausibly is using fcase
height_vitals[, unit_class := fcase(
  height_raw >= 100  & height_raw <= 250,  "cm", #values in this range are most likely true cm readings
  height_raw >= 1    & height_raw <= 2.5,  "meters", #values in this range may be meters
  !height_upstream_inches & height_raw >= 4 & height_raw < 8, "decimal_feet",     #values in this range may be meters
  height_upstream_inches & height_raw >= 9 & height_raw < 30 &                    #upstream-converted sites only
    floor(typed_in) >= ft_digit_range[1] & floor(typed_in) <= ft_digit_range[2] &
    !ftin_frac %in% c(0, 10) & ftin_in <= 11, "ftin_in_inches_field",
  height_raw >= 1000 & height_raw <= 2500, "decimal_shift", #values here could be transposition e.g. 1750 meant 175.0
  height_raw >= 400  & height_raw <= 711 &
    abs(height_raw - round(height_raw)) < 1e-6 &
    (round(height_raw) %% 100) <= 11,      "feet_inches_3digit", #values here may be feet with inches written out e.g. 510 = 5'10"
  height_raw >= amb_lo & height_raw < amb_hi, "ambiguous", #values here are truly ambiguous - inches vs 2-digit feet-inches
  default = "unusable" #default to using unusable if a value does not fall within one of these ranges
)]

#Define conversion factors for unit_class values defined above and create new column
height_vitals[, height_cm_conv := fcase(
  unit_class == "cm",                   height_raw,
  unit_class == "meters",               height_raw * 100,
  unit_class == "decimal_feet",         height_raw * 30.48,                                    # raw-unit sites only
  unit_class == "ftin_in_inches_field", (floor(typed_in) * 12 + ftin_in) * 2.54,               # upstream-converted sites only
  unit_class == "decimal_shift",        height_raw / 10,
  unit_class == "feet_inches_3digit",   ((floor(height_raw / 100) * 12) + (round(height_raw) %% 100)) * 2.54,
  default = NA_real_
)]
height_vitals[, c("typed_in", "ftin_frac", "ftin_in") := NULL]   # helper columns no longer needed

#Audit of the unit class for later analysis
audit_unit_class <- height_vitals[, .(n_readings = .N, n_patients = uniqueN(patient_id)), by = unit_class][order(-n_readings)]
print(audit_unit_class) #peak

#)5 Choose one value per hospitalization
  # Rule 1: Hospitalizations without any unambiguous/unusable reading use the median of those readings
hosp_trusted <- height_vitals[!unit_class %in% c("ambiguous", "unusable"),
  .(hosp_height_cm = median(height_cm_conv), n_obs = .N),
  by = .(patient_id, hospitalization_id)]

  # Rule 2: Hospitalizations with ONLY ambiguous readings keep the median raw value for now
hosp_ambiguous <- height_vitals[unit_class == "ambiguous" &
                                  !hospitalization_id %in% hosp_trusted$hospitalization_id,
  .(raw_med = median(height_raw), n_obs = .N),
  by = .(patient_id, hospitalization_id)]

#)6 Resolve ambiguous hospitalizations by cross-hospitalization consensus
  # For hosp where all heights are ambiguous create inches candidate values
cand_inches <- hosp_ambiguous[,
  .(patient_id, hospitalization_id, cand_cm = raw_med * 2.54, family = "inches")]

#Now create foot-inch candidate values if values are within range defined above
cand_ftin <- hosp_ambiguous[
  abs(raw_med - round(raw_med)) < 1e-6 & #The median must be a whole number
    floor(round(raw_med) / 10) >= ft_digit_range[1] &
    floor(round(raw_med) / 10) <= ft_digit_range[2],
  .(patient_id, hospitalization_id,
    cand_cm = ((floor(round(raw_med) / 10) * 12) + (round(raw_med) %% 10)) * 2.54,
    family  = "feet_inches")
]
#Patients with at least one ambiguous hospitalization
amb_patients <- unique(hosp_ambiguous$patient_id)
#Merge trusted and ambiguous heights for ambiguous patients 
all_cands <- rbindlist(list(
  hosp_trusted[patient_id %in% amb_patients,
               .(patient_id, hospitalization_id, cand_cm = hosp_height_cm, family = "trusted")],
  cand_inches,
  cand_ftin
))
#Define function to help resolve which heights we should use
resolve_patient <- function(d) {
  vals    <- unique(d$cand_cm) #all of the distinct values for the patient
  support <- vapply(vals, function(v) uniqueN(d$hospitalization_id[abs(d$cand_cm - v) <= tol_cm]), integer(1)) #Count how many candidate values are within our tolerance
  best    <- vals[support == max(support)] #Find the value that has the most support (ties are allowed)
  trusted_vals <- d$cand_cm[d$family == "trusted"] #Now pull the trusted height if it exists
  #Now determine consensus height
  consensus <- if (diff(range(best)) <= tol_cm) { #If the top values are all within the tol_cm - take their median
    median(best)
  } else if (length(trusted_vals) > 0) { #If they have trusted values use whichever is closest to median trusted height
    best[which.min(abs(best - median(trusted_vals)))]
  } else { #Otherwise leave them as NA
    NA_real_ 
  }

  d <- copy(d) #make a private copy so we don't change shared table
  d[, dist := abs(cand_cm - consensus)] #determine distance from candidate and consensus
  setorder(d, hospitalization_id, dist, na.last = TRUE) #Order by distance, if no consensus then NA
  out <- d[, .SD[1], by = hospitalization_id] #Choose first row as it is closest
  out[, chosen_cm := fifelse(family == "trusted" | (!is.na(dist) & dist <= tol_cm), cand_cm, NA_real_)] #If the chosen is trusted or within tol_cm then keep it, otherwise NA
  out[, .(hospitalization_id, chosen_cm, family)] #Return only one row per encounter
}

resolved <- all_cands[, resolve_patient(.SD), by = patient_id] #run the function on the ambiguous values
resolved[, source := fifelse(is.na(chosen_cm), "unresolved", family)] #if still NA then label it as unresolved

hosp_height <- rbindlist(list(
  hosp_trusted[!patient_id %in% amb_patients,
               .(patient_id, hospitalization_id, hosp_height_cm = hosp_height_cm, source = "trusted")],
  resolved[, .(patient_id, hospitalization_id, hosp_height_cm = chosen_cm, source)]
))

print(hosp_height[, .N, by = source])   # audit: how did ambiguous hospitalizations resolve?

#7) Preliminary median of medians (used to find big-gap patients)
 # Function that returns TRUE if a height isn't missing and lies between 100 and 250
height_ok <- function(x) !is.na(x) & x >= 100 & x <= 250

#Create summary for each patient - keep only plausible heights and one row per encounter
patient_height_prelim <- hosp_height[height_ok(hosp_height_cm),
  .(median_height   = median(hosp_height_cm),
    n_hosp          = .N,
    height_range_cm = max(hosp_height_cm) - min(hosp_height_cm)),
  by = patient_id]

print(patient_height_prelim[height_range_cm > big_gap_cm, .N])

#)8 Correct feet-inches typos and neutralize unexplained gaps
# Safety net for sites that convert inches to cm
big_gap_ids <- patient_height_prelim[height_range_cm > big_gap_cm, patient_id] #Identify patients with big gaps in their height data

#Summarize each of these patients - lowest and highest plausible heights, # of encounters, and extremes converted to inches
chk <- hosp_height[patient_id %in% big_gap_ids & height_ok(hosp_height_cm),
  .(lo_cm = min(hosp_height_cm), hi_cm = max(hosp_height_cm), n_hosp = .N),
  by = patient_id]
chk[, lo_in := lo_cm / 2.54]
chk[, hi_in := hi_cm / 2.54]

#Read the low value's digits as feet+inches (54 in -> 5'4" = 64 in); typo if that matches the high value
chk[, lo_as_ftin := floor(round(lo_in) / 10) * 12 + round(lo_in) %% 10] #Convert the low value to feet+inches then convert to inches
chk[, ftin_match := floor(round(lo_in) / 10) >= ft_digit_range[1] &
                    floor(round(lo_in) / 10) <= ft_digit_range[2] &
                    abs(lo_as_ftin - hi_in) <= 1.5] #Check to see if the conversion fixed it

print(chk[, .N, by = .(ftin_match, n_hosp_3plus = n_hosp >= 3)])   #audit: breakdown of big-gap patients

hosp_height[, hosp_height_cm_orig := hosp_height_cm] #Copy the height before any changes were made
hosp_height[, height_adjustment   := NA_character_] #Record the changes made for auditing

  # (a) Confirmed feet-inches typos: test EVERY encounter of a big-gap patient, not just the lowest one
hosp_height[chk[, .(patient_id, hi_in)], on = "patient_id", hi_in := i.hi_in]
hosp_height[, own_in   := round(hosp_height_cm / 2.54)]                       #this encounter's height in whole inches
hosp_height[, own_ftin := floor(own_in / 10) * 12 + own_in %% 10]             #read the encounter's digits as feet+inches
hosp_height[!is.na(hi_in) & !is.na(hosp_height_cm) &
              floor(own_in / 10) >= ft_digit_range[1] & floor(own_in / 10) <= ft_digit_range[2] &
              own_in < hi_in - 3 &                                              #only values clearly below the high value
              abs(own_ftin - hi_in) <= 1.5,
            `:=`(hosp_height_cm = own_ftin * 2.54, height_adjustment = "ftin_typo_corrected")]
hosp_height[, c("hi_in", "own_in", "own_ftin") := NULL]

  # Patients with at least one confirmed typo (used in part b and the audit)
typo_ids <- unique(hosp_height[height_adjustment %in% "ftin_typo_corrected", patient_id])
chk[, ftin_match := patient_id %in% typo_ids]

  # (b) Unexplained big gap with only 2 hospitalizations: the median would just average two
    # conflicting values so we will set to NA and let sex-median imputation handle the patient
unexplained_2_ids <- chk[ftin_match == FALSE & n_hosp == 2, patient_id]
hosp_height[patient_id %in% unexplained_2_ids,
  `:=`(hosp_height_cm = NA_real_, height_adjustment = "unexplained_gap_set_na")] #Document it for later auditing

#)9 Final median of medians
  # Create final summary for each patient - keep only plausible heights and one row per encounter
patient_height <- hosp_height[height_ok(hosp_height_cm),
  .(median_height   = median(hosp_height_cm),
    n_hosp          = .N,
    height_range_cm = max(hosp_height_cm) - min(hosp_height_cm)),
  by = patient_id]

print(patient_height[height_range_cm > big_gap_cm, .N])      #should drop vs. the preliminary count
patient_height[height_range_cm > review_range_cm, .N]        #remaining likely measurement noise

#)10. Patient-level audit table + sex-based median imputation
  # Set flags for number of readings, conversions, etc per patient (from the unit classification)
pt_unit <- height_vitals[, .(
  n_readings    = .N,
    n_converted = sum(unit_class %in% c("meters", "decimal_feet", "decimal_shift",
                                      "feet_inches_3digit", "ftin_in_inches_field")),
  n_ambiguous   = sum(unit_class == "ambiguous"),
  n_unusable    = sum(unit_class == "unusable")
), by = patient_id]

  # Hospitalization-level flags per patient - make TRUE/FALSE statements for each
    # This may be less rows than pt_unit if patients have height_cm values but none are usable
pt_flags <- hosp_height[, .(
  ambiguous_resolved     = any(source %in% c("inches", "feet_inches")),
  ambiguous_unresolved   = any(source == "unresolved"),
  ftin_typo_corrected    = any(height_adjustment %in% "ftin_typo_corrected"),
  unexplained_gap_set_na = any(height_adjustment %in% "unexplained_gap_set_na")
), by = patient_id]

#Create audit table
audit_patient <- merge(cohort_patients, patient_height, by = "patient_id", all.x = TRUE)
audit_patient <- merge(audit_patient,
  patient_height_prelim[, .(patient_id, height_range_cm_prelim = height_range_cm)],
  by = "patient_id", all.x = TRUE)
audit_patient <- merge(audit_patient, patient_demographics[, .(patient_id, sex_category)],
  by = "patient_id", all.x = TRUE)
audit_patient <- merge(audit_patient, pt_unit,  by = "patient_id", all.x = TRUE)
audit_patient <- merge(audit_patient, pt_flags, by = "patient_id", all.x = TRUE)

# Patients with no height data at all have NA flags: treat as FALSE / 0
for (col in c("ambiguous_resolved", "ambiguous_unresolved", "ftin_typo_corrected", "unexplained_gap_set_na")) {
  set(audit_patient, which(is.na(audit_patient[[col]])), col, FALSE)
}
for (col in c("n_readings", "n_converted", "n_ambiguous", "n_unusable")) {
  set(audit_patient, which(is.na(audit_patient[[col]])), col, 0L)
}

audit_patient[, height_imputed := is.na(median_height)] #Create a column for tracking imputed heights

#Imputation values come from patients with a real (non-imputed) height, one value per patient
  # Determine median height by sex_category
sex_median_height <- audit_patient[height_imputed == FALSE & tolower(sex_category) %in% c("male", "female"),
  .(sex_med = median(median_height)), by = sex_category]
  # Calculate overall median height - used as a backup for people with missing or unknown sex_category
overall_median_height <- audit_patient[height_imputed == FALSE, median(median_height)]

#Join sex medians onto every patient by sex category
audit_patient[sex_median_height, on = "sex_category", sex_med := i.sex_med]

#Record how each height was imputed for auditing
audit_patient[, imputed_with := fcase(
  !height_imputed,     NA_character_,
  !is.na(sex_med),     "sex_median",
  default =            "overall_median"
)]
#Set the final height
audit_patient[, height_cm_final := fcase(
  !height_imputed,     median_height,
  !is.na(sex_med),     sex_med,
  default =            overall_median_height
)]
#Final audit trail for how height was measured - each patient gets one label
audit_patient[, height_status := fcase(
  height_imputed & unexplained_gap_set_na, "imputed_unexplained_gap",
  height_imputed,                          "imputed_no_valid_data",
  ftin_typo_corrected,                     "measured_typo_corrected",
  default =                                "measured"
)]
#Flag for review if heights still differ by more than 10cm after cleaning
audit_patient[, review_flag := !is.na(height_range_cm) & height_range_cm > review_range_cm]
audit_patient[, sex_med := NULL] #Drop sex_med

#)11 Attach height data to baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs
old_cols <- intersect(c("height_cm", "height_imputed", "height_status", "n_height_hosp", "height_range_cm"),
                      names(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs))
if (length(old_cols)) baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, (old_cols) := NULL]

hosp_to_pat <- merge(
  hospitalization[hospitalization_id %in% cohort_hosp_ids, .(hospitalization_id, patient_id)],
  audit_patient[, .(patient_id, height_cm = height_cm_final, height_imputed, height_status,
                    n_height_hosp = n_hosp, height_range_cm)],
  by = "patient_id"
)

# Update-join keeps row order; the same height is intentionally repeated across a hospitalization's runs
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[hosp_to_pat, on = "hospitalization_id",
  `:=`(height_cm = i.height_cm, height_imputed = i.height_imputed, height_status = i.height_status,
       n_height_hosp = i.n_height_hosp, height_range_cm = i.height_range_cm)]

baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[is.na(height_cm), .N]   # should be 0

#)12 Create final height audit summary and save it
n_pat  <- nrow(audit_patient)
n_runs <- nrow(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs)

height_audit_summary <- rbindlist(list(
  data.table(level = "patient", metric = "cohort_patients",                       n = n_pat),
  data.table(level = "patient", metric = "height_measured",                       n = audit_patient[height_imputed == FALSE, .N]),
  data.table(level = "patient", metric = "height_imputed_total",                  n = audit_patient[height_imputed == TRUE, .N]),
  data.table(level = "patient", metric = "imputed_no_valid_data",                 n = audit_patient[height_status == "imputed_no_valid_data", .N]),
```
