```{r}
  data.table(level = "patient", metric = "imputed_unexplained_gap",               n = audit_patient[height_status == "imputed_unexplained_gap", .N]),
  data.table(level = "patient", metric = "imputed_with_sex_median",               n = audit_patient[imputed_with %in% "sex_median", .N]),
  data.table(level = "patient", metric = "imputed_with_overall_median",           n = audit_patient[imputed_with %in% "overall_median", .N]),
  data.table(level = "patient", metric = "any_reading_unit_converted",            n = audit_patient[n_converted > 0, .N]),
  data.table(level = "patient", metric = "ambiguous_reading_resolved",            n = audit_patient[ambiguous_resolved == TRUE, .N]),
  data.table(level = "patient", metric = "ambiguous_reading_unresolved",          n = audit_patient[ambiguous_unresolved == TRUE, .N]),
  data.table(level = "patient", metric = "ftin_typo_corrected",                   n = audit_patient[ftin_typo_corrected == TRUE, .N]),
  data.table(level = "patient", metric = "unexplained_gap_set_na",                n = audit_patient[unexplained_gap_set_na == TRUE, .N]),
  data.table(level = "patient", metric = "multi_hospitalization_height",          n = audit_patient[n_hosp > 1, .N]),
  data.table(level = "patient", metric = paste0("range_gt_", review_range_cm, "cm_final"), n = audit_patient[review_flag == TRUE, .N]),
  data.table(level = "patient", metric = paste0("range_gt_", big_gap_cm, "cm_final"),     n = audit_patient[height_range_cm > big_gap_cm, .N]),
  data.table(level = "run",     metric = "imv_runs_total",                        n = n_runs),
  data.table(level = "run",     metric = "imv_runs_height_imputed",               n = baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[height_imputed == TRUE, .N]),
  data.table(level = "run",     metric = "imv_runs_typo_corrected",               n = baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[height_status == "measured_typo_corrected", .N])
))
height_audit_summary[, denominator := fifelse(level == "patient", n_pat, n_runs)]
height_audit_summary[, pct := round(100 * n / denominator, 2)]
print(height_audit_summary)

# Row-level detail of every height value that was changed (before/after)
height_adjustments_detail <- hosp_height[!is.na(height_adjustment),
  .(patient_id, hospitalization_id, height_adjustment,
    hosp_height_cm_before = hosp_height_cm_orig, hosp_height_cm_after = hosp_height_cm)]

# HEIGHT: keep summary + unit-class counts in audit_dir; row-level files go local
fwrite(height_audit_summary,      file.path(audit_dir,        paste0("height_audit_summary_",      stamp, institution, ".csv")))
fwrite(audit_unit_class,          file.path(audit_dir,        paste0("height_audit_unit_class_",   stamp, institution, ".csv")))
fwrite(audit_patient,             file.path(intermediate_dir, paste0("height_audit_patient_",      stamp, institution, ".csv")))
fwrite(height_adjustments_detail, file.path(intermediate_dir, paste0("height_adjustments_detail_", stamp, institution, ".csv")))

baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, .N, by = .(sex_category, height_status)][order(sex_category, height_status)]

################################################################################
# PART FOUR: WEIGHT
################################################################################

# Set the parameters and ranges we allow
wt_lo         <- 35     # plausible low adult weight after conversion (kg)
wt_hi         <- 450    # widened from 300 so real super obese patients are not rejected
wt_tol_ratio  <- 1.35   # a reading "agrees" with the anchor if within this ratio (1.35 = +/-35%)
wt_stale_days <- 30     # flag if the chosen reading is further than this from admission
bmi_lo        <- 12     # BMI plausibility screen low (flag only, never changes a value)
bmi_hi        <- 80     # BMI plausible max
fb_bmi_lo     <- 15     # Low BMI window used by the fallback to accept an interpretation
fb_bmi_hi     <- 60     # Max BMI window

# Candidate interpretations of a recorded "kg" value. The CLIF value may have been converted
# upstream, so each row says what the entered value might really have been:
#   as_recorded     : value is already correct kg
#   lbs_in_kg_field : lbs typed into a field read as kg                    -> kg = x / 2.20462
#   kg_in_lb_field  : kg typed into a lbs field, then divided by 2.2       -> kg = x * 2.20462
#   lbs_in_oz_field : lbs typed into an oz field, then oz->kg (/35.274)     -> kg = x * 16
#   kg_in_oz_field  : kg typed into an oz field, then oz->kg                -> kg = x * 35.274
#   oz_in_kg_field  : ounces never converted                                -> kg = x / 35.274
#   decimal_x10 / decimal_div10 : missing or extra digit
# Grams can be added the same way (e.g., mult = 0.035274 for grams in an oz field).
interp_tbl <- data.table(
  interp = c("as_recorded", "lbs_in_kg_field", "kg_in_lb_field", "lbs_in_oz_field",
             "kg_in_oz_field", "oz_in_kg_field", "decimal_x10", "decimal_div10"),
  mult   = c(1, 1/2.20462, 2.20462, 16, 35.274, 1/35.274, 10, 0.1)
)
interp_tbl[, prior := .I]   # tie-break order only

#)1 Cohort hospitalizations and +/-12 month windows - same as for height
win_pairs <- pat_hosp_window[, .(patient_id, cohort_hospitalization_id, cohort_admission_dttm, hospitalization_id)]

#)2 Pull raw weight readings (no averaging of same-timestamp readings)
wt_raw <- vitals[
  vital_category == "weight_kg" & hospitalization_id %in% win_pairs$hospitalization_id & !is.na(vital_value),
  .(hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm, wt_raw = vital_value)
]
wt_raw <- unique(wt_raw)
wt_raw[, reading_id := .I] #Create a reading_id

#)3 Raw distribution diagnostics - use during building of code for info
quantile(wt_raw$wt_raw, probs = c(0, .001, .01, .05, .5, .95, .99, .999, 1))
weight_audit_raw_buckets <- wt_raw[, .(n_readings = .N),
  by = .(bucket = cut(wt_raw, breaks = c(-Inf, 0, 2, 9, 19, 35, 77, 300, 450, 1000, 10000, Inf)))][order(bucket)]
print(weight_audit_raw_buckets)   # 35-77 = kg only; 77-300 = kg or lbs; 2-19 = oz-conversion errors; 450+ = typos

#Check plausibility
  plaus_w <- wt_raw[wt_raw >= wt_lo & wt_raw <= wt_hi, wt_raw]
  print(c(whole_oz  = mean(abs(plaus_w * 35.274  - round(plaus_w * 35.274))  < 0.05),
          whole_lb  = mean(abs(plaus_w * 2.20462 - round(plaus_w * 2.20462)) < 0.01),
          whole_kg  = mean(abs(plaus_w - round(plaus_w)) < 0.01)))

#)4 Expand each reading into its plausible interpretations using interp_tbl function
wt_cand <- wt_raw[, .(reading_id, hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm, wt_raw, k = 1L)][
  interp_tbl[, .(interp, prior, mult, k = 1L)], on = "k", allow.cartesian = TRUE][
  , kg_cand := wt_raw * mult][kg_cand >= wt_lo & kg_cand <= wt_hi][, c("k", "mult") := NULL][]

print(wt_cand[, .N, by = interp][order(-N)])

#)5 Anchor per cohort hospitalization: median of per-hospitalization medians
 # Evidence = readings that are plausible AS RECORDED, so the anchor can't be pulled around by the conversion candidates themselves
  # Merge candidate weights with the hospitalization_id info
anchor_base <- merge(
  wt_cand[interp == "as_recorded", .(hospitalization_id, kg_cand)],
  win_pairs[, .(cohort_hospitalization_id, hospitalization_id)],
  by = "hospitalization_id", allow.cartesian = TRUE)
# Determine the median of the kg_cand for each hospitalization/cohort_hospitalization combo
hosp_med  <- anchor_base[, .(hosp_med_kg = median(kg_cand)),
                         by = .(cohort_hospitalization_id, hospitalization_id)]
# Develop anchor for each cohort_hospitalization_id using median of individual medians
wt_anchor <- hosp_med[, .(anchor_kg          = median(hosp_med_kg),
                          n_anchor_hosp      = .N, #How many encounters contributed to the median
                          anchor_range_ratio = max(hosp_med_kg) / min(hosp_med_kg)), #Ratio between heaviest and lightest encounter medians
                      by = cohort_hospitalization_id]

#)6 Decide how to interpret every weight reading using anchor and tolerance
# Readings with no interpretation inside tolerance are dropped as unexplained (counted in the audit)
  # Merge wt_cand and win_pairs to pair each candidate weight to every cohort encounter within the window
wt_resolve <- merge(wt_cand,
  win_pairs[, .(patient_id, cohort_hospitalization_id, cohort_admission_dttm, hospitalization_id)],
  by = "hospitalization_id", allow.cartesian = TRUE)
  # Merge the anchor information - if a cohort has no anchor then it drops out here and is imputed later
wt_resolve <- merge(wt_resolve, wt_anchor[, .(cohort_hospitalization_id, anchor_kg)],
                    by = "cohort_hospitalization_id")
  # Use ratio scale to determine distance between the candidate weight and anchor weight
wt_resolve[, abs_log_ratio := abs(log(kg_cand / anchor_kg))]
  # Filter only for weights within the previously set wt_tol_ratio
wt_resolve <- wt_resolve[abs_log_ratio <= log(wt_tol_ratio)]
setorder(wt_resolve, cohort_hospitalization_id, reading_id, abs_log_ratio, prior)
  # Filter only for unique weights and rename variables
wt_clean <- unique(wt_resolve, by = c("cohort_hospitalization_id", "reading_id"))
setnames(wt_clean, "hospitalization_id", "source_hospitalization_id")

print(wt_clean[, .N, by = interp][order(-N)])                         

#)7 Determine baseline weight defined as cleaned reading closest to cohort admission
  # Calculate absolute time from admission to weight recording
wt_clean[, secs_from_adm := as.numeric(difftime(recorded_dttm, cohort_admission_dttm, units = "secs"))]
wt_clean[, abs_secs := abs(secs_from_adm)]
setorder(wt_clean, cohort_hospitalization_id, abs_secs, recorded_dttm, reading_id)
  # Set up admission weight table
admission_weight <- unique(wt_clean, by = "cohort_hospitalization_id")[, .(
  hospitalization_id   = cohort_hospitalization_id,
  weight_kg_clean      = kg_cand,
  weight_raw           = wt_raw,
  weight_interp        = interp,
  weight_source_hosp   = source_hospitalization_id,
  weight_recorded_dttm = recorded_dttm,
  weight_days_from_adm = secs_from_adm / 86400 #Convert seconds back to days
)]

#)7b Fallback for unanchored cohort hospitalizations: choose interpretation by BMI
# Cohorts with no reading plausible as recorded have no anchor (e.g., kg typed into a lbs field
# and divided by 2.2 gives ~22-35 kg). Use final height to pick the interpretation, accepting
# one ONLY if it is the single interpretation giving a plausible weight AND BMI. Otherwise the
# cohort stays unresolved and is imputed.
n_fallback_rescued <- 0L
if (all(c("height_cm", "height_imputed") %in% names(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs))) {

  unanch_ids <- setdiff(cohort_hosp$cohort_hospitalization_id, admission_weight$hospitalization_id)

  fb_hgt <- unique(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[
    hospitalization_id %in% unanch_ids & height_imputed == FALSE,
    .(hospitalization_id, height_cm)])

  fb_med <- merge(
    win_pairs[cohort_hospitalization_id %in% fb_hgt$hospitalization_id,
              .(cohort_hospitalization_id, hospitalization_id)],
    wt_raw, by = "hospitalization_id", allow.cartesian = TRUE
  )[, .(raw_med = median(wt_raw)), by = cohort_hospitalization_id]

  if (nrow(fb_med) > 0) {
    fb_med[, k := 1L]
    fb_cand <- merge(fb_med, interp_tbl[, .(interp, mult, k = 1L)], by = "k", allow.cartesian = TRUE)
    fb_cand[, kg_cand := raw_med * mult]
    fb_cand <- merge(fb_cand, fb_hgt, by.x = "cohort_hospitalization_id", by.y = "hospitalization_id")
    fb_cand[, bmi := kg_cand / (height_cm / 100)^2]

    fb_pick <- fb_cand[kg_cand >= wt_lo & kg_cand <= wt_hi & bmi >= fb_bmi_lo & bmi <= fb_bmi_hi
                       ][, if (.N == 1) .SD, by = cohort_hospitalization_id]

    if (nrow(fb_pick) > 0) {
      fb_add <- fb_pick[, .(hospitalization_id = cohort_hospitalization_id,
                            weight_kg_clean = kg_cand, weight_raw = raw_med,
                            weight_interp = paste0("bmi_fallback_", interp))]
      admission_weight <- rbind(admission_weight, fb_add, fill = TRUE)
      n_fallback_rescued <- nrow(fb_add)
    }
  }
}
print(n_fallback_rescued)   # how many unanchored cohort hospitalizations were rescued by BMI

#)7c. BMI veto: undo a conversion that makes BMI implausible when the recorded value was fine
if (all(c("height_cm", "height_imputed") %in% names(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs))) {
  veto_h <- unique(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[height_imputed == FALSE, .(hospitalization_id, height_cm)])
  admission_weight <- merge(admission_weight, veto_h, by = "hospitalization_id", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
  admission_weight[, `:=`(bmi_conv = weight_kg_clean / (height_cm / 100)^2,
                          bmi_orig = weight_raw      / (height_cm / 100)^2)]
  admission_weight[, bmi_veto := weight_interp != "as_recorded" & !is.na(height_cm) &
                     (bmi_conv < fb_bmi_lo | bmi_conv > fb_bmi_hi) &
                     bmi_orig >= fb_bmi_lo & bmi_orig <= fb_bmi_hi &
                     weight_raw >= wt_lo & weight_raw <= wt_hi]
  admission_weight[bmi_veto == TRUE, `:=`(weight_kg_clean = weight_raw, weight_interp = "as_recorded_bmi_veto")]
  admission_weight[, c("height_cm", "bmi_conv", "bmi_orig") := NULL]
  admission_weight[, .N, by = bmi_veto]
}
print(admission_weight[, .N, by = bmi_veto])  
print(admission_weight[, .N, by = weight_interp][order(-N)])         

#)8 Create Cohort-level audit table + flags
audit_weight <- cohort_hosp[, .(patient_id, hospitalization_id = cohort_hospitalization_id)]
audit_weight <- merge(audit_weight, patient_demographics[, .(patient_id, sex_category)],
                      by = "patient_id", all.x = TRUE)
 # Calculate # of raw readings per hospitalization_id 
n_raw <- merge(win_pairs[, .(cohort_hospitalization_id, hospitalization_id)],
               wt_raw[, .(hospitalization_id, reading_id)],
               by = "hospitalization_id", allow.cartesian = TRUE)[
  , .(n_raw_readings = .N), by = .(hospitalization_id = cohort_hospitalization_id)]
 # Calculate # of clean weight readings per hospitalization_id
n_clean <- wt_clean[, .(n_clean_readings = .N, n_reinterpreted = sum(interp != "as_recorded")),
                    by = .(hospitalization_id = cohort_hospitalization_id)]
 # Create anchor table
anchor_tbl <- wt_anchor[, .(hospitalization_id = cohort_hospitalization_id,
                            anchor_kg, n_anchor_hosp, anchor_range_ratio)]
 # Combine the five tables into one audit table, one row per cohort encounter
audit_weight <- Reduce(function(a, b) merge(a, b, by = "hospitalization_id", all.x = TRUE),
                       list(audit_weight, n_raw, n_clean, anchor_tbl, admission_weight))
 # Set NA values to 0 in audit_weight
for (col in c("n_raw_readings", "n_clean_readings", "n_reinterpreted")) {
  set(audit_weight, which(is.na(audit_weight[[col]])), col, 0L)
}
print(audit_weight[, lapply(.SD, function(x) sum(is.na(x))),
                   .SDcols = c("n_raw_readings", "n_clean_readings", "n_reinterpreted")])
 # Create TRUE/FALSE flags for weights that required fixing for auditing
audit_weight[, unanchored      := is.na(anchor_kg) & n_raw_readings > 0]
audit_weight[, anchor_conflict := !is.na(anchor_range_ratio) & anchor_range_ratio > wt_tol_ratio^2]
audit_weight[, weight_stale    := !is.na(weight_days_from_adm) & abs(weight_days_from_adm) > wt_stale_days]
audit_weight[, weight_imputed  := is.na(weight_kg_clean)]

#)9 Sex-based median imputation (one value per cohort hospitalization) - same approach as height
sex_median_wt <- audit_weight[weight_imputed == FALSE & tolower(sex_category) %in% c("male", "female"),
  .(sex_med = median(weight_kg_clean)), by = sex_category]
overall_median_wt <- audit_weight[weight_imputed == FALSE, median(weight_kg_clean)]

audit_weight[sex_median_wt, on = "sex_category", sex_med := i.sex_med]
audit_weight[, imputed_with := fcase(
  !weight_imputed,   NA_character_,
  !is.na(sex_med),   "sex_median",
  default =          "overall_median")]
audit_weight[, weight_kg_final := fcase(
  !weight_imputed,   weight_kg_clean,
  !is.na(sex_med),   sex_med,
  default =          overall_median_wt)]
audit_weight[, weight_status := fcase(
  weight_imputed & n_raw_readings == 0,           "imputed_no_readings",
  weight_imputed,                                 "imputed_unresolved",
  weight_interp == "as_recorded_bmi_veto",        "measured_bmi_veto",
  grepl("^bmi_fallback_", weight_interp),         "measured_converted_bmi_fallback",
  weight_interp != "as_recorded",                 "measured_converted",
  default =                                       "measured")]
audit_weight[, sex_med := NULL]

#)10 Attach to baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs
old_cols <- intersect(c("weight_kg", "weight_imputed", "weight_status", "weight_interp",
                        "weight_days_from_adm", "weight_stale", "bmi", "bmi_flag", "bmi_lbs_suspect"),
                      names(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs))
if (length(old_cols)) baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, (old_cols) := NULL]

#Update-join keeps row order; the same weight repeats across a hospitalization's runs by design
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[audit_weight, on = "hospitalization_id",
  `:=`(weight_kg = i.weight_kg_final, weight_imputed = i.weight_imputed,
       weight_status = i.weight_status, weight_interp = i.weight_interp,
       weight_days_from_adm = i.weight_days_from_adm, weight_stale = i.weight_stale)]

baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[is.na(weight_kg), .N]   # should be 0

#BMI screen using the final height: FLAGS ONLY, and only where both values were measured
if ("height_cm" %in% names(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs)) {
  baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, bmi := weight_kg / (height_cm / 100)^2]
  baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, bmi_flag := fcase(
    weight_imputed | height_imputed, NA_character_,
    is.na(bmi),                      NA_character_,
    bmi < bmi_lo,                    "low",
    bmi > bmi_hi,                    "high",
    default =                        "ok")]
}  
print(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, .N, by = bmi_flag])   # BMI screen

#)11 Audit summary and saved files
n_coh  <- nrow(audit_weight)
n_runs <- nrow(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs)
has_bmi <- "bmi_flag" %in% names(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs)

weight_audit_summary <- rbindlist(list(
  data.table(level = "reading",     metric = "raw_weight_readings",                  n = nrow(wt_raw)),
  data.table(level = "reading",     metric = "readings_no_plausible_interpretation", n = wt_raw[!reading_id %in% wt_cand$reading_id, .N]),
  data.table(level = "reading",     metric = "readings_not_retained_after_anchor",   n = wt_raw[!reading_id %in% wt_clean$reading_id, .N]),
  data.table(level = "cohort_hosp", metric = "cohort_hospitalizations",              n = n_coh),
  data.table(level = "cohort_hosp", metric = "weight_measured_total",                n = audit_weight[weight_imputed == FALSE, .N]),
  data.table(level = "cohort_hosp", metric = "measured_as_recorded",                 n = audit_weight[weight_status == "measured", .N]),
  data.table(level = "cohort_hosp", metric = "measured_converted",                   n = audit_weight[weight_status == "measured_converted", .N]),
  data.table(level = "cohort_hosp", metric = "measured_converted_bmi_fallback",      n = audit_weight[weight_status == "measured_converted_bmi_fallback", .N]),
  data.table(level = "cohort_hosp", metric = "measured_bmi_veto (conversion undone, recorded value kept)", n = audit_weight[weight_status == "measured_bmi_veto", .N]),
  data.table(level = "cohort_hosp", metric = "weight_imputed_total",                 n = audit_weight[weight_imputed == TRUE, .N]),
  data.table(level = "cohort_hosp", metric = "imputed_no_readings",                  n = audit_weight[weight_status == "imputed_no_readings", .N]),
  data.table(level = "cohort_hosp", metric = "imputed_unresolved",                   n = audit_weight[weight_status == "imputed_unresolved", .N]),
  data.table(level = "cohort_hosp", metric = "  of which unanchored (no as-recorded plausible reading)", n = audit_weight[unanchored == TRUE & weight_imputed == TRUE, .N]),
  data.table(level = "cohort_hosp", metric = "imputed_with_sex_median",              n = audit_weight[imputed_with %in% "sex_median", .N]),
  data.table(level = "cohort_hosp", metric = "imputed_with_overall_median",          n = audit_weight[imputed_with %in% "overall_median", .N]),
  data.table(level = "cohort_hosp", metric = "anchor_conflict (hosp medians differ > tol^2)", n = audit_weight[anchor_conflict == TRUE, .N]),
  data.table(level = "cohort_hosp", metric = paste0("chosen_reading_gt_", wt_stale_days, "d_from_admission"), n = audit_weight[weight_stale == TRUE, .N]),
  data.table(level = "run",         metric = "imv_runs_total",                       n = n_runs),
  data.table(level = "run",         metric = "imv_runs_weight_imputed",              n = baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[weight_imputed == TRUE, .N]),
  data.table(level = "run",         metric = "imv_runs_weight_converted",            n = baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[grepl("^measured_converted", weight_status), .N]),
  data.table(level = "run",         metric = "imv_runs_bmi_flag_low",                n = if (has_bmi) baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[bmi_flag %in% "low", .N] else NA_integer_),
  data.table(level = "run",         metric = "imv_runs_bmi_flag_high",               n = if (has_bmi) baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[bmi_flag %in% "high", .N] else NA_integer_)
))
weight_audit_summary[, denominator := fcase(level == "reading", nrow(wt_raw), level == "cohort_hosp", n_coh, default = n_runs)]
weight_audit_summary[, pct := round(100 * n / denominator, 2)]
print(weight_audit_summary)

#Which interpretations were used. NOTE: n_cleaned_readings counts a reading once per cohort hospitalization whose window includes it, so it can exceed the raw reading count.
weight_audit_interp <- merge(
  wt_clean[, .(n_cleaned_readings = .N), by = interp],
  admission_weight[, .(n_chosen_as_baseline = .N), by = .(interp = weight_interp)],
  by = "interp", all = TRUE)
print(weight_audit_interp)

#Before/after for every reinterpreted reading
weight_adjustments_detail <- wt_clean[interp != "as_recorded",
  .(patient_id, cohort_hospitalization_id, source_hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm,
    weight_raw = wt_raw, interp, weight_kg_after = kg_cand, anchor_kg)]

fwrite(weight_audit_summary,      file.path(audit_dir,        paste0("weight_audit_summary_",      stamp, institution, ".csv")))
fwrite(weight_audit_interp,       file.path(audit_dir,        paste0("weight_audit_interp_",       stamp, institution, ".csv")))
fwrite(weight_audit_raw_buckets,  file.path(audit_dir,        paste0("weight_audit_raw_buckets_",  stamp, institution, ".csv")))
fwrite(audit_weight,              file.path(intermediate_dir, paste0("weight_audit_cohort_hosp_",  stamp, institution, ".csv")))
fwrite(weight_adjustments_detail, file.path(intermediate_dir, paste0("weight_adjustments_detail_", stamp, institution, ".csv")))

print(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, .N, by = .(sex_category, weight_status)][order(sex_category, weight_status)])

################################################################################
# PART FOUR: Elixhauser (van Walraven weights)
################################################################################
# Produces two versions in one run:
#   *_poa : only diagnoses present on admission (plus exempt-type status codes - see below)
#   *_all : every diagnosis on the hospitalization (matches the original project)
################################################################################

#1) Define the Elixhauser parameters for the project
lookback_months <- 0       # 0 = index hospitalization only. >0 also pulls in the same patient's prior
                           # hospitalizations discharged within that many months before admission
# POA-exempt prefixes, one per code system
poa_keep_prefix_icd10 <- "^Z|^Q23"  # exempt-type codes the ETL recorded as POA = 0 (pacemaker, dialysis, transplant, valve replacement, etc.) - they are actually POA should be kept in the POA version
poa_keep_prefix_icd9  <- "^V|^746[3-6]"   # V codes = status codes; 746.3-746.6 = congenital valve anomalies
apply_hierarchy <- TRUE    # solid tumor not counted when metastatic cancer present (also diabetes / hypertension flags)
primary_version <- "poa"   # which version is copied into the column `elixhauser_score` ("poa" or "all") - using poa version as this doesn't count codes from the acute illness itself during the hosp
age_breaks      <- c(-Inf, 40, 55, 65, 75, Inf) #Set up age ranges for imputation later in code
age_labels      <- c("<40", "40-54", "55-64", "65-74", "75+")

poa_col <- intersect(c("poa_present"), names(hospital_diagnosis))[1] #screen if poa_present is in table
if (is.na(poa_col)) stop("No POA column found in hospital_diagnosis. Add poa_present to the select = c(...) in your load statement.")
if (!"diagnosis_code_format" %in% names(hospital_diagnosis)) stop("Add diagnosis_code_format to the select = c(...) in your load statement.") #check that code format is present

#2) Elixhauser Definitions using ICD codes
  # ICD 10
elix_regex_icd10 <- c(
  chf      = "^I099|^I110|^I130|^I132|^I255|^I420|^I425|^I426|^I427|^I428|^I429|^I43|^I50|^P290",
  carit    = "^I441|^I442|^I443|^I456|^I459|^I47|^I48|^I49|^R000|^R001|^R008|^T821|^Z450|^Z950",
  valv     = "^A520|^I05|^I06|^I07|^I08|^I091|^I098|^I34|^I35|^I36|^I37|^I38|^I39|^Q230|^Q231|^Q232|^Q233|^Z952|^Z953|^Z954",
  pcd      = "^I26|^I27|^I280|^I288|^I289",
  pvd      = "^I70|^I71|^I731|^I738|^I739|^I771|^I790|^I792|^K551|^K558|^K559|^Z958|^Z959",
  hypunc   = "^I10",
  hypc     = "^I11|^I12|^I13|^I15",
  para     = "^G041|^G114|^G801|^G802|^G81|^G82|^G830|^G831|^G832|^G833|^G834|^G839",
  ond      = "^G10|^G11|^G12|^G13|^G20|^G21|^G22|^G254|^G255|^G312|^G318|^G319|^G32|^G35|^G36|^G37|^G40|^G41|^G931|^G934|^R470|^R56",
  cpd      = "^I278|^I279|^J40|^J41|^J42|^J43|^J44|^J45|^J46|^J47|^J60|^J61|^J62|^J63|^J64|^J65|^J66|^J67|^J684|^J701|^J703",
  diabunc  = "^E10[019]|^E11[019]|^E12[019]|^E13[019]|^E14[019]",
  diabc    = "^E10[2-8]|^E11[2-8]|^E12[2-8]|^E13[2-8]|^E14[2-8]",
  hypothy  = "^E00|^E01|^E02|^E03|^E890",
  rf       = "^I120|^I131|^N18|^N19|^N250|^Z490|^Z491|^Z492|^Z940|^Z992",
  ld       = "^B18|^I85|^I864|^I982|^K70|^K711|^K713|^K714|^K715|^K717|^K72|^K73|^K74|^K760|^K762|^K763|^K764|^K765|^K766|^K767|^K768|^K769|^Z944",
  pud      = "^K257|^K259|^K267|^K269|^K277|^K279|^K287|^K289",
  aids     = "^B20|^B21|^B22|^B24",
  lymph    = "^C81|^C82|^C83|^C84|^C85|^C88|^C96|^C900|^C902",
  metacanc = "^C77|^C78|^C79|^C80",
  solidtum = "^C0[0-9]|^C1[0-4]|^C15|^C16|^C17|^C18|^C19|^C20|^C21|^C22|^C23|^C24|^C25|^C26|^C30|^C31|^C32|^C33|^C34|^C37|^C38|^C39|^C40|^C41|^C43|^C45|^C46|^C47|^C48|^C49|^C50|^C51|^C52|^C53|^C54|^C55|^C56|^C57|^C58|^C60|^C61|^C62|^C63|^C64|^C65|^C66|^C67|^C68|^C69|^C70|^C71|^C72|^C73|^C74|^C75|^C76|^C97",
  rheumd   = "^L940|^L941|^L943|^M05|^M06|^M08|^M120|^M123|^M30|^M310|^M311|^M312|^M313|^M32|^M33|^M34|^M35|^M45|^M461|^M468|^M469",
  coag     = "^D65|^D66|^D67|^D68|^D691|^D693|^D694|^D695|^D696",
  obes     = "^E66",
  wloss    = "^E40|^E41|^E42|^E43|^E44|^E45|^E46|^R634|^R64",
  fed      = "^E222|^E86|^E87",
  blane    = "^D500",
  dane     = "^D508|^D509|^D51|^D52|^D53",
  alcohol  = "^F10|^E52|^G621|^I426|^K292|^K700|^K703|^K709|^T51|^Z502|^Z714|^Z721",
  drug     = "^F1[1-6]|^F18|^F19|^Z715|^Z722",
  psycho   = "^F20|^F22|^F23|^F24|^F25|^F28|^F29|^F302|^F312|^F315",
  depre    = "^F204|^F313|^F314|^F315|^F32|^F33|^F341|^F412|^F432"
)
  # ICD 9
elix_regex_icd9 <- c(
  chf      = "^39891|^40201|^40211|^40291|^40401|^40403|^40411|^40413|^40491|^40493|^4254|^4255|^4256|^4257|^4258|^4259|^428",
  carit    = "^4260|^42610|^42612|^42613|^4267|^4269|^427[0-4]|^427[6-9]|^7850|^99601|^99604|^V450|^V533",
  valv     = "^0932|^39[4-7]|^424|^746[3-6]|^V422|^V433",
  pcd      = "^4150|^4151|^416|^4170|^4178|^4179",
  pvd      = "^0930|^4373|^440|^441|^443[1-9]|^4471|^5571|^5579|^V434",
  hypunc   = "^401",
  hypc     = "^40[2-5]",
  para     = "^3341|^342|^343|^344[0-6]|^3449",
  ond      = "^3319|^3320|^3321|^3334|^3335|^33392|^334|^335|^3362|^340|^341|^345|^3481|^3483|^7803|^7843",
  cpd      = "^4168|^4169|^49[0-9]|^50[0-5]|^5064|^5081|^5088",
  diabunc  = "^250[0-3]",
  diabc    = "^250[4-9]",
  hypothy  = "^243|^244|^2461|^2468",
  rf       = "^40301|^40311|^40391|^40402|^40403|^40412|^40413|^40492|^40493|^585|^586|^5880|^V420|^V451|^V56",
  ld       = "^07022|^07023|^07032|^07033|^07044|^07054|^0706|^0709|^4560|^4561|^4562|^570|^5710|^5712|^5713|^571[4-9]|^572[2-8]|^V427",
  pud      = "^5317|^5319|^5327|^5329|^5337|^5339|^5347|^5349",
  aids     = "^04[2-4]",
  lymph    = "^20[0-2]|^2030|^2386",
  metacanc = "^19[6-9]",
  solidtum = "^1[4-6][0-9]|^17[0-2]|^17[4-9]|^18[0-9]|^19[0-5]",
  rheumd   = "^446|^7010|^710[0-4]|^7108|^7109|^7112|^714|^7193|^720|^725|^7285|^72889|^72930",
  coag     = "^286|^2871|^2873|^2874|^2875",
  obes     = "^2780",
  wloss    = "^260|^261|^262|^263|^7832|^7994",
  fed      = "^2536|^276",
  blane    = "^2800",
  dane     = "^280[1-9]|^281",
  alcohol  = "^2652|^291[1-3]|^291[5-9]|^3030|^3039|^3050|^3575|^4255|^5353|^5710|^5711|^5712|^5713|^980|^V113",
  drug     = "^292|^304|^305[2-9]|^V6542",
  psycho   = "^2938|^295|^29604|^29614|^29644|^29654|^297|^298",
  depre    = "^2962|^2963|^2965|^3004|^309|^311"
)

flag_cols <- names(elix_regex_icd10)
stopifnot(identical(flag_cols, names(elix_regex_icd9)))   # both lists must define the same flags

# van Walraven weights (comorbidities with weight 0 are flagged but don't contribute)
elix_wt <- c(chf = 7, carit = 5, valv = -1, pcd = 4, pvd = 2, para = 7, ond = 6, cpd = 3,
             rf = 5, ld = 11, lymph = 9, metacanc = 12, solidtum = 4, coag = 3, obes = -4,
             wloss = 6, fed = 5, blane = -2, dane = -2, drug = -7, depre = -3)
wt_cols <- names(elix_wt)

#3) Which hospitalizations feed each cohort hospitalization
cohort_hosp_ids <- unique(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs$hospitalization_id) #do not repeat hospitalizations for those with multiple runs of IMV

cohort_hosp <- hospitalization[hospitalization_id %in% cohort_hosp_ids,
  .(patient_id, cohort_hospitalization_id = hospitalization_id, cohort_admission_dttm = admission_dttm)]

  # Always use the index hospitalization itself
src_pairs <- cohort_hosp[, .(cohort_hospitalization_id, source_hospitalization_id = cohort_hospitalization_id)] #By default w lookback set to 0 these values equal each other

  # Optional for when we use lookback
if (lookback_months > 0) {
  prior <- merge(
    hospitalization[patient_id %in% cohort_hosp$patient_id,
      .(patient_id, source_hospitalization_id = hospitalization_id, source_discharge_dttm = discharge_dttm)],
    cohort_hosp, by = "patient_id", allow.cartesian = TRUE) #merge all hospitalizations to cohort hospitalizations for each patient
  prior[, window_start := add_with_rollback(cohort_admission_dttm, months(-lookback_months))] #calculate start of lookback window
  prior <- prior[source_hospitalization_id != cohort_hospitalization_id &
                   source_discharge_dttm <= cohort_admission_dttm &
                   source_discharge_dttm >= window_start] #Filter only for hospitalizations within lookback
  src_pairs <- rbind(src_pairs, prior[, .(cohort_hospitalization_id, source_hospitalization_id)])
} #stack the prior-stay pairs - cohort can have several source stays

# Age (one value per hospitalization) and sex, used for imputation
age_lookup <- baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, .(age_at_admission = age_at_admission[1]), by = hospitalization_id] #choose the age at admission- 1 per hospitalization

#4) Function that builds the score for one version (poa_only TRUE / FALSE)
run_elix <- function(poa_only) {

  # 4a. Diagnosis rows: filter, clean, dedupe
  dx <- hospital_diagnosis[hospitalization_id %in% src_pairs$source_hospitalization_id] #keep only the diagnosis rows from hospitalizations that feed the cohort
  dx[, code_fmt := fcase(
  grepl("ICD10", toupper(diagnosis_code_format)), "ICD10",
  grepl("ICD9",  toupper(diagnosis_code_format)), "ICD9",
  default = NA_character_)] #Decide on code type based on diagnosis_code_format
  if (dx[is.na(code_fmt), .N] > 0) { #count rows with unrecognized formatting
  warning(dx[is.na(code_fmt), .N], " diagnosis rows had an unrecognized diagnosis_code_format and were dropped")
  dx <- dx[!is.na(code_fmt)] #drop the unrecognized formatting rows
}
  dx <- dx[!is.na(diagnosis_code)] #drop rows with NA diagnosis_codes
  dx[, diagnosis_code := toupper(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "", diagnosis_code))] #clean, capitalize codes
  dx <- dx[diagnosis_code != ""] #drop blank codes
  hosp_with_any_dx <- unique(dx$hospitalization_id)   #has ANY diagnosis row, before the POA filter - keeps track of which are completely blank vs have diagnoses but no POAs
  cohort_has_dx    <- unique(src_pairs[source_hospitalization_id %in% hosp_with_any_dx, cohort_hospitalization_id]) #Same deal but within cohort - moot if using no lookback
  n_dx_before <- nrow(dx) #count rows prior to POA filter
    # run the POA only version
  if (poa_only) {
  v  <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(dx[[poa_col]]))) #convert poa column to number, ignore NA warnings
  dx <- dx[which(v == 1 |
                 (code_fmt == "ICD10" & grepl(poa_keep_prefix_icd10, diagnosis_code)) |
                 (code_fmt == "ICD9"  & grepl(poa_keep_prefix_icd9,  diagnosis_code)))]
  } #keep the exempt codes defined above 
  
n_dx_after <- nrow(dx) #row count after POA filter
dx <- unique(dx[, .(hospitalization_id, diagnosis_code, code_fmt)]) #keep key columns, remove duplicates

  # 4b. Flag each UNIQUE code once, then aggregate
  code_flags <- unique(dx[, .(diagnosis_code, code_fmt)]) #check each code only once 
  for (nm in flag_cols) { #look to see if code above falls into one of the comorbidities - makes 31 columns of TRUE/FALSE
  set(code_flags, j = nm,
      value = fifelse(code_flags$code_fmt == "ICD10", #try icd10 first then icd9
                      grepl(elix_regex_icd10[[nm]], code_flags$diagnosis_code),
                      grepl(elix_regex_icd9[[nm]],  code_flags$diagnosis_code)))
    }

  hosp_flags <- merge(dx, code_flags, by = c("diagnosis_code", "code_fmt"))[
  , lapply(.SD, any), by = hospitalization_id, .SDcols = flag_cols] #add flags to each row

  cohort_flags <- merge(src_pairs, hosp_flags, #Add flags onto the source-stay mapping then collapse by cohort
                        by.x = "source_hospitalization_id", by.y = "hospitalization_id")[
    , lapply(.SD, any), by = cohort_hospitalization_id, .SDcols = flag_cols]
  setnames(cohort_flags, "cohort_hospitalization_id", "hospitalization_id") #rename cohort back to hosp

  # 4c. Hierarchies and score
  n_solid_removed <- cohort_flags[solidtum & metacanc, .N] #count the number of stays with both solid tumor and metastatic cancer
  if (apply_hierarchy) { #if apply_hierarchy above is TRUE then use these rules
    cohort_flags[, `:=`(solidtum = solidtum & !metacanc,
                        diabunc  = diabunc  & !diabc,
                        hypunc   = hypunc   & !hypc)]
  }
  score_mat <- 1L * as.matrix(cohort_flags[, ..wt_cols]) #pull the 21 weighted columns into a matrix 1/0
  cohort_flags[, elixhauser_score := as.numeric(score_mat %*% elix_wt[colnames(score_mat)])] #van walraven score calculation using the weights defined above

  # 4d. Audit table, one row per cohort hospitalization
  audit <- merge(cohort_hosp[, .(patient_id, hospitalization_id = cohort_hospitalization_id)],
                 cohort_flags, by = "hospitalization_id", all.x = TRUE) #merge in full cohort
  audit[, index_has_dx := hospitalization_id %in% hosp_with_any_dx] #does cohort stay have dx?
  audit[, dx_source := fcase(
    index_has_dx,                       "index",
    hospitalization_id %in% cohort_has_dx, "prior_hospitalizations_only",
    default =                           "none")] #if cohort stay does not have dx then do prior hosps or none?
  # Has diagnoses but none survived the POA filter = no documented preexisting comorbidity: score 0, not imputed
  audit[is.na(elixhauser_score) & hospitalization_id %in% cohort_has_dx, elixhauser_score := 0]
  for (nm in flag_cols) set(audit, which(is.na(audit[[nm]])), nm, FALSE) #replace NA w FALSE for audit

  # 4e. Imputation for hospitalizations with no diagnosis data
  audit[, elixhauser_imputed := is.na(elixhauser_score)] #which rows need a score imputed?
  audit <- merge(audit, patient_demographics[, .(patient_id, sex_category)], by = "patient_id", all.x = TRUE) #merge w patient demo so we have sex
  audit <- merge(audit, age_lookup, by = "hospitalization_id", all.x = TRUE) #merge w age as well
  audit[, age_band := as.character(cut(age_at_admission, age_breaks, right = FALSE, labels = age_labels))] #sort into age groups

  real <- audit[elixhauser_imputed == FALSE] #which stays have real scores - used for medians
  #Tiers of median scores - agexsex median first, then age mmedian, then overall median
  med_age_sex <- real[!is.na(age_band) & !is.na(sex_category),
                      .(m_as = median(elixhauser_score)), by = .(age_band, sex_category)]
  med_age     <- real[!is.na(age_band), .(m_a = median(elixhauser_score)), by = age_band]
  overall_med <- real[, median(elixhauser_score)]

  audit[med_age_sex, on = .(age_band, sex_category), m_as := i.m_as] #write in the values
  audit[med_age,     on = "age_band",                m_a  := i.m_a]
    # which imputation level is each row using?
  audit[, imputed_with := fcase(
    !elixhauser_imputed, NA_character_,
    !is.na(m_as),        "age_sex_median",
    !is.na(m_a),         "age_median",
    default =            "overall_median")]
  audit[, elixhauser_score_final := fcase( #attach the actual scores
    !elixhauser_imputed, elixhauser_score,
    !is.na(m_as),        m_as,
    !is.na(m_a),         m_a,
    default =            overall_med)]
  audit[, c("m_as", "m_a") := NULL]

  list(audit = audit, n_solid_removed = n_solid_removed, n_dx_before = n_dx_before, n_dx_after = n_dx_after)
} #return audit table for summary

#5) Run both the poa and all versions
res_poa <- run_elix(poa_only = TRUE)
res_all <- run_elix(poa_only = FALSE)

# How much did the POA filter remove?
c(dx_rows_all_version = res_all$n_dx_after, dx_rows_poa_version = res_poa$n_dx_after)

#6) Attach to baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs
old_cols <- intersect(c("elixhauser_score", "elixhauser_score_poa", "elixhauser_score_all",
                        "elixhauser_imputed", "elixhauser_imputed_poa", "elixhauser_imputed_all",
                        "elixhauser_dx_source", "elixhauser_dx_source_poa", "elixhauser_dx_source_all"),
                      names(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs))
if (length(old_cols)) baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, (old_cols) := NULL] #clear any old elixhauser data present from previous runs

# Update-joins keep row order; the same score repeats across a hospitalization's runs by design
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[res_poa$audit, on = "hospitalization_id",
  `:=`(elixhauser_score_poa = i.elixhauser_score_final,
       elixhauser_imputed_poa = i.elixhauser_imputed,
       elixhauser_dx_source_poa = i.dx_source)]
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[res_all$audit, on = "hospitalization_id",
  `:=`(elixhauser_score_all = i.elixhauser_score_final,
       elixhauser_imputed_all = i.elixhauser_imputed,
       elixhauser_dx_source_all = i.dx_source)]

# Convenience columns that point at whichever version you declared primary
if (primary_version == "poa") {
  baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, `:=`(elixhauser_score = elixhauser_score_poa,
                                         elixhauser_imputed = elixhauser_imputed_poa,
                                         elixhauser_dx_source = elixhauser_dx_source_poa)]
} else {
  baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, `:=`(elixhauser_score = elixhauser_score_all,
                                         elixhauser_imputed = elixhauser_imputed_all,
                                         elixhauser_dx_source = elixhauser_dx_source_all)]
}

baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[is.na(elixhauser_score_poa) | is.na(elixhauser_score_all), .N]   # should be 0

#7) Audit summary
n_coh  <- nrow(res_all$audit) #number of cohort hospitalizations
n_runs <- nrow(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs) #number of runs

mk_summary <- function(res, label, imputed_col) { #build summary table
  a <- res$audit #audit table shortcut
  data.table(
    version = label,
    level   = c(rep("cohort_hosp", 8), "run", "run"),
    metric  = c("cohort_hospitalizations", "dx_from_index_hospitalization", "dx_from_prior_hospitalizations_only",
                "no_dx_data (imputed)", "imputed_with_age_sex_median", "imputed_with_age_median",
                "imputed_with_overall_median", "solid_tumor_removed_by_metastatic_hierarchy",
                "imv_runs_total", "imv_runs_score_imputed"),
    n       = c(nrow(a), a[dx_source == "index", .N], a[dx_source == "prior_hospitalizations_only", .N],
                a[elixhauser_imputed == TRUE, .N], a[imputed_with %in% "age_sex_median", .N],
                a[imputed_with %in% "age_median", .N], a[imputed_with %in% "overall_median", .N],
                res$n_solid_removed,
                n_runs, baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[get(imputed_col) == TRUE, .N])
  )
}
#combine the 2 versions and add percentages
elix_audit_summary <- rbind(mk_summary(res_poa, "poa", "elixhauser_imputed_poa"),
                            mk_summary(res_all, "all", "elixhauser_imputed_all"))
elix_audit_summary[, denominator := fifelse(level == "cohort_hosp", n_coh, n_runs)]
elix_audit_summary[, pct := round(100 * n / denominator, 2)]
print(elix_audit_summary)

# Prevalence of each comorbidity (hospitalizations with diagnosis data), both versions side by side
prev_fun <- function(res) { #function for prevalence
  a <- res$audit[index_has_dx == TRUE] #keep only stays with their own diagnosis data
  data.table(comorbidity = flag_cols, pct = as.numeric(sapply(flag_cols, function(nm) round(100 * mean(a[[nm]]), 2)))) #calculate percent of hospitalizations with each comorbidity TRUE
}
# Run the function on each version and rename pct to either pct_all or pct_poa for audit
elix_prevalence <- merge(prev_fun(res_all)[, .(comorbidity, pct_all = pct)],
                         prev_fun(res_poa)[, .(comorbidity, pct_poa = pct)], by = "comorbidity")
elix_prevalence[, drop_pct_points := round(pct_all - pct_poa, 2)] #how much did POA remove?
elix_prevalence <- elix_prevalence[order(-drop_pct_points)] #sort by the drop percent
elix_prevalence    # in-stay conditions (fed, coag, carit, wloss) should drop most; chronic ones barely move

# Score distributions and agreement - look at quantiles
rbind(all = quantile(res_all$audit$elixhauser_score_final, c(0, .05, .25, .5, .75, .95, 1)),
      poa = quantile(res_poa$audit$elixhauser_score_final, c(0, .05, .25, .5, .75, .95, 1)))
cor(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs$elixhauser_score_all,
    baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs$elixhauser_score_poa) #look at Pearson correlation between the 2 versions

# Coding-lag check: does missing index diagnosis data cluster at recent discharge dates?
elix_nodx_by_year <- merge(res_all$audit[, .(hospitalization_id, index_has_dx)],
                           hospitalization[, .(hospitalization_id, discharge_dttm)], by = "hospitalization_id")[
  , .(n_hosp = .N, pct_no_index_dx = round(100 * mean(!index_has_dx), 2)),
  by = .(discharge_year = year(discharge_dttm))][order(discharge_year)]
elix_nodx_by_year

#8) Save audit files
fwrite(elix_audit_summary, file.path(audit_dir, paste0("elix_audit_summary_",      stamp, institution, ".csv")))
fwrite(elix_prevalence,    file.path(audit_dir, paste0("elix_audit_prevalence_",   stamp, institution, ".csv")))
fwrite(elix_nodx_by_year,  file.path(audit_dir, paste0("elix_audit_nodx_by_year_", stamp, institution, ".csv")))
fwrite(res_poa$audit,      file.path(intermediate_dir, paste0("elix_audit_cohort_hosp_poa_", stamp, institution, ".csv")))
fwrite(res_all$audit,      file.path(intermediate_dir, paste0("elix_audit_cohort_hosp_all_", stamp, institution, ".csv")))

print(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, .N, by = .(elixhauser_dx_source_poa, elixhauser_imputed_poa)])

################################################################################
# PART FOUR: Location of Intubation
################################################################################
# First define our parameters
match_time_col     <- "begin_obs"  # timestamp matched to ADT
max_gap_mins       <- 60           # begin time in a gap between ADT rows: accept the NEAREST row if within this many minutes
arrive_mins        <- 30           # runs starting within this many minutes of arrival may have been intubated before arrival
reassign_from      <- c("procedural", "ed")   # prior locations the intubation is reassigned to (ward arrivals stay ambiguous)
min_prior_row_mins <- 0            # require the prior ADT row to have lasted at least this long (0 = no restriction)

if (!match_time_col %in% names(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs))
  stop(match_time_col, " is not a column of baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs")

#begin_imv_source describes begin_obs only, so it is only used in the rule when matching on begin_obs
use_src <- (match_time_col == "begin_obs")

#)0 ADT prep (all comparisons in numeric seconds, so timezone labels can't interfere)
if (!"hospital_type" %in% names(adt)) {
  warning("hospital_type is not in adt - add it to the select = c(...) above. Setting to NA.")
  adt[, hospital_type := NA_character_]
} 
#Create ADT table only with populated rows and convert times to seconds for calc
adt_iv <- adt[!is.na(in_dttm), .(
  hospitalization_id, hospital_id, hospital_type,
  location_category = tolower(trimws(location_category)),
  in_s  = as.numeric(in_dttm),
  out_s = as.numeric(out_dttm)
)]
setorder(adt_iv, hospitalization_id, in_s)

n_adt_rows <- nrow(adt_iv) #number of rows in the table
n_out_na   <- adt_iv[is.na(out_s), .N] #number of rows with NA values for out_dttm in s
n_inverted <- adt_iv[!is.na(out_s) & out_s < in_s, .N] #how many rows have an out_dttm before in_dttm
adt_iv <- adt_iv[is.na(out_s) | out_s >= in_s]  #drop rows whose out_dttm precedes in_dttm

# A missing out_dttm is treated as "open until the next ADT row starts" (indefinitely if it is the last row)
adt_iv[, next_in_s := shift(in_s, type = "lead"), by = hospitalization_id] #use in_s from next row to determine time of subsequent location
adt_iv[is.na(out_s), out_s := fifelse(!is.na(next_in_s), next_in_s, Inf)] #if missing an end time - use next_in_s to fill in the missing time unless it's the last row then it's inifinity

# Information about the PRECEDING ADT row (used to infer where a patient who arrived intubated was intubated)
    # if first row then that row gest NA for all three of these
adt_iv[, `:=`(prior_location_category = shift(location_category), #where was previous location_category
              prior_hospital_id       = shift(hospital_id), #where was previous hospital_id
              prior_row_mins          = (shift(out_s) - shift(in_s)) / 60), by = hospitalization_id] #how long were they in the previous row

#)1 Match each IMV run to the ADT row containing the match time
# Intervals are half-open [in, out): a time exactly at a transfer belongs to the NEW location.
runs_key <- data.table(
  run_row            = seq_len(nrow(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs)), #what row is the run in the table - used to match the location later to the right run
  hospitalization_id = baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs$hospitalization_id,
  begin_s            = as.numeric(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[[match_time_col]]) #time to match on in seconds so it can be directly measured against in_s and out_s
)
# Merge run_keys and adt table, drop those without start times, use cartesian to create all possible candidate rows
cand <- merge(
  runs_key[!is.na(begin_s)],
  adt_iv[, .(hospitalization_id, hospital_id, hospital_type, location_category,
             prior_location_category, prior_hospital_id, prior_row_mins, in_s, out_s)],
  by = "hospitalization_id", allow.cartesian = TRUE)

cand[, inside := begin_s >= in_s & begin_s < out_s] #Is the start time inside of this candidate?
# Signed gap in seconds: 0 if inside; negative if the time is BEFORE the row starts; positive if AFTER it ends
cand[, gap_signed_s := fcase(inside,          0,
                             begin_s < in_s,  -(in_s - begin_s),
                             default =        begin_s - out_s)]
cand[, gap_abs_s := abs(gap_signed_s)] #How far is the candidate from the intubation time?
cand[, n_overlap := sum(inside), by = run_row]   # >1 means overlapping ADT rows contain the time

# Best row per run: containing row first (most recently started if several overlap), otherwise nearest
setorder(cand, run_row, gap_abs_s, -in_s) #put them in order of gap time
best <- cand[, .SD[1], by = run_row] #choose the row with the lowest gap

best[, location_match_type := fcase( #describe the way the decision was made based on the gap
  inside,                           "within_interval",
  gap_abs_s <= max_gap_mins * 60,   "nearest_within_tolerance",
  default =                         "unmatched")]
best[location_match_type == "unmatched",
     c("location_category", "hospital_id", "hospital_type", "prior_location_category",
       "prior_hospital_id", "prior_row_mins") := NA] #If nothing matches with the candidates then leave it NA
best[, mins_since_arrival := fifelse(inside, (begin_s - in_s) / 60, NA_real_)] #If within an interval - how long within that interval did the intubation take place?

#)2 Attach to baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs
old_cols <- intersect(c("location_of_intubation", "hospital_id", "hospital_type", "location_match_type",
                        "location_gap_mins", "location_n_overlap", "location_mins_since_arrival",
                        "prior_location_category", "prior_hospital_id", "prior_location_row_mins",
                        "arrived_intubated_likely", "location_of_intubation_adj", "location_confidence",
                        "intubation_site", "intubated_in_procedural", "intubation_site_uncertain"),
                      names(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs))
if (length(old_cols)) baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, (old_cols) := NULL] #Remove any columns from previous run

baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, run_row := .I] #Row number same as above for matching
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[best, on = "run_row", `:=`(
  location_of_intubation      = i.location_category,
  hospital_id                 = i.hospital_id,
  hospital_type               = i.hospital_type,
  location_match_type         = i.location_match_type,
  location_gap_mins           = i.gap_signed_s / 60,
  location_n_overlap          = i.n_overlap,
  location_mins_since_arrival = i.mins_since_arrival,
  prior_location_category     = i.prior_location_category,
  prior_hospital_id           = i.prior_hospital_id,
  prior_location_row_mins     = i.prior_row_mins
)] #Join over the new columns to the old baseline data table
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[is.na(location_match_type), location_match_type := "no_adt_rows_or_missing_begin_obs"] #If there isn't a match type - use this
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, run_row := NULL] #Drop run_row

#) 3 Adjusted location: likely arrived already intubated
# begin_obs is the earliest documented evidence of IMV. A patient intubated in the OR/ED and then moved
# has their first vent charting minutes after arriving in the next location, so the matched location
# (usually ICU) is where intubation was DOCUMENTED, not where it happened. If the run begins shortly
# after arrival from a procedural area or the ED, label the PRIOR location instead.
  # Define arrived_intubated_likely based on 30 minute arrive_mins
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, arrived_intubated_likely := fcoalesce(
  location_match_type == "within_interval" & #Must have an interval
  location_mins_since_arrival <= arrive_mins & #Must be within 30*** mins
  prior_location_category %in% reassign_from & #Must have been in OR or ED
  prior_location_category != location_of_intubation &
  (is.na(prior_hospital_id) | is.na(hospital_id) | prior_hospital_id == hospital_id) &   #no cross-hospital reassignment
  (is.na(prior_location_row_mins) | prior_location_row_mins >= min_prior_row_mins) &
  (!use_src | begin_imv_source %in% c("resp", "drip")),                                  #RSI source = charted intubation
  FALSE)]
# If flagged then use the previous location as the site of intubation
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, location_of_intubation_adj := fifelse(
  arrived_intubated_likely, prior_location_category, location_of_intubation)]
# Label the confidence of this data for auditing purposes
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, location_confidence := fcase(
  location_match_type %in% c("unmatched", "no_adt_rows_or_missing_begin_obs"),     "unmatched",
  location_match_type == "nearest_within_tolerance",                               "nearest_row_not_contained",
  arrived_intubated_likely,                                                        "inferred_from_prior_location",
  location_mins_since_arrival <= arrive_mins & !is.na(prior_location_category) &
    prior_location_category != location_of_intubation,                             "ambiguous_recent_arrival",
  location_mins_since_arrival <= arrive_mins & is.na(prior_location_category),     "ambiguous_first_adt_row",
  default =                                                                        "direct")]

#)4 Model-ready baseline features
# Collapsed site (rare categories folded together) and a binary OR/procedural flag built on the ADJUSTED location
# "procedural" is a CLIF location_category and includes OR, cath lab, IR, endoscopy, etc.
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, intubation_site := fcase(
  is.na(location_of_intubation_adj),                         "unknown",
  location_of_intubation_adj == "procedural",                "or_procedural",
  location_of_intubation_adj == "icu",                       "icu",
  location_of_intubation_adj == "ed",                        "ed",
  location_of_intubation_adj %in% c("ward", "stepdown"),     "ward",
  default =                                                  "other")]
# Keep a documented in OR variable for later
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, intubated_in_procedural := as.integer(intubation_site == "or_procedural")]

# Track uncertainty for sensitivity analyses later on, 1=weakly supported
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, intubation_site_uncertain := as.integer(location_confidence %in%
  c("unmatched", "nearest_row_not_contained", "ambiguous_recent_arrival", "ambiguous_first_adt_row"))]

#5) Audits and saved files
n_runs <- nrow(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs)

loc_audit_summary <- rbindlist(list(
  data.table(metric = "adt_rows",                                         n = n_adt_rows),
  data.table(metric = "adt_rows_missing_out_dttm (open until next row)",  n = n_out_na),
  data.table(metric = "adt_rows_out_before_in (dropped)",                 n = n_inverted),
  baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, .(n = .N), by = .(metric = paste0("runs_match_", location_match_type))],
  baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, .(n = .N), by = .(metric = paste0("runs_confidence_", location_confidence))],
  data.table(metric = "runs_with_overlapping_adt_rows",                   n = baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[location_n_overlap > 1, .N]),
  data.table(metric = "runs_reassigned_to_prior_location",                n = baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[arrived_intubated_likely == TRUE, .N]),
  data.table(metric = "runs_intubated_in_procedural (adjusted)",          n = baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[intubated_in_procedural == 1L, .N]),
  data.table(metric = "runs_site_uncertain",                              n = baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[intubation_site_uncertain == 1L, .N])
), use.names = TRUE)
loc_audit_summary[grepl("^runs_", metric), pct := round(100 * n / n_runs, 2)]
loc_audit_summary

# Documented vs adjusted location
loc_adjustment_crosstab <- baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, .N, by = .(location_of_intubation, location_of_intubation_adj)][order(-N)]
loc_adjustment_crosstab
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, .N, by = intubation_site][order(-N)]

# Hospitals
loc_by_hospital <- baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, .N, by = .(hospital_id, hospital_type)][order(-N)]
loc_by_hospital

#Additional analyses for possible site-based issues - not saved in audit
# Non-contained matches: how far off were they (negative = match time before the row started)?
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[location_match_type %in% c("nearest_within_tolerance", "unmatched"),
  quantile(location_gap_mins, c(0, .05, .25, .5, .75, .95, 1), na.rm = TRUE)]

# Is the arrival pile-up real? Minutes from arrival to run start, for ICU matches arriving from a procedural area
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[location_match_type == "within_interval" & location_of_intubation == "icu" &
                                  prior_location_category == "procedural",
  .N, by = .(mins_bin = cut(location_mins_since_arrival, c(-Inf, 5, 10, 30, 60, 180, 720, Inf)))][order(mins_bin)]

# Do reassigned runs rest on very short prior rows (transit rather than a real stay)?
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[arrived_intubated_likely == TRUE,
  .(n = .N, prior_row_lt_5min = round(100 * mean(prior_location_row_mins < 5, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    median_prior_row_mins = median(prior_location_row_mins, na.rm = TRUE))]

# Does location_type distinguish OR from other procedural rooms at your site? (see note below)
adt[tolower(location_category) == "procedural", .N, by = location_type][order(-N)]

dir.create(audit_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
fwrite(loc_audit_summary,      file.path(audit_dir, paste0("location_audit_summary_",    stamp, institution, ".csv")))
fwrite(loc_adjustment_crosstab, file.path(audit_dir, paste0("location_audit_adjustment_", stamp, institution, ".csv")))
fwrite(loc_by_hospital,        file.path(audit_dir, paste0("location_audit_by_hospital_", stamp, institution, ".csv")))

baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, .N, by = .(location_match_type, location_confidence, intubation_site)][
  order(location_match_type, -N)]

}

```


# PART SIX: Inclusion/Exclusion Criteria and CONSORT
```{r}
if (!use_cohort_cache) {
# Starts from baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs (all cleaned runs, nothing excluded for missing data).
# Order: tracheostomy rules (already applied in Part Three) -> repeat episodes -> exclusion_order below.
# Every criterion is evaluated on the INDEX (first) IMV episode of each hospitalization.

#0) Parameters - definitions follow the old pipeline unless noted
min_imv_hours          <- 4     #index episode shorter than this (begin_obs -> end_obs) is excluded
icu_within_hours       <- 4     #index episode must overlap an ICU ADT row starting <= this many hours after begin_obs
icu_require_type       <- TRUE  #old pipeline only counted ICU rows with a non-blank location_type (needed for icu_imv)
rass_lookback_hours    <- 1     #a RASS up to this many hours BEFORE begin_obs counts as the first RASS (old rule)
rass_first_within_h    <- 8     #first RASS must be documented within this many hours of begin_obs
rass_window_hours      <- 48    #RASS frequency window: begin_obs to min(begin_obs + 48 h, end_obs)
rass_max_hours_per_obs <- 12    #excluded if window hours / number of RASS assessments > this (or no RASS in window)
min_age                <- 18
max_age                <- 120   #ages above this are treated as invalid (old pipeline removed them with age)
osh_admission_types    <- c("facility", "osh")
prehospital_min_mins   <- 60    #IMV documented >= this many minutes before hospital admission = arrived intubated (EMS/field)
missing_language_vals  <- c("", "unknown or na", "unknown_or_na", "unknown", "sign language", "sign_language")
svm_url  <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/acortizmd/deep_sedation_language_final/main/code/SVM_ZIPCODE_SCORES_All%20States_All%20Counties_2025-07-03.csv"
svm_file <- file.path(intermediate_dir, "SVM_ZIPCODE_SCORES_All_States_All_Counties_2025-07-03.csv")

#Order of the sequential exclusions (edit to reorder). Default reproduces the old cascade so the
#counts are comparable with the original submission.
exclusion_order <- c("ex_osh", "ex_imv_short", "ex_icu_late", "ex_rass_first", "ex_rass_freq",
                     "ex_bmi", "ex_language", "ex_demographics", "ex_age", "ex_elixhauser") #can change this later
exclusion_labels <- c(
  ex_osh          = "Intubated before arrival (outside hospital or prehospital)",
  ex_imv_short    = paste0("IMV duration < ", min_imv_hours, " h"),
  ex_icu_late     = paste0("Did not reach an ICU within ", icu_within_hours, " h of intubation"),
  ex_rass_first   = paste0("No RASS documented within ", rass_first_within_h, " h of intubation"),
  ex_rass_freq    = paste0("RASS documented less often than every ", rass_max_hours_per_obs, " h"),
  ex_bmi          = "Missing BMI (height or weight not measured)",
  ex_language     = "Missing, unknown, or non-verbal language",
  ex_demographics = "Missing demographic data (ZIP code, sex, age, race, ethnicity)",
  ex_age          = paste0("Age < ", min_age, " years"),
  ex_elixhauser   = "Missing Elixhauser data (no diagnosis codes)")
stopifnot(setequal(exclusion_order, names(exclusion_labels)))

#1) Input checks
for (tb in c("baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs", "hospitalization", "adt", "respiratory_support", "patient_assessments"))
  if (!exists(tb)) stop(tb, " is not loaded. patient_assessments needs hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm, ",
                        "assessment_category, numerical_value, categorical_value.")
if (!"zipcode_five_digit" %in% names(hospitalization))
  stop("Add zipcode_five_digit to the hospitalization select = c(...) in Part One.")
need_cols <- c("hospitalization_id", "run_id", "begin_obs", "end_obs", "run_hrs", "admission_type_category",
               "admission_dttm", "begin_imv_source",
               "age_at_admission", "sex_category", "race_category", "ethnicity_category", "language_category",
               "height_imputed", "weight_imputed", "bmi", "elixhauser_imputed")
miss_cols <- setdiff(need_cols, names(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs))
if (length(miss_cols)) stop("Missing from baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs: ", paste(miss_cols, collapse = ", "))
#Flow counts from Part Three / the run cleanup (read from disk when Parts 3-4 were skipped by the cache)
if (!exists("consort_top")) consort_top <- fread(file.path(intermediate_dir, "consort_top.csv"))
if (!exists("cohort_flow")) cohort_flow <- fread(file.path(intermediate_dir, "cohort_flow.csv"))

lc <- function(x) tolower(trimws(as.character(x)))

#2) All cleaned runs, then the index (first) episode of each hospitalization
eps <- copy(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs)
eps[hospitalization[, .(hospitalization_id, patient_id, zipcode_raw = zipcode_five_digit)], on = "hospitalization_id",
    `:=`(patient_id = i.patient_id, zipcode_raw = i.zipcode_raw)]
idx <- eps[run_id == 1L]
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(idx$hospitalization_id), nrow(idx) == uniqueN(eps$hospitalization_id))
idx[, `:=`(b_s = as.numeric(begin_obs), e_s = as.numeric(end_obs))]

#3) Outside-hospital intubation (old definition): admitted from a facility/OSH AND the first
#   documented respiratory device of the hospitalization is IMV
rs_dev <- respiratory_support[hospitalization_id %in% idx$hospitalization_id & !is.na(recorded_dttm) &
                                !is.na(device_category) & trimws(device_category) != "",
                              .(hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm, dev = lc(device_category))]
rs_dev <- rs_dev[rs_dev[, .I[recorded_dttm == min(recorded_dttm)], by = hospitalization_id]$V1]
first_device <- rs_dev[, .(first_device = if (any(dev == "imv")) "imv" else dev[1]), by = hospitalization_id] #tie at first time -> imv
idx[first_device, on = "hospitalization_id", first_device := i.first_device]
if (!"first_device" %in% names(idx)) idx[, first_device := NA_character_]
#   R&R addition - prehospital: first documented device is IMV and IMV began >= prehospital_min_mins before hospital
#   admission, unless RSI drugs were charted here (begin_imv_source "rsi" = intubated in this hospital). These arrive
#   intubated like OSH transfers but are admitted through the ED, so the admission-type rule missed them.
idx[, mins_imv_before_admission := as.numeric(difftime(admission_dttm, begin_obs, units = "mins"))]
idx[, osh_reason := fcase(
  lc(admission_type_category) %in% osh_admission_types & first_device %in% "imv",       "outside hospital (admission type)",
  first_device %in% "imv" & mins_imv_before_admission >= prehospital_min_mins &
    !begin_imv_source %in% "rsi",                                                       "prehospital (IMV before arrival)",
  default = NA_character_)]
idx[, osh_intubation := !is.na(osh_reason)]

#4a) Time to ICU: first ICU ADT row overlapping the index episode (old definition, on begin_obs/end_obs)
adt_i <- adt[hospitalization_id %in% idx$hospitalization_id & !is.na(in_dttm),
             .(hospitalization_id, adt_hospital_id = hospital_id, loc = lc(location_category),
               loc_type = fifelse(trimws(as.character(location_type)) == "", NA_character_, trimws(as.character(location_type))),
               in_s = as.numeric(in_dttm), out_s = as.numeric(out_dttm))]
setorder(adt_i, hospitalization_id, in_s)
adt_i[, next_in_s := shift(in_s, type = "lead"), by = hospitalization_id]
adt_i[is.na(out_s), out_s := fifelse(!is.na(next_in_s), next_in_s, Inf)] #missing out_dttm = open until next row
icu_rows <- adt_i[loc == "icu" & out_s >= in_s]
if (icu_require_type) icu_rows <- icu_rows[!is.na(loc_type)]
icu_hits <- icu_rows[idx, on = .(hospitalization_id, in_s < e_s, out_s > b_s), nomatch = 0L,
                     .(hospitalization_id, icu_in_s = x.in_s, icu_hospital_id = x.adt_hospital_id, icu_imv = x.loc_type)]
setorder(icu_hits, hospitalization_id, icu_in_s)
icu_first <- icu_hits[, .SD[1], by = hospitalization_id]
idx[icu_first, on = "hospitalization_id",
    `:=`(icu_in_s = i.icu_in_s, icu_hospital_id = i.icu_hospital_id, icu_imv = i.icu_imv)]
if (!"icu_in_s" %in% names(idx)) idx[, `:=`(icu_in_s = NA_real_, icu_hospital_id = NA, icu_imv = NA_character_)]
idx[, icu_admission_dttm := .POSIXct(icu_in_s, tz = time_zone)]
idx[, time_from_begin_imv_to_icu_hours := (icu_in_s - b_s) / 3600] #negative = already in the ICU at intubation
#Hospital-ICU identifier for the random effect and the later Spanish-speaking-ICU step (NA if either part is missing)
idx[, hospital_icu_id := fifelse(!is.na(icu_hospital_id) & !is.na(icu_imv),
                                 paste(icu_hospital_id, icu_imv, sep = "_"), NA_character_)]

#4b) Procedural stay
proc_gap_mins   <- 60   #procedural ADT rows separated by <= this many minutes (no other location in between) = one stay
proc_match_mins <- 90   #a stay that ENDED up to this many minutes before begin_obs still counts (first vent charting
                        #after arrival in the next unit - Part Four's arrived-intubated rule uses 30 min after arrival)

proc_ids <- idx[lc(location_of_intubation_adj) == "procedural", hospitalization_id]
pr <- adt_i[hospitalization_id %in% proc_ids]           #all ADT rows (any location) of these hospitalizations
setorder(pr, hospitalization_id, in_s)
pr[, is_proc := loc %in% "procedural"]
pr[, `:=`(prev_proc = shift(is_proc, fill = FALSE), prev_out = shift(out_s),
          next_loc  = shift(loc, type = "lead"), next_type = shift(loc_type, type = "lead"),
          next_in   = shift(in_s, type = "lead")), by = hospitalization_id]
#A new stay starts at a procedural row unless the row before it was procedural AND ended within proc_gap_mins
pr[, new_stay := is_proc & !(prev_proc & !is.na(prev_out) & (in_s - prev_out) <= proc_gap_mins * 60)]
pr[, stay_id := cumsum(new_stay), by = hospitalization_id]
stays <- pr[is_proc == TRUE, .(stay_in = min(in_s), stay_out = max(out_s),
                               post_loc = next_loc[which.max(out_s)], post_type = next_type[which.max(out_s)],
                               post_in  = next_in[which.max(out_s)]),
            by = .(hospitalization_id, stay_id)]
stays[!is.finite(stay_out), stay_out := NA_real_]      #open last row (missing out_dttm and no later row)

#Match each procedural intubation to its stay: begin_obs inside the stay, or the stay ended shortly before begin_obs.
#If more than one qualifies, take the latest.
pq <- idx[hospitalization_id %in% proc_ids, .(hospitalization_id, b_s, lo_s = b_s - proc_match_mins * 60, icu_in_s)]
mt <- stays[!is.na(stay_out)][pq, on = .(hospitalization_id, stay_in <= b_s, stay_out >= lo_s), nomatch = 0L,
            .(hospitalization_id, stay_id = x.stay_id, stay_in = x.stay_in, stay_out = x.stay_out,
              post_loc = x.post_loc, post_type = x.post_type, icu_in_s = i.icu_in_s)]
setorder(mt, hospitalization_id, -stay_in)
mt <- mt[, .SD[1], by = hospitalization_id]

#Pre-ICU procedural time: all procedural time from the start of the matched stay up to the first ICU arrival
#(normally = the stay itself; larger if the patient went OR -> PACU/ward -> OR again before the ICU)
ov <- pr[is_proc == TRUE, .(hospitalization_id, in_s, out_s)][mt, on = "hospitalization_id", allow.cartesian = TRUE,
        .(hospitalization_id, in_s, out_s, stay_in = i.stay_in, icu_in_s = i.icu_in_s)]
pre_icu <- ov[!is.na(icu_in_s), .(pre_icu_procedural_hours =
                sum(pmax(0, pmin(out_s, icu_in_s) - pmax(in_s, stay_in)), na.rm = TRUE) / 3600), by = hospitalization_id]
mt[pre_icu, on = "hospitalization_id", pre_icu_procedural_hours := i.pre_icu_procedural_hours]
if (!"pre_icu_procedural_hours" %in% names(mt)) mt[, pre_icu_procedural_hours := NA_real_]

new_proc_cols <- c("procedural_stay_found", "procedural_in_dttm", "procedural_out_dttm", "procedural_stay_hours",
                   "pre_icu_procedural_hours", "procedure_end_to_icu_hours", "post_procedure_location", "post_procedure_icu_type")
if (any(new_proc_cols %in% names(idx))) idx[, intersect(new_proc_cols, names(idx)) := NULL]   #lets the chunk be re-run
idx[mt, on = "hospitalization_id", `:=`(
  procedural_in_dttm         = .POSIXct(i.stay_in,  tz = time_zone),
  procedural_out_dttm        = .POSIXct(i.stay_out, tz = time_zone),
  procedural_stay_hours      = (i.stay_out - i.stay_in) / 3600,
  pre_icu_procedural_hours   = i.pre_icu_procedural_hours,                   #NA if the patient never reached an ICU
  procedure_end_to_icu_hours = (i.icu_in_s - i.stay_out) / 3600,            #e.g. PACU time; <= 0 = straight to ICU
  post_procedure_location    = i.post_loc,                                   #location category of the next ADT row
  post_procedure_icu_type    = fifelse(i.post_loc %in% "icu", i.post_type, NA_character_))]
idx[, procedural_stay_found := fifelse(hospitalization_id %in% proc_ids, hospitalization_id %in% mt$hospitalization_id, NA)]

#Audit (counts are local; nothing here is uploaded)
print(idx[hospitalization_id %in% proc_ids, .(
  n_procedural_intubations = .N,
  n_stay_found             = sum(procedural_stay_found),
  median_stay_hours        = median(procedural_stay_hours, na.rm = TRUE),
  n_pre_icu_proc_ge_4h     = sum(pre_icu_procedural_hours >= 4, na.rm = TRUE),
  n_post_procedure_icu     = sum(post_procedure_location %in% "icu"))])
print(idx[hospitalization_id %in% proc_ids, .N, by = .(post_procedure_location, post_procedure_icu_type)][order(-N)])
rm(pr, stays, pq, mt, ov, pre_icu)

#5) RASS: parse (same parser as the old pipeline), keep valid values -5..+4, one row per assessment time
ra <- patient_assessments[hospitalization_id %in% idx$hospitalization_id & !is.na(recorded_dttm) &
                            lc(assessment_category) == "rass",
                          .(hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm, numerical_value,
                            txt = trimws(as.character(categorical_value)))]
ra[, rass_value := suppressWarnings(fcase(
  !is.na(numerical_value),                              as.integer(numerical_value),
  grepl("^\\+?(-?5|-?4|-?3|-?2|-?1|0|1|2|3|4)$", txt),  as.integer(sub("^\\+", "", txt)),
  grepl("^\\(\\+?-?[0-5]\\)", txt),                     as.integer(sub("^\\(\\+?(-?[0-5])\\).*$", "\\1", txt)),
  default = NA_integer_))]
rass_parse_audit <- ra[, .N, by = .(status = fcase(is.na(rass_value), "unparsed",
                                                  rass_value < -5L | rass_value > 4L, "out_of_range",
                                                  default = "valid"))]
print(rass_parse_audit)
ra <- unique(ra[!is.na(rass_value) & rass_value >= -5L & rass_value <= 4L,
                .(hospitalization_id, r_s = as.numeric(recorded_dttm))])

ep_r <- idx[, .(hospitalization_id, b_s, lo_s = b_s - rass_lookback_hours * 3600,
                w_end_s = pmin(b_s + rass_window_hours * 3600, e_s))]
#5a) Time to first RASS: earliest RASS at or after begin_obs - 1 h; values before begin_obs count as 0 h
first_rass <- ra[ep_r, on = .(hospitalization_id, r_s >= lo_s), nomatch = 0L,
                 .(hospitalization_id, r_s = x.r_s, b_s = i.b_s)][
  , if (.N > 0L) .(time_to_first_rass = max(0, (min(r_s) - b_s[1]) / 3600)), by = hospitalization_id]
if (nrow(first_rass)) idx[first_rass, on = "hospitalization_id", time_to_first_rass := i.time_to_first_rass]
if (!"time_to_first_rass" %in% names(idx)) idx[, time_to_first_rass := NA_real_]
#5b) RASS frequency within the 48 h window (old: observation hours / number of RASS)
rass_win <- ra[ep_r, on = .(hospitalization_id, r_s >= b_s, r_s <= w_end_s), nomatch = 0L,
               .(hospitalization_id, r_s = x.r_s, w_end_s = i.w_end_s)][
  , if (.N > 0L) .(rass_count = .N, rass_observed_hours = (w_end_s[1] - min(r_s)) / 3600), by = hospitalization_id]
if (nrow(rass_win)) idx[rass_win, on = "hospitalization_id", `:=`(rass_count = i.rass_count, rass_observed_hours = i.rass_observed_hours)]
if (!"rass_count" %in% names(idx)) idx[, `:=`(rass_count = NA_integer_, rass_observed_hours = NA_real_)]
idx[is.na(rass_count), rass_count := 0L]
idx[, rass_window_hours_obs := (pmin(b_s + rass_window_hours * 3600, e_s) - b_s) / 3600]
idx[, rass_frequency_hrs := fifelse(rass_count > 0L, rass_window_hours_obs / rass_count, NA_real_)]

#5c) RASS count limited to hours 4-48 (the outcome window), for the RASS documentation table (7d)
rass_win_out <- ra[ep_r, on = .(hospitalization_id, r_s >= b_s, r_s <= w_end_s), nomatch = 0L,
                   .(hospitalization_id, r_s = x.r_s, b_s = i.b_s)][
  r_s >= b_s + 4 * 3600, .(rass_count_4_48 = .N), by = hospitalization_id]
if (nrow(rass_win_out)) idx[rass_win_out, on = "hospitalization_id", rass_count_4_48 := i.rass_count_4_48]
if (!"rass_count_4_48" %in% names(idx)) idx[, rass_count_4_48 := NA_integer_]
idx[is.na(rass_count_4_48), rass_count_4_48 := 0L]

#6) ZIP code -> SVM score (old: missing SVM = missing ZIP). ZIP+4 and lost leading zeros are repaired.
pad0 <- function(x, w) { n <- nchar(x); i <- !is.na(x) & n < w; x[i] <- paste0(strrep("0", w - n[i]), x[i]); x }
norm_zip5 <- function(z) {
  d <- gsub("[^0-9]", "", as.character(z))
  i9 <- !is.na(d) & nchar(d) %in% 6:9                 #ZIP+4 (dash stripped / leading zero lost)
  d[i9] <- substr(pad0(d[i9], 9), 1, 5)
  i5 <- !is.na(d) & nchar(d) %in% 3:4                 #5-digit ZIP stored as a number (e.g., 1001 -> 01001)
  d[i5] <- pad0(d[i5], 5)
  fifelse(!is.na(d) & nchar(d) == 5L & d != "00000", d, NA_character_)
}
if (!file.exists(svm_file)) download.file(svm_url, destfile = svm_file, mode = "wb")
svm <- fread(svm_file, select = c(ZIPCODE = "character", SVM_SCORE = "numeric"))
svm[, zip5 := norm_zip5(ZIPCODE)]
svm <- svm[!is.na(zip5) & !is.na(SVM_SCORE)]
if (anyDuplicated(svm$zip5)) {
  warning("Duplicate ZIP codes in the SVM file - averaging their scores")
  svm <- svm[, .(SVM_SCORE = mean(SVM_SCORE)), by = zip5]
}
idx[, zip5 := norm_zip5(zipcode_raw)]
idx[svm, on = "zip5", SVM_SCORE := i.SVM_SCORE]
if (!"SVM_SCORE" %in% names(idx)) idx[, SVM_SCORE := NA_real_]

#7) Exclusion flags (one per criterion, never NA) and the reason within the combined boxes
idx[, demographic_missing_reason := fcase(       #first missing item, in the old cascade order
  is.na(ethnicity_category) | trimws(ethnicity_category) == "", "ethnicity missing",
  is.na(race_category)      | trimws(race_category) == "",      "race missing",
  is.na(zip5),                                                  "ZIP code missing or invalid",
  is.na(SVM_SCORE),                                             "ZIP code not in SVM file",
  is.na(sex_category) | lc(sex_category) %in% c("", "unknown"), "sex missing or unknown",
  is.na(age_at_admission) | age_at_admission > max_age,         "age missing or implausible",
  default = NA_character_)]
idx[, rass_freq_reason := fcase(
  rass_count == 0L,                             "no RASS in the frequency window",
  rass_observed_hours %in% 0,                   "zero observed RASS time (old step 5b)",
  rass_frequency_hrs > rass_max_hours_per_obs,  "average interval above threshold",
  default = NA_character_)]
idx[, `:=`(
  ex_osh          = osh_intubation,
  ex_imv_short    = run_hrs < min_imv_hours,
  ex_icu_late     = is.na(time_from_begin_imv_to_icu_hours) | time_from_begin_imv_to_icu_hours > icu_within_hours,
  ex_rass_first   = is.na(time_to_first_rass) | time_to_first_rass > rass_first_within_h,
  ex_rass_freq    = !is.na(rass_freq_reason),
  ex_bmi          = !(height_imputed %in% FALSE & weight_imputed %in% FALSE) | is.na(bmi), #imputed = not measured
  ex_language     = is.na(language_category) | lc(language_category) %in% missing_language_vals,
  ex_demographics = !is.na(demographic_missing_reason),
  ex_age          = !is.na(age_at_admission) & age_at_admission < min_age,
  ex_elixhauser   = !(elixhauser_imputed %in% FALSE))]                                   #imputed = no diagnosis codes
stopifnot(idx[, !anyNA(unlist(.SD)), .SDcols = exclusion_order])
idx[, n_exclusion_flags := rowSums(.SD), .SDcols = exclusion_order]

#8) CONSORT flow table (counts remaining after each step; *_removed = removed at that step)
flow <- list()
add_flow <- function(type, step, episodes, hospitalizations, patients = NA_real_,
                     episodes_removed = NA_real_, hospitalizations_removed = NA_real_)
  flow[[length(flow) + 1L]] <<- data.table(type, step, episodes = as.numeric(episodes),
                                           hospitalizations = as.numeric(hospitalizations), patients = as.numeric(patients),
                                           episodes_removed = as.numeric(episodes_removed),
                                           hospitalizations_removed = as.numeric(hospitalizations_removed))
add_reasons <- function(rs) for (j in seq_len(nrow(rs)))   #rs: data.table(reason, N)
  add_flow("  reason", paste0("    ", rs$reason[j]), NA, NA, episodes_removed = rs$N[j], hospitalizations_removed = rs$N[j])
for (i in seq_len(nrow(consort_top))) {
  ct <- consort_top[i]
  is_c1 <- ct$box == "C1"
  add_flow(if (ct$box == "info") "info" else "count", paste0(ct$box, ". ", ct$step),
           ct$episodes, ct$hospitalizations, ct$patients,
           episodes_removed         = if (is_c1) consort_top[box == "C", episodes] - ct$episodes else NA_real_,
           hospitalizations_removed = if (is_c1) consort_top[box == "C", hospitalizations] - ct$hospitalizations else NA_real_)
}

#Tracheostomy (Part Three rules 2-5b) as ONE exclusion box with the individual rules underneath
cf <- copy(cohort_flow)[, rule := sub(" .*", "", step)]
tr0 <- cf[rule == "0"]; tr_end <- cf[rule == "5b"]
if (tr0$runs != consort_top[box == "C1", episodes])
  warning("cohort_flow does not start from the Part Three episode count - is the baseline cache stale?")
```
