```{r}
cleanup_end <- cf[.N] #last cleanup row (after merging / minimum run length)
add_flow("exclusion", "Tracheostomy at or before the start of IMV (trach rules 2-5b)",
         tr_end$runs, tr_end$hospitalizations,
         patients = if (tr_end$hospitalizations == uniqueN(eps$hospitalization_id)) uniqueN(eps$patient_id) else NA_real_,
         episodes_removed = tr0$runs - tr_end$runs, hospitalizations_removed = tr0$hospitalizations - tr_end$hospitalizations)
for (r in c("2", "3", "4", "5a", "5b")) {
  k <- which(cf$rule == r)
  add_flow("  reason", paste0("    ", cf$step[k]), NA, NA,
           episodes_removed = cf$runs[k - 1L] - cf$runs[k],
           hospitalizations_removed = cf$hospitalizations[k - 1L] - cf$hospitalizations[k])
}
add_flow("info", "Episodes after merging overlapping runs / minimum run length (no exclusions)",
         nrow(eps), uniqueN(eps$hospitalization_id), uniqueN(eps$patient_id),
         episodes_removed = tr_end$runs - nrow(eps),
         hospitalizations_removed = tr_end$hospitalizations - uniqueN(eps$hospitalization_id))
stopifnot(nrow(eps) == cleanup_end$runs)

#Repeat IMV episodes: keep the first episode per hospitalization
add_flow("exclusion", "Repeat IMV episodes (run_id >= 2)", nrow(idx), uniqueN(idx$hospitalization_id),
         uniqueN(idx$patient_id), episodes_removed = nrow(eps) - nrow(idx), hospitalizations_removed = 0)

#Sequential exclusions on the index episode
cascade <- copy(idx)
cascade[, excluded_at := NA_character_]
for (f in exclusion_order) {
  drop <- cascade[get(f) == TRUE & is.na(excluded_at)]
  cascade[get(f) == TRUE & is.na(excluded_at), excluded_at := exclusion_labels[[f]]]
  remaining <- cascade[is.na(excluded_at)]
  add_flow("exclusion", exclusion_labels[[f]], nrow(remaining), nrow(remaining), uniqueN(remaining$patient_id),
           episodes_removed = nrow(drop), hospitalizations_removed = nrow(drop))
  if (f == "ex_osh")          add_reasons(drop[, .N, by = .(reason = osh_reason)][order(-N)])
  if (f == "ex_demographics") add_reasons(drop[, .N, by = .(reason = demographic_missing_reason)][order(-N)])
  if (f == "ex_rass_freq")    add_reasons(drop[, .N, by = .(reason = rass_freq_reason)][order(-N)])
}
cohort_final <- cascade[is.na(excluded_at)]
add_flow("count", "Final cohort (index IMV episodes)", nrow(cohort_final), nrow(cohort_final), uniqueN(cohort_final$patient_id))
consort_flow <- rbindlist(flow)
print(consort_flow)

#9a) Non-sequential view: how many index episodes meet each criterion at all, and how many meet ONLY that one
#   (denominator = index episodes after the trach and repeat-episode steps). Useful for reviewers.
exclusion_overlap <- rbindlist(lapply(exclusion_order, function(f) data.table(
  criterion             = exclusion_labels[[f]],
  n_meeting_criterion   = idx[get(f) == TRUE, .N],
  n_only_this_criterion = idx[get(f) == TRUE & n_exclusion_flags == 1L, .N],
  denominator           = nrow(idx))))
exclusion_overlap[, pct_meeting := round(100 * n_meeting_criterion / denominator, 2)]
print(exclusion_overlap)

#9b) 
#Language group of every index episode. Language is itself an exclusion (ex_language), so a
#missing/unknown group is kept rather than dropped.
idx[, lang_group_excl := "other"] # create new column where default is other
idx[lc(language_category) == "english", lang_group_excl := "english"] #overwrite column for english
idx[lc(language_category) == "spanish", lang_group_excl := "spanish"] #overwrite column for spanish
idx[ex_language == TRUE, lang_group_excl := "missing_or_unknown"] #ID the missing or unknown ppl
cascade[idx, on = "hospitalization_id", lang_group_excl := i.lang_group_excl] #copy the new idx column into the table cascade by hospitalization_id

#met_any   = meets the criterion regardless of order (answers "what % met this criterion")
#excl_step = removed at this step of the CONSORT cascade (answers "% of all exclusions")
#only_this = meets this criterion and no other (= the patients a sensitivity analysis could add back)
idx_l <- rbind(idx, copy(idx)[, lang_group_excl := "all"])               #create a double table where "all" row = whole site
cas_l <- rbind(cascade, copy(cascade)[, lang_group_excl := "all"])      #bind the tables
exclusion_by_language <- rbindlist(lapply(exclusion_order, function(f) {
  m <- idx_l[, .(n_index = .N, n_met_any = sum(get(f)), n_only_this = sum(get(f) & n_exclusion_flags == 1L)),
             by = lang_group_excl] #by language group count the number of index episodes in each group
  s <- cas_l[, .(n_excl_step = sum(excluded_at %in% exclusion_labels[[f]]), n_excluded_total = sum(!is.na(excluded_at))),
             by = lang_group_excl] #count from the cascade instead
  merge(m, s, by = "lang_group_excl")[, criterion := exclusion_labels[[f]]][] #put the two count tables together
})) #count the exclusion criteria by language to look for any differentials
exclusion_by_language[, `:=`(
  pct_met_any         = round(100 * n_met_any / n_index, 2), #pct of all patients who were outside of the ICU
  pct_only_this       = round(100 * n_only_this / n_index, 2), #percent that only were excluded for this
  pct_of_all_excluded = round(100 * n_excl_step / n_excluded_total, 2))]   #letter R4.11: "% of the total excluded"
#Small-cell rule: hide counts 1-9 and the percentages built on them
censor_pairs <- list(n_index = c("pct_met_any", "pct_only_this"), n_met_any = "pct_met_any",
                     n_only_this = "pct_only_this", n_excl_step = "pct_of_all_excluded",
                     n_excluded_total = "pct_of_all_excluded") #hide small cells
for (col in names(censor_pairs))
  exclusion_by_language[get(col) > 0 & get(col) < 10, c(col, censor_pairs[[col]]) := NA]
rm(idx_l, cas_l) #drop tables we don't need
exclusion_by_language[, site := institution] #add institution to the table
setcolorder(exclusion_by_language, c("site", "criterion", "lang_group_excl")) #put them in order
print(exclusion_by_language[criterion %in% exclusion_labels[c("ex_icu_late", "ex_rass_first")] & lang_group_excl %in% c("all", "english", "spanish")]) #print results
fwrite(exclusion_by_language, file.path(audit_dir, paste0("exclusion_by_language_", stamp, institution, ".csv"))) #save the results

#R4.7 sensitivity: keep patients excluded ONLY for "> 4 h outside the ICU" and flag them.
#They go through Parts 7-12 like everyone else; 01_analysis_rr removes them from every analysis
#except the R4.7 sensitivity (9j). Patients who never reached an ICU have no ICU id and drop out
#of the ICU-fixed-effect model there automatically.
cohort_final[, sens_only_icu_late := FALSE] #add column for later exclusion
cohort_icu_late <- cascade[ex_icu_late == TRUE & n_exclusion_flags == 1L & !is.na(icu_in_s)][, sens_only_icu_late := TRUE] #ID those excluded only for not reaching ICU in time
message(nrow(cohort_icu_late), " index episodes excluded only for the ICU-timing criterion carried forward for the R4.7 sensitivity analysis")
cohort_final <- rbind(cohort_final, cohort_icu_late[, names(cohort_final), with = FALSE]) #Recreate cohort_final with these patients included
#(the CONSORT "Final cohort" row was written above, before this append, so it is unchanged)

#10) Tidy and save
cohort_final[, c("b_s", "e_s", "icu_in_s", "excluded_at") := NULL]
fwrite(consort_flow,      file.path(audit_dir, paste0("consort_flow_",      stamp, institution, ".csv")))
fwrite(exclusion_overlap, file.path(audit_dir, paste0("exclusion_overlap_", stamp, institution, ".csv")))
fwrite(rass_parse_audit,  file.path(audit_dir, paste0("rass_parse_audit_",  stamp, institution, ".csv")))
#Row-level (local only): first exclusion reason per index episode, for spot checks
fwrite(cascade[, .(hospitalization_id, patient_id, excluded_at, demographic_missing_reason, rass_freq_reason)],
       file.path(intermediate_dir, paste0("exclusion_detail_", stamp, institution, ".csv")))
arrow::write_parquet(cohort_final, file.path(intermediate_dir, paste0("cohort_final_", stamp, institution, ".parquet")))
}
```


# PART SEVEN: RASS Calculations
```{r}
if (!use_cohort_cache) {
# Same definitions as the old RASS section, applied to the index IMV episode:
#   window      = begin_obs to min(begin_obs + 48 h, end_obs)           (old: begin_imv / end_imv)
#   each RASS value lasts until the next one; the last lasts until the window end
#   deep sedation (weighted)   = time-weighted mean RASS <= -3
#   deep sedation (unweighted) = simple mean RASS  <  -3   (strict "<" kept from the old code)
#   deep sedation (median)     = median RASS <= -3
#   sedation index = sum of negative RASS (as a positive number) / number of RASS; tertiles use the old fixed cut points
# RASS values are parsed exactly as in Part Five (valid -5..+4), one value per assessment time, so
# rass_count / rass_frequency_hrs / time_to_first_rass from Part Five describe the same rows.
# Run after Part Five and before Part Six (Part Six copies these columns into cohort_final_outcomes).

deep_rass_cutoff    <- -3
sedation_index_cuts <- c(1.56, 3.25, 5.00)   #fixed tertile cut points from the original cohort

parse_rass <- function(num, txt) suppressWarnings(fcase(
  !is.na(num),                                          as.integer(num),
  grepl("^\\+?(-?5|-?4|-?3|-?2|-?1|0|1|2|3|4)$", txt),  as.integer(sub("^\\+", "", txt)),
  grepl("^\\(\\+?-?[0-5]\\)", txt),                     as.integer(sub("^\\(\\+?(-?[0-5])\\).*$", "\\1", txt)),
  default = NA_integer_))

#dt: one row per hospitalization with begin_obs and end_obs (cohort_final, or a sensitivity group from `cascade`)
compute_rass_exposure <- function(dt) {
  r <- patient_assessments[hospitalization_id %in% dt$hospitalization_id & !is.na(recorded_dttm) &
                             tolower(trimws(assessment_category)) == "rass",
                           .(hospitalization_id, r_s = as.numeric(recorded_dttm),
                             rass_value = parse_rass(numerical_value, trimws(as.character(categorical_value))))]
  r <- r[!is.na(rass_value) & rass_value >= -5L & rass_value <= 4L]
  #One value per assessment time (old code kept duplicate rows; conflicting values at one time are averaged)
  n_conflict <- r[, uniqueN(rass_value), by = .(hospitalization_id, r_s)][V1 > 1L, .N]
  if (n_conflict > 0) message(n_conflict, " RASS timestamps had conflicting values - averaged")
  r <- r[, .(rass_value = mean(rass_value)), by = .(hospitalization_id, r_s)]

  win <- dt[, .(hospitalization_id, b_s = as.numeric(begin_obs),
                w_end_s = pmin(as.numeric(begin_obs) + rass_window_hours * 3600, as.numeric(end_obs)))]
  tl <- r[win, on = .(hospitalization_id, r_s >= b_s, r_s <= w_end_s), nomatch = 0L,
          .(hospitalization_id, r_s = x.r_s, rass_value = x.rass_value, w_end_s = i.w_end_s)]
  setorder(tl, hospitalization_id, r_s)
  tl[, dur_h := (fcoalesce(shift(r_s, type = "lead"), w_end_s) - r_s) / 3600, by = hospitalization_id]

  ex <- tl[, .(rass_count_window        = .N,
               total_observed_time      = sum(dur_h),
               rass_weighted_avg        = if (sum(dur_h) > 0) sum(rass_value * dur_h) / sum(dur_h) else NA_real_,
               rass_unweighted_avg      = mean(rass_value),
               median_rass_cont         = median(rass_value),
               rass_cumulative          = sum(rass_value),
               rass_cumulative_neg      = -sum(pmin(rass_value, 0)),
               rass_below_minus_3_count = sum(rass_value <= deep_rass_cutoff)),
           by = hospitalization_id]
  ex[, `:=`(deep_sedation_weighted   = rass_weighted_avg   <= deep_rass_cutoff,
            deep_sedation_unweighted = rass_unweighted_avg <=  deep_rass_cutoff,
            median_rass_binary       = median_rass_cont    <= deep_rass_cutoff,
            sedation_index_score     = rass_cumulative_neg / rass_count_window)]
  ex[, sedation_index_tertiles := fcase(
    sedation_index_score >= 0 & sedation_index_score <= sedation_index_cuts[1], 1,
    sedation_index_score >  sedation_index_cuts[1] & sedation_index_score <= sedation_index_cuts[2], 2,
    sedation_index_score >  sedation_index_cuts[2] & sedation_index_score <= sedation_index_cuts[3], 3,
    default = NA_real_)]
  ex[]
}

rass_exposure <- compute_rass_exposure(cohort_final)
exp_cols <- setdiff(names(rass_exposure), "hospitalization_id")
cohort_final[rass_exposure, on = "hospitalization_id", (exp_cols) := mget(paste0("i.", exp_cols))]

#Checks: every cohort member has RASS in the window (guaranteed by the RASS-frequency exclusion), and the
#count agrees with Part Five's rass_count (same parsing, same window, one value per time)
stopifnot(cohort_final[is.na(rass_weighted_avg), .N] == 0)
if (cohort_final[rass_count_window != rass_count, .N] > 0)
  warning(cohort_final[rass_count_window != rass_count, .N], " hospitalizations: exposure RASS count differs from Part Five rass_count")
print(cohort_final[, .(n = .N,
                       pct_deep_weighted   = round(100 * mean(deep_sedation_weighted), 1),
                       pct_deep_unweighted = round(100 * mean(deep_sedation_unweighted), 1),
                       pct_deep_median     = round(100 * mean(median_rass_binary), 1),
                       median_weighted_rass = median(rass_weighted_avg))])
print(cohort_final[, .N, by = sedation_index_tertiles][order(sedation_index_tertiles)])

################################################################################
# RASS QC (ported): raw values and whether they parsed, for every index episode at the exclusion stage
qc_src <- patient_assessments[hospitalization_id %in% idx$hospitalization_id & tolower(trimws(assessment_category)) == "rass",
                              .(numerical_value, categorical_value = trimws(as.character(categorical_value)))]
qc_src[, parsed := parse_rass(numerical_value, categorical_value)]
qc_src[, `:=`(
  source = fcase(!is.na(numerical_value), "numerical_value",
                 !is.na(categorical_value) & categorical_value != "", "categorical_value",
                 default = "both_missing"),
  raw_value = fifelse(!is.na(numerical_value), as.character(numerical_value), categorical_value))]
qc_src[, parse_status := fcase(
  source == "both_missing",                                                   "both_fields_missing",
  source == "numerical_value" & !is.na(parsed) & parsed >= -5L & parsed <= 4L, "parsed_in_range",
  source == "numerical_value",                                                "parsed_out_of_range_or_failed",
  grepl("^\\+?(-?5|-?4|-?3|-?2|-?1|0|1|2|3|4)$", categorical_value),         "regex_matched_bare",
  grepl("^\\(\\+?-?[0-5]\\)", categorical_value),                             "regex_matched_paren",
  default =                                                                   "regex_failed")]
rass_qc <- qc_src[, .N, by = .(source, raw_value, parsed_value = as.character(parsed), parse_status)]
rass_qc <- rass_qc[order(!(parse_status %in% c("regex_matched_bare", "regex_matched_paren", "parsed_in_range")), -N)]
rass_qc[, institution := institution]
rass_qc_summary <- rass_qc[, .(total_rows = sum(N), pct_of_total = round(100 * sum(N) / nrow(qc_src), 2)),
                           by = parse_status][order(-total_rows)]
print(rass_qc_summary)
qc_dir <- if (exists("cohort_characteristics")) cohort_characteristics else audit_dir
fwrite(rass_qc,         file.path(qc_dir, paste0(institution, "_rass_value_qc.csv")))
fwrite(rass_qc_summary, file.path(qc_dir, paste0(institution, "_rass_value_qc_summary.csv")))
}
```


# PART EIGHT: 28-day and 6-month outcomes (VFD, ICUFD, HFD, mortality)
```{r}
if (!use_cohort_cache) {
# Logic matches the old "Calculate HFDs, VFDs, ICUFDs" section. Changes:
#   * time zero = begin_obs of the index episode (old: begin_imv)
#   * 28-day IMV hours use the raw respiratory-support runs saved in Part Three (imv_runs_raw),
#     NOT truncated at tracheostomy - same intent as the old code
#   * discharge categories are compared in lower case
# Wrapped in a function so it can also be run on a sensitivity group, e.g.
#   compute_outcomes(cascade[hospitalization_id %in% sens_icu_late_ids])

facility_categories <- c("skilled nursing facility (snf)", "acute inpatient rehab facility",
                         "long term care hospital (ltach)", "acute care hospital",
                         "psychiatric hospital", "snf", "acute_ip_rehab", "ltach")
expired_categories  <- c("expired", "died")
hospice_categories  <- c("hospice")

if (!exists("hospital_days")) stop("hospital_days (Part Two) is not loaded")
if (!exists("imv_runs_raw"))
  imv_runs_raw <- as.data.table(arrow::read_parquet(file.path(intermediate_dir, "imv_runs_raw.parquet")))

compute_outcomes <- function(dt) {
  d <- copy(dt)
  d[, dc_cat := tolower(trimws(discharge_category))]

  #1) Death date corrections (old): expired with missing or pre-discharge death_dttm -> discharge_dttm
  d[dc_cat %in% expired_categories & (is.na(death_dttm) | death_dttm < discharge_dttm), death_dttm := discharge_dttm]

  #2) Dates (tz explicit: as.Date on POSIXct defaults to UTC)
  d[, `:=`(begin_imv_date = as.Date(begin_obs,      tz = time_zone),
           death_date     = as.Date(death_dttm,     tz = time_zone),
           discharge_date = as.Date(discharge_dttm, tz = time_zone),
           admission_date = as.Date(admission_dttm, tz = time_zone))]
  d[, death_during_admission := !is.na(death_date) & death_date >= admission_date & death_date <= discharge_date]

  #3) Total IMV hours in the 28 days from begin_obs (raw runs of this hospitalization, clamped to the window)
  w  <- d[, .(hospitalization_id, ws = begin_obs, we = begin_obs + 28 * 86400)]
  ov <- imv_runs_raw[w, on = .(hospitalization_id, end_imv > ws, begin_imv_resp < we), nomatch = 0L,
                     .(hospitalization_id,
                       hrs = (pmin(as.numeric(x.end_imv), as.numeric(i.we)) -
                              pmax(as.numeric(x.begin_imv_resp), as.numeric(i.ws))) / 3600)]
  imv_hours_28d <- ov[, .(total_imv_hours_28d = sum(hrs)), by = hospitalization_id]
  d[imv_hours_28d, on = "hospitalization_id", total_imv_hours_28d := i.total_imv_hours_28d]
  if (!"total_imv_hours_28d" %in% names(d)) d[, total_imv_hours_28d := NA_real_]
  #begin_obs can precede the first raw row (RSI/drip correction): never report fewer hours than the index episode
  d[, total_imv_hours_28d := pmax(fcoalesce(total_imv_hours_28d, 0), pmin(run_hrs, 28 * 24))]

  #4) 28-day window with death truncation; hospital/ICU/vent days from hospital_days (all of the patient's stays)
  d[, window_end_28 := begin_imv_date + 27]
  d[, eligible_end := fifelse(!is.na(death_date) & death_date <= window_end_28, death_date, window_end_28)]
  hd <- hospital_days[, .(patient_id, calendar_date, icu_day, vent_day)]
  win28 <- merge(hd, d[, .(patient_id, cohort_hospitalization_id = hospitalization_id, ws = begin_imv_date, eligible_end)],
                 by = "patient_id", allow.cartesian = TRUE)[calendar_date >= ws & calendar_date <= eligible_end]
  fd_counts <- win28[, .(hospital_days_28 = uniqueN(calendar_date),
                         icu_days_28      = uniqueN(calendar_date[icu_day  == TRUE]),
                         vent_days_28     = uniqueN(calendar_date[vent_day == TRUE])),
                     by = .(hospitalization_id = cohort_hospitalization_id)]
  d <- merge(d, fd_counts, by = "hospitalization_id", all.x = TRUE) #NA = no hospital days in window (old step 12)
  d[!is.na(run_hrs) & run_hrs > 0 & vent_days_28 %in% 0L, vent_days_28 := 1L] #every IMV episode has >= 1 vent day

  #5) Mortality / hospice / worst outcome
  d[, mortality_28day     := !is.na(death_date) & death_date <= window_end_28]
  d[, hospice_28day       := dc_cat %in% hospice_categories & !is.na(discharge_date) & discharge_date <= window_end_28]
  d[, worst_outcome_28day := mortality_28day | hospice_28day]

  #6) Ventilated on the discharge day (within the 28-day window)
  vent_dates <- unique(hospital_days[vent_day == TRUE, .(hospitalization_id, calendar_date)])[, vent_flag := TRUE]
  d[, vent_on_dc_day := FALSE]
  d[vent_dates, on = c("hospitalization_id", "discharge_date" = "calendar_date"), vent_on_dc_day := i.vent_flag]
  d[is.na(discharge_date) | discharge_date > window_end_28, vent_on_dc_day := FALSE]
  d[, los_from_imv := as.integer(discharge_date - begin_imv_date) + 1L]

  #7) Free days and disposition rules (identical to the old code)
  d[, `:=`(hospital_free_days_28 = 28L - hospital_days_28,
           icu_free_days_28      = 28L - icu_days_28,
           vent_free_days_28     = 28L - vent_days_28)]
  d[, fd_group := fcase(
    worst_outcome_28day,                                   "worst",
    vent_on_dc_day & dc_cat == "home",                     "home_vent",
    vent_on_dc_day & dc_cat %in% facility_categories,      "facility_vent",
    vent_on_dc_day,                                        "ama_other_vent",
    default =                                              "standard")]
  d[fd_group == "facility_vent", `:=`(vent_free_days_28 = 0L, icu_free_days_28 = 0L, hospital_free_days_28 = 0L)]
  d[fd_group == "home_vent",     `:=`(vent_free_days_28 = 0L, icu_free_days_28 = 28L - los_from_imv,
                                      hospital_free_days_28 = 28L - los_from_imv)]
  #ama_other_vent: no override (per Meeta, 2026-10)
  d[, `:=`(vent_free_days_28_alt = vent_free_days_28, icu_free_days_28_alt = icu_free_days_28,
           hospital_free_days_28_alt = hospital_free_days_28)]
  d[fd_group == "worst", `:=`(vent_free_days_28_alt = -1L, icu_free_days_28_alt = -1L, hospital_free_days_28_alt = -1L)]
  d[fd_group == "worst", `:=`(vent_free_days_28 = 0L, icu_free_days_28 = 0L, hospital_free_days_28 = 0L)]
  d[, vent_free_days_28_hours := fifelse(worst_outcome_28day, 0, (28 * 24 - total_imv_hours_28d) / 24)]

  #8) 6-month hospital-free days (survival-adjusted denominator)
  d[, window_end_6mo   := begin_imv_date %m+% months(6) - days(1)]
  d[, eligible_end_6mo := fifelse(!is.na(death_date) & death_date <= window_end_6mo, death_date, window_end_6mo)]
  d[, eligible_days_6mo := as.integer(eligible_end_6mo - begin_imv_date) + 1L]
  win6 <- merge(hd[, .(patient_id, calendar_date)],
                d[, .(patient_id, cohort_hospitalization_id = hospitalization_id, ws = begin_imv_date, eligible_end_6mo)],
                by = "patient_id", allow.cartesian = TRUE)[calendar_date >= ws & calendar_date <= eligible_end_6mo]
  hd6 <- win6[, .(hospital_days_6mo = uniqueN(calendar_date)), by = .(hospitalization_id = cohort_hospitalization_id)]
  d <- merge(d, hd6, by = "hospitalization_id", all.x = TRUE)
  d[is.na(hospital_days_6mo), hospital_days_6mo := 0L]
  d[, mortality_6mo     := !is.na(death_date) & death_date <= window_end_6mo]
  d[, hospice_6mo       := dc_cat %in% hospice_categories & !is.na(discharge_date) & discharge_date <= window_end_6mo]
  d[, worst_outcome_6mo := mortality_6mo | hospice_6mo]
  d[, hospital_free_days_6mo := eligible_days_6mo - hospital_days_6mo]
  d[, vent_on_dc_day_6mo := FALSE]
  d[vent_dates, on = c("hospitalization_id", "discharge_date" = "calendar_date"), vent_on_dc_day_6mo := i.vent_flag]
  d[is.na(discharge_date) | discharge_date > window_end_6mo, vent_on_dc_day_6mo := FALSE]
  d[vent_on_dc_day_6mo == TRUE & dc_cat %in% facility_categories & worst_outcome_6mo == FALSE, hospital_free_days_6mo := 0L]
  d[worst_outcome_6mo == TRUE, hospital_free_days_6mo := 0L]

  d[, dc_cat := NULL]
  d[]
}

#Run on the final cohort, then apply the old step 12 (no hospital days in the 28-day window = date error)
cohort_final_outcomes <- compute_outcomes(cohort_final)
n_date_err <- cohort_final_outcomes[is.na(hospital_days_28), .N]
cohort_final_outcomes <- cohort_final_outcomes[!is.na(hospital_days_28)]
message(n_date_err, " index episodes removed: no hospital days in the 28-day window")

#Add that step to the CONSORT (replaces the previous "Final cohort" row)
main_outcomes <- cohort_final_outcomes[sens_only_icu_late == FALSE]
n_date_err_main <- cohort_final[sens_only_icu_late == FALSE, .N] - nrow(main_outcomes)
consort_flow <- rbind(consort_flow[!grepl("^Final cohort", step)],
  data.table(type = "exclusion", step = "Errors in dates (no hospital days in the 28-day window)",
             episodes = nrow(main_outcomes), hospitalizations = nrow(main_outcomes),
             patients = uniqueN(main_outcomes$patient_id),
             episodes_removed = n_date_err_main, hospitalizations_removed = n_date_err_main),
  data.table(type = "count", step = "Final cohort (index IMV episodes)",
             episodes = nrow(main_outcomes), hospitalizations = nrow(main_outcomes),
             patients = uniqueN(main_outcomes$patient_id),
             episodes_removed = NA_real_, hospitalizations_removed = NA_real_))
print(consort_flow)
fwrite(consort_flow, file.path(audit_dir, paste0("consort_flow_", stamp, institution, ".csv")))
rm(main_outcomes)

print(cohort_final_outcomes[, .N, by = fd_group])
print(cohort_final_outcomes[, lapply(.SD, function(x) round(mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), 2)),
  .SDcols = c("vent_free_days_28", "icu_free_days_28", "hospital_free_days_28", "vent_free_days_28_hours",
              "hospital_free_days_6mo", "mortality_28day", "mortality_6mo")])
arrow::write_parquet(cohort_final_outcomes, file.path(intermediate_dir, paste0("cohort_final_outcomes_", stamp, institution, ".parquet")))

#Individual Elixhauser comorbidity flags for the final cohort (for the comorbidity sensitivity analysis)
elix_flags_version <- "poa"   #match whichever version your primary elixhauser_score uses
elix_src <- if (elix_flags_version == "poa") res_poa$audit else res_all$audit
cohort_elix_flags <- elix_src[hospitalization_id %in% cohort_final_outcomes$hospitalization_id,
                              c("hospitalization_id", flag_cols), with = FALSE]
cohort_elix_flags[, (flag_cols) := lapply(.SD, as.integer), .SDcols = flag_cols]   #0/1 for modelling
stopifnot(nrow(cohort_elix_flags) == nrow(cohort_final_outcomes))
arrow::write_parquet(cohort_elix_flags, file.path(intermediate_dir,
  paste0("cohort_elix_flags_", elix_flags_version, "_", stamp, institution, ".parquet")))
print(sort(cohort_elix_flags[, sapply(.SD, sum), .SDcols = flag_cols]))   #count per comorbidity


#Save_cache
save_cache(cohort_final_outcomes, cohort_cache, cohort_meta, cohort_params,
           extras = list(consort_flow = consort_flow))
}
```


# PART NINE: LAPS2 calculated using labs/vitals from 24 hours BEFORE ICU admission (instead of 24 hours after hospital admission)
```{r}
if (!use_laps_cache) {
if (use_cohort_cache && !use_laps_cache) {
  cohort_final_outcomes <- restore_tz(as.data.table(arrow::read_parquet(cohort_cache)))
  stopifnot(nrow(cohort_final_outcomes) == readRDS(cohort_meta)$n_rows)
  list2env(readRDS(cohort_meta)$extras, envir = globalenv())
  message("Loaded cached cohort_final_outcomes: ", format(nrow(cohort_final_outcomes), big.mark = ","), " rows")
}
#Define for future pipeline
# CHANGED (R&R): use the outcomes table (Part Six) so the reduced table has free days / mortality.
#   copy() so the := below doesn't modify cohort_final_outcomes by reference.
final_cohort_imv_runs <- copy(cohort_final_outcomes)

# CHANGED (R&R): anchor for the 24 h window = START of the ICU stay containing icu_admission_dttm.
#   icu_admission_dttm (Part Five) is the in_dttm of the first ICU ADT row that overlaps the IMV episode;
#   if the patient changed ICU beds/units before intubation that row starts at the bed move, not at
#   ICU admission. Contiguous ICU rows (gaps <= icu_gap_mins) are collapsed into one stay.
icu_gap_mins <- 60
adt_s <- adt[hospitalization_id %in% final_cohort_imv_runs$hospitalization_id & !is.na(in_dttm),
             .(hospitalization_id, loc = tolower(trimws(location_category)),
               in_s = as.numeric(in_dttm), out_s = as.numeric(out_dttm))]
setorder(adt_s, hospitalization_id, in_s)
adt_s[, next_in_s := shift(in_s, type = "lead"), by = hospitalization_id]
adt_s[is.na(out_s), out_s := fifelse(!is.na(next_in_s), next_in_s, in_s)] #missing out_dttm = until next ADT row
icu_s <- adt_s[loc == "icu" & out_s >= in_s]
icu_s[, prev_end := shift(cummax(out_s)), by = hospitalization_id]
icu_s[, stay := cumsum(is.na(prev_end) | in_s - prev_end > icu_gap_mins * 60), by = hospitalization_id]
icu_stays <- icu_s[, .(stay_start_s = min(in_s), stay_end_s = max(out_s)), by = .(hospitalization_id, stay)]
anc <- final_cohort_imv_runs[, .(hospitalization_id, a_s = as.numeric(icu_admission_dttm))]
anc_hit <- icu_stays[anc, on = .(hospitalization_id, stay_start_s <= a_s, stay_end_s >= a_s), nomatch = 0L,
                     .(hospitalization_id, stay_start_s = x.stay_start_s)][
  , .(stay_start_s = min(stay_start_s)), by = hospitalization_id]
final_cohort_imv_runs[, icu_stay_start_dttm := icu_admission_dttm]
final_cohort_imv_runs[anc_hit, on = "hospitalization_id", icu_stay_start_dttm := .POSIXct(i.stay_start_s, tz = time_zone)]
print(final_cohort_imv_runs[, .N, by = .(anchor_moved_earlier = icu_stay_start_dttm < icu_admission_dttm)])

# CHANGED (R&R): the calendar date that carries the 24 h pre-ICU window values (local time zone)
laps2_anchor_dates <- final_cohort_imv_runs[, .(hospitalization_id,
                                                lab_date = as.Date(icu_stay_start_dttm, tz = time_zone))]

#Prep labs, vitals, gcs tables
#Labs
labs_time_dependent_2 <- labs_time_dependent[hospitalization_id %in% final_cohort_imv_runs$hospitalization_id]

#Filtered Vitals
time_dependent_vitals <- c("sbp", "dbp", "map", "spo2", "temp_c", "heart_rate", "respiratory_rate")
vitals_time_dependent <- vitals[vital_category %in% time_dependent_vitals & hospitalization_id %in% final_cohort_imv_runs$hospitalization_id]

#Filtered Patient Assessments
patient_assess_gcs_time_dependent <- patient_assessments[hospitalization_id %in% final_cohort_imv_runs$hospitalization_id & assessment_category == "gcs_total"]
pat_assess_gcs_time_dependent <- patient_assess_gcs_time_dependent[, .(hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm, assessment_category, numerical_value)]

#GCS
pat_assess_gcs_time_dependent_wide <- dcast(pat_assess_gcs_time_dependent,
                   hospitalization_id + recorded_dttm ~ assessment_category,
                   value.var = "numerical_value",
                   fun.aggregate = mean,
                   fill = NA)
setorder(pat_assess_gcs_time_dependent_wide, hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm)


# CHANGED (R&R): a lab/vital category with no rows at a site produces no column after pivot_wider,
#   which breaks the summarise() calls below. ensure_cols() adds any missing ones as NA.
ensure_cols <- function(df, cols) { for (cc in setdiff(cols, names(df))) df[[cc]] <- NA_real_; df }
laps_lab_cols    <- c("albumin", "anion_gap", "bilirubin_total", "bun", "bicarbonate", "creatinine", "glucose_serum",
                      "hematocrit", "lactic_acid", "pco2_arterial", "po2_arterial", "ph_arterial", "platelet_count",
                      "so2_arterial", "sodium", "troponin_i", "wbc")
laps_vital_cols  <- c("temp_c", "sbp", "spo2", "heart_rate", "respiratory_rate", "gcs")

# LAPS2 Score Part 1: Encounter Data

clif_adt_hospital <- adt |>
  mutate(location_category = factor(location_category,
                                    levels = (c("icu", "stepdown", "ward", "ed", "procedural", "other")),
                                    ordered = TRUE)) |>
  group_by(hospitalization_id) |>
  arrange(hospitalization_id, location_category, in_dttm) |>
  slice_head(n = 1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  dplyr::select(hospitalization_id,
                hospital = hospital_id)

clif_adt_admit <- adt |>
  group_by(hospitalization_id) |>
  arrange(hospitalization_id, in_dttm) |>
  slice_head(n = 1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  dplyr::select(hospitalization_id,
                first_location_category = location_category)

# fixing clif_labs to recorded_dttm 
#safety check - should have been changed earlier in code
if ("lab_collect_dttm" %in% colnames(labs_time_dependent)) {
  labs_time_dependent <- labs_time_dependent |> rename(recorded_dttm = lab_collect_dttm)
}

df_encounter_laps2_temp1 <- hospitalization |>
  left_join(patient_demographics) |>
  left_join(clif_adt_hospital) |>
  left_join(clif_adt_admit) |>

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Join in icu_admission_dttm from cohort to anchor the window
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------
  left_join(
    final_cohort_imv_runs |>
      # CHANGED (R&R): window anchor = ICU-stay start (named icu_admission_dttm inside this chunk only)
      dplyr::select(hospitalization_id, icu_admission_dttm = icu_stay_start_dttm) |>
      distinct(),
    by = "hospitalization_id"
  ) |>

  mutate(
    death_or_hospice_01 = fcase(
      discharge_category %in%
        c("hospice", "dead", "expired", "died", "Hospice", "Expired"), 1,
      default = 0
    ),

    death_or_hospice_01    = as.factor(death_or_hospice_01),

    # Keep 24h after admit for pre-LAPS logistic regression (Part 3)
    dt_24hours_after_admit = admission_dttm + hours(24),

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------
    # New window — 24 hours BEFORE ICU admission
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------
    dt_24hours_before_icu  = icu_admission_dttm - hours(24),

    ed_admit_01  = fifelse(first_location_category == "ed", 1, 0, 0),
    female_01    = fifelse(str_detect(sex_category, "female"), 1, 0, 0),
  )


# LAPS2 Score Part 2: Fix Anion Gap & Troponin_t

if (any(labs_time_dependent$lab_category == "anion_gap", na.rm = TRUE)) {

  print("you already have anion gap")
  message("we are going to remove anion_gap and recreate it for you")
  message("this way... all our analyses are the same")

  labs_time_dependent <- labs_time_dependent |>
    filter(lab_category != "anion_gap")

  print("Anion gap removed... please proceed!!")

} else {

  print("no anion_gap found... we will make one for you!!")

}

if (any(labs_time_dependent$lab_category == "troponin_t")) {

  print("you already have trop_t")
  message("we are going to change to trop_i levels")

  labs_time_dependent <- labs_time_dependent |>

    mutate(lab_value_numeric = fcase(
      lab_category == "troponin_t",
      lab_value_numeric / 1000,
      default = lab_value_numeric
    )) |>

    mutate(lab_category = fcase(
      lab_category == "troponin_t",
      "troponin_i",
      rep_len(TRUE, length(lab_category)), lab_category
    ))

  print("Troponin fixed ... please proceed!!")

} else {

  print("no need to fix troponin !!")

}

# Set a time tolerance of 1 hour for anion gap calculation
time_tolerance <- hours(1)

labs_time_dependent <- labs_time_dependent %>%
  mutate(recorded_date = as.Date(recorded_dttm, tz = time_zone))  # CHANGED (R&R): local date, not UTC

sodium_df <- labs_time_dependent %>%
  filter(lab_category == "sodium") %>%
  dplyr::select(hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm, recorded_date, sodium = lab_value_numeric,
                lab_order_dttm, lab_result_dttm)

bicarbonate_df <- labs_time_dependent %>%
  filter(lab_category == "bicarbonate") %>%
  dplyr::select(hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm, recorded_date, bicarbonate = lab_value_numeric)

chloride_df <- labs_time_dependent %>%
  filter(lab_category == "chloride") %>%
  dplyr::select(hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm, recorded_date, chloride = lab_value_numeric)

anion_gap_df <- sodium_df %>%
  full_join(bicarbonate_df, by = c("hospitalization_id", "recorded_date")) %>%
  full_join(chloride_df, by = c("hospitalization_id", "recorded_date")) %>%
  mutate(
    time_diff_sodium_bicarbonate = abs(difftime(recorded_dttm.x, recorded_dttm.y, units = "mins")),
    time_diff_sodium_chloride    = abs(difftime(recorded_dttm.x, recorded_dttm, units = "mins")),
    within_tolerance_bicarbonate = time_diff_sodium_bicarbonate <= time_tolerance,
    within_tolerance_chloride    = time_diff_sodium_chloride <= time_tolerance
  ) %>%
  filter(within_tolerance_bicarbonate & within_tolerance_chloride) %>%
  mutate(anion_gap = sodium - (bicarbonate + chloride)) %>%
  dplyr::select(hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm.x, anion_gap, lab_order_dttm, lab_result_dttm, recorded_date) %>%
  mutate(
    reference_unit = "meq/l",
    lab_name       = "anion gap",
    lab_category   = "anion_gap"
  ) %>%
  rename(
    lab_value_numeric = anion_gap,
    recorded_dttm     = recorded_dttm.x
  )

labs_time_dependent <- labs_time_dependent |>
  bind_rows(anion_gap_df)

# Re-create to fix bug with anion_gap below
# CHANGED (R&R): dplyr steps above keep data.table's auto-index from the first subset while changing the rows;
#   a stale index makes the subset below error or return the wrong rows. Drop it first.
setDT(labs_time_dependent); setindex(labs_time_dependent, NULL)
labs_time_dependent_2 <- labs_time_dependent[
  hospitalization_id %in% final_cohort_imv_runs$hospitalization_id
]

# LAPS2 Score Part 3: Fix/Prep Labs for Pre-LAPS2 Logistic Regression
# NOTE: Pre-LAPS still uses 24h after hospital admission — this feeds the
#       logistic regression model that generates p(death/hospice), which
#       is a patient-level risk flag, not a time-varying score.

df_pre_laps2_prep1 <-
  df_encounter_laps2_temp1 |>
  left_join(
    labs_time_dependent |>
      filter(lab_category %in% c("anion_gap", "bicarbonate", "bun", "creatinine", "sodium")),
    by = join_by(hospitalization_id,
                 dt_24hours_after_admit >= recorded_dttm)
  ) |>
  group_by(hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm, lab_category) |>
  mutate(obs = row_number()) |>
  ungroup() |>
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols     = c(hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm, obs),
    names_from  = lab_category,
    values_from = lab_value_numeric
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(-obs) |>
  distinct()

df_pre_laps2_prep2 <- df_pre_laps2_prep1 |>
  ensure_cols(c("bun", "creatinine", "bicarbonate", "anion_gap", "sodium")) |>   # CHANGED (R&R)
  arrange(hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm) |>
  group_by(hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm) |>
  summarise(
    bun         = fmax(bun, na.rm = TRUE),
    creatinine  = fmin(creatinine, na.rm = TRUE),
    bicarbonate = fmin(bicarbonate, na.rm = TRUE),
    anion_gap   = fmax(anion_gap, na.rm = TRUE),
    sodium      = fmin(sodium, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups     = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric) & !c(hospitalization_id), ~ replace(.x, is.infinite(.x), NA))) |>
  distinct() |>
  arrange(hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm) |>
  group_by(hospitalization_id) |>
  fill(c(bun, creatinine, bicarbonate, anion_gap, sodium), .direction = "downup") |>
  mutate(
    bun_recent        = flast(bun, na.rm = TRUE),
    creatinine_recent = flast(creatinine, na.rm = TRUE),
    bicarbonate_recent = flast(bicarbonate, na.rm = TRUE),
    anion_gap_recent  = flast(anion_gap, na.rm = TRUE),
    sodium_recent     = flast(sodium, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  dplyr::select(hospitalization_id, ends_with("recent")) |>
  mutate(
    sodium       = sodium_recent,
    bun_cr_ratio = bun_recent / creatinine_recent,
    ag_hco3_ratio = (anion_gap_recent / bicarbonate_recent) * 1000
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(-ends_with("recent")) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric) & !c(hospitalization_id), ~ replace(.x, is.infinite(.x), NA))) |>
  distinct()

df_pre_laps_merging <- df_pre_laps2_prep2 |>
  left_join(
    df_encounter_laps2_temp1 |>
      dplyr::select(
        hospitalization_id,
        admission_dttm,
        age = age_at_admission,
        female_01,
        ed_admit_01,
        death_or_hospice_01
      ) |>
      distinct(),
    join_by(hospitalization_id)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    age_cat = case_when(
      age >= 85 ~ 5,
      age >= 75 ~ 4,
      age >= 65 ~ 3,
      age >= 40 ~ 2,
      TRUE      ~ 1
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    bun_cr_ratio = fifelse(is.na(bun_cr_ratio), 8, bun_cr_ratio),
    buncreat_cat = case_when(
      bun_cr_ratio >= 24 ~ 4,
      bun_cr_ratio >= 16 ~ 3,
      bun_cr_ratio < 8   ~ 2,
      TRUE               ~ 1
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    sodium = fifelse(is.na(sodium), 135, sodium),
    na_cat = case_when(
      sodium >= 155 ~ 7,
      sodium >= 149 ~ 6,
      sodium >= 146 ~ 5,
      sodium >= 132 ~ 4,
      sodium >= 129 ~ 3,
      sodium < 129  ~ 2,
      TRUE          ~ 1
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    ag_hco3_ratio = fifelse(is.na(ag_hco3_ratio), 200, ag_hco3_ratio),
    aghco3_cat    = case_when(
      ag_hco3_ratio >= 600 ~ 4,
      ag_hco3_ratio >= 400 ~ 3,
      ag_hco3_ratio < 200  ~ 2,
      TRUE                 ~ 1
    )
  )

# Logistic regression for p(death/hospice) — patient-level risk flag
lr_model <- glm(
  death_or_hospice_01 ~
    age +
    female_01 +
    ed_admit_01 +
    bun_cr_ratio +
    sodium +
    ag_hco3_ratio,
  family = "binomial",
  data   = df_pre_laps_merging
)

tidy(lr_model)
pR2(lr_model)["McFadden"]

df_pre_laps_final <- df_pre_laps_merging |>
  mutate(p_death = predict(lr_model, df_pre_laps_merging, type = "response")) |>
  mutate(high_risk = case_when(
    p_death >= 0.06 ~ 1,
    TRUE            ~ 0
  )) |>
  dplyr::select(hospitalization_id, p_death, high_risk)


# LAPS2 Score Part 4: Prep LAPS2 Labs (All Days — rolling join, no time filter)

# LAPS2 Score Part 5: Labs in 24h Window BEFORE ICU Admission (replaces day-one window)
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Was dt_24hours_after_admit >= recorded_dttm (24h after hospital admit)
#     Now:  icu_admission_dttm  >= recorded_dttm  (up to ICU admit)
#     AND dt_24hours_before_icu <= recorded_dttm (no earlier than 24h before ICU admit)
# -------------------------------------------------------------------

df_laps2_dayone_prep1 <-
  df_encounter_laps2_temp2 |>
  dplyr::select(hospitalization_id, admission_dttm, discharge_dttm,
                icu_admission_dttm, dt_24hours_before_icu) |>   # CHANGE: ICU window cols
  distinct() |>
  left_join(
    labs_time_dependent_2 |>
      filter(lab_category %in% c(
        "albumin", "anion_gap", "bilirubin_total", "bun", "bicarbonate",
        "creatinine", "glucose_serum", "hemoglobin", "lactate",

    # CHANGE: 24h window before ICU admission
    by = join_by(

    )
  ) |>
  mutate(

    lab_category      = fifelse(lab_category == "hemoglobin", "hematocrit", lab_category),

  ) |>
  group_by(hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm, lab_category) |>

  ungroup() |>
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols     = c(hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm, obs, admission_dttm, icu_admission_dttm),  # CHANGE: keep icu_admission_dttm
    names_from  = lab_category,
    values_from = lab_value_numeric
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(-obs) |>
  distinct()

df_laps2_dayone_prep2 <- df_laps2_dayone_prep1 |>
  ensure_cols(laps_lab_cols) |>   # CHANGED (R&R)
  arrange(hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm) |>

  # CHANGE: Anchor lab_date to ICU admission date (was admission_dttm)
  mutate(lab_date = as.Date(icu_admission_dttm, tz = time_zone)) |>  # CHANGED (R&R): explicit local date

  group_by(hospitalization_id, lab_date) |>
  summarise(

    creatinine      = fmax(creatinine, na.rm = TRUE),
    glucose_serum   = fmin(glucose_serum, na.rm = TRUE),
    hematocrit      = fmax(hematocrit, na.rm = TRUE),

    po2_arterial    = fmax(po2_arterial, na.rm = TRUE),

    so2_arterial    = fmin(so2_arterial, na.rm = TRUE),
    sodium          = fmin(sodium, na.rm = TRUE),

  ) |>
  mutate(bun_cr_ratio = bun / creatinine) |>

  distinct()

# Swap in the ICU-anchored day-one labs

df_laps2_final <- df_laps2_prep2 |>

# LAPS2 Score Part 9: Calculate LAPS2 Score
setDT(df_pre_laps_final)
df_pre_laps_final_cohort <- df_pre_laps_final[hospitalization_id %in% final_cohort_imv_runs$hospitalization_id]

df_laps_calc <- df_laps2_final |>
  rename(recorded_date = lab_date) |>
  full_join(
    df_laps2_vitals_final |> rename(recorded_date = vital_date),
    join_by(hospitalization_id, recorded_date)
  ) |>
  # CHANGED (R&R): one row on the anchor date for every cohort hospitalization, even with no data in the
  #   window (it then scores the LAPS2 missing-value points), and an explicit key for p(death)/high_risk
  full_join(laps2_anchor_dates |> rename(recorded_date = lab_date), join_by(hospitalization_id, recorded_date)) |>
  left_join(df_pre_laps_final_cohort, join_by(hospitalization_id))

clif_laps2_scores <- df_laps_calc |>
  group_by(hospitalization_id, recorded_date) |>

  mutate(laps2 = 0) |>

  mutate(
    # Lactic Acid and pH
    laps2 = fcase(
      is.na(ph_arterial) & is.na(lactic_acid) & high_risk == 0,                                    laps2 + 0,
      is.na(ph_arterial) & is.na(lactic_acid) & high_risk == 1,                                    laps2 + 15,
      is.na(ph_arterial) & lactic_acid < 2    & high_risk == 0,                                    laps2 + 0,
      is.na(ph_arterial) & lactic_acid < 2    & high_risk == 1,                                    laps2 + 12,
      is.na(ph_arterial) & lactic_acid >= 2   & lactic_acid < 4 & high_risk == 0,                  laps2 + 12,
      is.na(ph_arterial) & lactic_acid >= 2   & lactic_acid < 4 & high_risk == 1,                  laps2 + 15,
      is.na(ph_arterial) & lactic_acid >= 4   & high_risk == 0,                                    laps2 + 26,
      is.na(ph_arterial) & lactic_acid >= 4   & high_risk == 1,                                    laps2 + 30,
      ph_arterial < 7.2  & is.na(lactic_acid) & high_risk == 0,                                    laps2 + 13,
      ph_arterial < 7.2  & is.na(lactic_acid) & high_risk == 1,                                    laps2 + 19,
      ph_arterial >= 7.2  & ph_arterial < 7.35 & is.na(lactic_acid) & high_risk == 0,              laps2 + 5,
      ph_arterial >= 7.2  & ph_arterial < 7.35 & is.na(lactic_acid) & high_risk == 1,              laps2 + 15,
      ph_arterial >= 7.35 & ph_arterial < 7.45 & is.na(lactic_acid) & high_risk == 0,              laps2 + 0,
      ph_arterial >= 7.35 & ph_arterial < 7.45 & is.na(lactic_acid) & high_risk == 1,              laps2 + 12,
      ph_arterial >= 7.45 & is.na(lactic_acid) & high_risk == 0,                                   laps2 + 12,
      ph_arterial >= 7.45 & is.na(lactic_acid) & high_risk == 1,                                   laps2 + 15,
      ph_arterial < 7.2  & lactic_acid <  2,                                                        laps2 + 13,
      ph_arterial < 7.2  & lactic_acid >= 2 & lactic_acid < 4,                                     laps2 + 19,
      ph_arterial < 7.2  & lactic_acid >= 4,                                                        laps2 + 34,
      ph_arterial >= 7.2  & ph_arterial < 7.35 & lactic_acid <  2,                                 laps2 + 5,
      ph_arterial >= 7.2  & ph_arterial < 7.35 & lactic_acid >= 2 & lactic_acid < 4,               laps2 + 15,
      ph_arterial >= 7.2  & ph_arterial < 7.35 & lactic_acid >= 4,                                 laps2 + 25,
      ph_arterial >= 7.35 & ph_arterial < 7.45 & lactic_acid <  2,                                 laps2 + 0,
      ph_arterial >= 7.35 & ph_arterial < 7.45 & lactic_acid >= 2 & lactic_acid < 4,               laps2 + 12,
      ph_arterial >= 7.35 & ph_arterial < 7.45 & lactic_acid >= 4,                                 laps2 + 26,
      ph_arterial >= 7.45 & lactic_acid <  2,                                                       laps2 + 12,
      ph_arterial >= 7.45 & lactic_acid >= 2   & lactic_acid < 4,                                  laps2 + 15,
      ph_arterial >= 7.45 & lactic_acid >= 4,                                                       laps2 + 30,
      default                                                                                       = laps2
    ),

    # Sodium
    laps2 = fcase(
      is.na(sodium),                        laps2 + 0,
      sodium <  129,                        laps2 + 14,
      sodium >= 129 & sodium < 135,         laps2 + 7,
      sodium >= 135 & sodium < 146,         laps2 + 0,
      sodium >= 146,                        laps2 + 4,
      default                              = laps2
    ),

    # Bilirubin
    laps2 = fcase(
      is.na(bilirubin_total),                                         laps2 + 0,
      bilirubin_total <  2,                                           laps2 + 0,
      bilirubin_total >= 2 & bilirubin_total < 3,                     laps2 + 11,
      bilirubin_total >= 3 & bilirubin_total < 5,                     laps2 + 18,
      bilirubin_total >= 5 & bilirubin_total < 8,                     laps2 + 25,
      bilirubin_total >= 8,                                           laps2 + 41,
      TRUE,                                                           laps2
    ),

    # BUN
    laps2 = fcase(
      is.na(bun),                           laps2 + 0,
      bun < 18,                             laps2 + 0,
      bun >= 18 & bun < 20,                 laps2 + 11,
      bun >= 20 & bun < 40,                 laps2 + 12,
      bun >= 40 & bun < 80,                 laps2 + 20,
      bun >= 80,                            laps2 + 25,
      default                              = laps2
    ),

    # Creatinine
    laps2 = fcase(
      is.na(creatinine),                            laps2 + 0,
      creatinine < 1,                               laps2 + 0,
      creatinine >= 1 & creatinine < 2,             laps2 + 6,
      creatinine >= 2 & creatinine < 4,             laps2 + 11,
      creatinine >= 4,                              laps2 + 5,
      default                                      = laps2
    ),

    # BUN/Cr Ratio
    laps2 = fcase(
      is.na(bun_cr_ratio),                  laps2 + 0,
      bun_cr_ratio < 25,                    laps2 + 0,
      bun_cr_ratio >= 25,                   laps2 + 10,
      default                              = laps2
    ),

    # Albumin
    laps2 = fcase(
      is.na(albumin),                               laps2 + 0,
      albumin < 2,                                  laps2 + 31,
      albumin >= 2 & albumin < 2.5,                 laps2 + 15,
      albumin >= 2.5,                               laps2 + 0,
      default                                      = laps2
    ),

    # Glucose
    laps2 = fcase(
      is.na(glucose_serum),                                     laps2 + 0,
      glucose_serum < 40,                                       laps2 + 10,
      glucose_serum >= 40 & glucose_serum < 60,                 laps2 + 10,
      glucose_serum >= 60 & glucose_serum < 200,                laps2 + 0,
      glucose_serum >= 200,                                     laps2 + 3,
      default                                                  = laps2
    ),

    # Hematocrit
    laps2 = fcase(
      is.na(hematocrit),                                laps2 + 0,
      hematocrit < 20,                                  laps2 + 7,
      hematocrit >= 20 & hematocrit < 40,               laps2 + 8,
      hematocrit >= 40 & hematocrit < 50,               laps2 + 0,
      hematocrit >= 50,                                 laps2 + 3,
      default                                          = laps2
    ),

    # WBC
    laps2 = fcase(
      is.na(wbc) & high_risk == 0,          laps2 + 0,
      is.na(wbc) & high_risk == 1,          laps2 + 32,
      wbc < 5,                              laps2 + 8,
      wbc >= 5 & wbc < 13,                  laps2 + 0,
      wbc >= 13,                            laps2 + 11,
      default                              = laps2
    ),

    # PCO2 Arterial
    laps2 = fcase(
      is.na(pco2_arterial),                                         laps2 + 0,
      pco2_arterial < 35,                                           laps2 + 7,
      pco2_arterial >= 35 & pco2_arterial < 45,                     laps2 + 0,
      pco2_arterial >= 45 & pco2_arterial < 55,                     laps2 + 11,
      pco2_arterial >= 55 & pco2_arterial < 65,                     laps2 + 13,
      pco2_arterial >= 65,                                          laps2 + 12,
      default                                                      = laps2
    ),

    # PO2 Arterial
    laps2 = fcase(
      is.na(po2_arterial),                                  laps2 + 0,
      po2_arterial < 50,                                    laps2 + 8,
      po2_arterial >= 50 & po2_arterial < 120,              laps2 + 0,
      po2_arterial >= 120,                                  laps2 + 12,
      default                                              = laps2
    ),

    # Troponin
    laps2 = fcase(
      is.na(troponin) & high_risk == 0,             laps2 + 0,
      is.na(troponin) & high_risk == 1,             laps2 + 9,
      troponin <  0.01,                             laps2 + 0,
      troponin >= 0.01 & troponin < 0.2,            laps2 + 8,
      troponin >= 0.2  & troponin < 1,              laps2 + 17,
      troponin >= 1    & troponin < 3,              laps2 + 19,
      troponin >= 3,                                laps2 + 25,
      default                                      = laps2
    ),

    # Temperature
    laps2 = fcase(
      is.na(temp),                          laps2 + 0,
      temp < 96,                            laps2 + 20,
      temp >= 96    & temp < 100.5,         laps2 + 0,
      temp >= 100.5,                        laps2 + 3,
      default                              = laps2
    ),

    # Heart Rate
    laps2 = fcase(
      is.na(heart_rate),                            laps2 + 0,
      heart_rate < 60,                              laps2 + 7,
      heart_rate >= 60  & heart_rate < 110,         laps2 + 0,
      heart_rate >= 110 & heart_rate < 140,         laps2 + 7,
      heart_rate >= 140,                            laps2 + 10,
      default                                      = laps2
    ),

    # Respiratory Rate
    laps2 = fcase(
      is.na(resp),                          laps2 + 0,
      resp < 20,                            laps2 + 0,
      resp >= 20 & resp < 30,               laps2 + 11,
      resp >= 30,                           laps2 + 21,
      default                              = laps2
    ),

    # SBP
    laps2 = fcase(
      is.na(sbp),                           laps2 + 0,
      sbp < 75,                             laps2 + 22,
      sbp >= 75  & sbp < 90,               laps2 + 13,
      sbp >= 90  & sbp < 120,              laps2 + 5,
      sbp >= 120 & sbp < 140,              laps2 + 0,
      sbp >= 140 & sbp < 160,              laps2 + 8,
      sbp >= 160,                           laps2 + 14,
      default                              = laps2
    ),

    # Shock Index
    laps2 = fcase(
      is.na(shock_index),                                   laps2 + 0,
      shock_index < 0.65,                                   laps2 + 0,
      shock_index >= 0.65 & shock_index < 0.85,             laps2 + 8,
      shock_index >= 0.85,                                  laps2 + 17,
      default                                              = laps2
    ),

    # SpO2
    laps2 = fcase(
      is.na(spo2) & high_risk == 0,         laps2 + 0,
      is.na(spo2) & high_risk == 1,         laps2 + 22,
      spo2 <  90,                           laps2 + 22,
      spo2 >= 90  & spo2 < 94,             laps2 + 12,
      spo2 >  94,                           laps2 + 0,
      default                              = laps2
    ),

    # Neuro (GCS)
    laps2 = fcase(
      is.na(gcs) & high_risk == 0,          laps2 + 16,
      is.na(gcs) & high_risk == 1,          laps2 + 21,
      gcs == 1,                             laps2 + 0,
      gcs == 2,                             laps2 + 16,
      gcs == 3,                             laps2 + 21,
      gcs == 4,                             laps2 + 36,
      default                              = laps2
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup()   # CHANGED (R&R)


# LAPS2 Score Final: CHANGED (R&R)
#   Old code matched on as.Date(begin_imv) (UTC date) and rolled to the NEXT date (roll = -Inf) when there
#   was no exact match, so the score came from the IMV date, not the 24 h pre-ICU window, whenever those
#   dates differed. The window values sit on the ICU-stay-start date, so match on that date only.
setDT(clif_laps2_scores)
final_cohort_imv_runs[, laps2_date := as.Date(icu_stay_start_dttm, tz = time_zone)]
final_cohort_imv_runs_merge <- merge(
  final_cohort_imv_runs,
  clif_laps2_scores,
  by.x  = c("hospitalization_id", "laps2_date"),
  by.y  = c("hospitalization_id", "recorded_date"),
  all.x = TRUE
)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(final_cohort_imv_runs_merge$hospitalization_id),
          nrow(final_cohort_imv_runs_merge) == nrow(final_cohort_imv_runs),
          final_cohort_imv_runs_merge[is.na(laps2), .N] == 0)
# Did the 24 h window contain any labs / vitals? (if not, LAPS2 = the missing-value points only)
final_cohort_imv_runs_merge[, `:=`(
  laps2_window_labs   = hospitalization_id %in% df_laps2_dayone_prep2$hospitalization_id,
  laps2_window_vitals = hospitalization_id %in% df_laps2_vitals_dayone_prep2$hospitalization_id)]
print(final_cohort_imv_runs_merge[, .N, by = .(laps2_window_labs, laps2_window_vitals)])

# LAPS2 Missing Data Summary

laps2_missing_summary <- final_cohort_imv_runs_merge %>%
  group_by(hospitalization_id) %>%
  summarise(
    missing_sodium      = all(is.na(sodium)),
    missing_bili        = all(is.na(bilirubin_total)),
    missing_bun         = all(is.na(bun)),
    missing_creat       = all(is.na(creatinine)),
    missing_bun_cr_ratio = all(is.na(bun_cr_ratio)),
    missing_albumin     = all(is.na(albumin)),
    missing_gluc        = all(is.na(glucose_serum)),
    missing_hct         = all(is.na(hematocrit)),
    missing_wbc         = all(is.na(wbc)),
    missing_pco2        = all(is.na(pco2_arterial)),
    missing_po2         = all(is.na(po2_arterial)),
    missing_trop        = all(is.na(troponin)),
    missing_temp        = all(is.na(temp)),
    missing_hr          = all(is.na(heart_rate)),
    missing_resp        = all(is.na(resp)),
    missing_sbp         = all(is.na(sbp)),
    missing_shock_index = all(is.na(shock_index)),
    missing_spo2        = all(is.na(spo2)),
    missing_gcs         = all(is.na(gcs)),
    .groups             = "drop"
  )

laps2_missing_percent <- laps2_missing_summary %>%
  summarise(
    pct_missing_sodium      = mean(missing_sodium) * 100,
    pct_missing_bili        = mean(missing_bili) * 100,
    pct_missing_bun         = mean(missing_bun) * 100,
    pct_missing_creat       = mean(missing_creat) * 100,
    pct_missing_bun_cr_ratio = mean(missing_bun_cr_ratio) * 100,
    pct_missing_albumin     = mean(missing_albumin) * 100,
    pct_missing_gluc        = mean(missing_gluc) * 100,
    pct_missing_hct         = mean(missing_hct) * 100,
    pct_missing_wbc         = mean(missing_wbc) * 100,
    pct_missing_pco2        = mean(missing_pco2) * 100,
    pct_missing_po2         = mean(missing_po2) * 100,
    pct_missing_trop        = mean(missing_trop) * 100,
    pct_missing_temp        = mean(missing_temp) * 100,
    pct_missing_hr          = mean(missing_hr) * 100,
    pct_missing_resp        = mean(missing_resp) * 100,
    pct_missing_sbp         = mean(missing_sbp) * 100,
    pct_missing_shock_index = mean(missing_shock_index) * 100,
    pct_missing_spo2        = mean(missing_spo2) * 100,
    pct_missing_gcs         = mean(missing_gcs) * 100
  )

# CHANGED (R&R): variables the old pipeline built before this chunk
final_cohort_imv_runs_merge[as.data.table(clif_adt_admit), on = "hospitalization_id",
                            first_location_category := i.first_location_category]
if ("language_name" %in% names(patient_demographics))
  final_cohort_imv_runs_merge[patient_demographics, on = "patient_id", language_name := i.language_name]
final_cohort_imv_runs_merge[, age_category := fcase(
  age_at_admission >= 18 & age_at_admission < 35, "18-34 Years",
  age_at_admission >= 35 & age_at_admission < 50, "35-49 Years",
  age_at_admission >= 50 & age_at_admission < 65, "50-64 Years",
  age_at_admission >= 65 & age_at_admission < 75, "65-74 Years",
  age_at_admission >= 75 & age_at_admission < 85, "75-84 Years",
  age_at_admission >= 85,                         "85+ Years",
  default = NA_character_)]
final_cohort_imv_runs_merge[, race_category := fifelse(   #same in-place recode as the old pipeline
  race_category %in% c("american indian or alaska native", "native hawaiian or other pacific islander", "unknown", "other",
                       "american_indian_or_alaska_native", "native_hawaiian_or_other_pacific_islander"),
  "other/unknown", as.character(race_category))]
final_cohort_imv_runs_merge[, ethnicity_category_final := fifelse(
  ethnicity_category %in% c("non-hispanic", "unknown", "non_hispanic"), "non-hispanic/unknown", as.character(ethnicity_category))]

# CHANGED (R&R): new-pipeline names (old name in the comment). Columns not built yet are reported and skipped.
keep_cols <- c(
  "hospitalization_id", "patient_id",
  "begin_obs", "end_obs", "run_hrs",                                   # begin_imv, end_imv, imv_duration_hours_final
  "admission_dttm", "discharge_dttm", "icu_admission_dttm", "icu_stay_start_dttm", "death_dttm", "hospital_id",
  "icu_imv", "hospital_icu_id",
  "location_of_intubation_adj", "intubation_site", "first_location_category",   # location_of_intubation
  "age_at_admission", "age_category", "admission_type_category", "discharge_category",
  "sex_category", "race_category", "ethnicity_category", "ethnicity_category_final",
  "SVM_SCORE", "language_name", "language_category", "elixhauser_score",
  "weight_kg", "height_cm", "bmi",                                     # admission_height
  "trached", "reintubation",                                           # reintubation_final
  "mortality_28day", "death_during_admission",
  "hospital_free_days_6mo", "hospital_free_days_28", "hospital_free_days_28_alt",
  "icu_free_days_28", "icu_free_days_28_alt",
  "vent_free_days_28", "vent_free_days_28_alt", "vent_free_days_28_hours",
  "laps2", "laps2_window_labs", "laps2_window_vitals",
  "deep_sedation_weighted", "deep_sedation_unweighted", "rass_weighted_avg",       # RASS exposure block -
  "rass_below_minus_3_count", "median_rass_binary", "median_rass_cont",            #   not yet built in the
  "sedation_index_score", "sedation_index_tertiles",                               #   new pipeline
    "rass_frequency_hrs", "rass_count_4_48", "time_from_begin_imv_to_icu_hours",
  # ADDED (R&R): built in Part Five, needed by Part Twelve / 01_analysis_rr
  "sens_only_icu_late",                                     # R4.7 ICU-late patients carried forward
  "icu_hospital_id", "rass_count",                          # hospital of the IMV ICU; RASS documentation table
  "procedural_stay_found", "procedural_stay_hours", "pre_icu_procedural_hours",
  "procedure_end_to_icu_hours", "post_procedure_location", "post_procedure_icu_type")   # R4.4 eTable + 9k)
missing_cols <- setdiff(keep_cols, names(final_cohort_imv_runs_merge))
if (length(missing_cols)) warning("Not in the cohort yet, left out of the reduced table: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
final_cohort_imv_runs_reduced <- final_cohort_imv_runs_merge[, intersect(keep_cols, names(final_cohort_imv_runs_merge)), with = FALSE]

# Save missing data summary
out_dir_laps <- if (exists("cohort_characteristics")) cohort_characteristics else audit_dir   # CHANGED (R&R)
fwrite(laps2_missing_percent,
       file.path(out_dir_laps, paste0(institution, "_laps2_missing_percentages.csv")))

# Save Point
# CHANGED (R&R): file.path - paste0 without a separator wrote the file NEXT TO intermediate_dir unless it ended in "/"
arrow::write_parquet(final_cohort_imv_runs_reduced, file.path(intermediate_dir, paste0("cleaned_cohort_w_laps", institution, ".parquet")))

# Save cache
save_cache(final_cohort_imv_runs_reduced, laps_cache, laps_meta, laps_params,
           extras = list(laps2_missing_percent = laps2_missing_percent))
}
```

# PART TEN: Calculate Med Doses, Paralytics, etc in First 48 hours of IMV
```{r}
if (use_laps_cache) {
  final_cohort_imv_runs_reduced <- restore_tz(as.data.table(arrow::read_parquet(laps_cache)))
  stopifnot(nrow(final_cohort_imv_runs_reduced) == readRDS(laps_meta)$n_rows)
  list2env(readRDS(cohort_meta)$extras, envir = globalenv())   # consort_flow etc. too
  list2env(readRDS(laps_meta)$extras,   envir = globalenv())
  message("Loaded cached LAPS2 table: ", format(nrow(final_cohort_imv_runs_reduced), big.mark = ","), " rows")
}
#Save Point Code if need to re-run and don't want to re-run LAPS2 can simply run parts 0-3 to upload tables/directories then remove # before code below and start here.

time_dependent_vitals <- c("sbp", "dbp", "map", "spo2", "temp_c", "heart_rate", "respiratory_rate")
vitals_time_dependent <- vitals[vital_category %in% time_dependent_vitals & hospitalization_id %in% final_cohort_imv_runs_reduced$hospitalization_id]
labs_time_dependent_2 <- labs_time_dependent[hospitalization_id %in% final_cohort_imv_runs_reduced$hospitalization_id]

# One engine (med_window) + one specification per drug (med_specs) replaces the 13 copy-pasted blocks.
# Rules are the same as the old code:
#   window     = begin_obs to min(begin_obs + 48 h, end_obs); averages divide by min(run_hrs, 48)
#   infusions  = the last rate charted in the hour before begin_obs is carried in at begin_obs; each rate
#                runs until the next charted rate (or the window end); same-time rows -> keep the last
#   >= 60 min  = an infusion with < 60 min of infusion time in the window counts as 0 (and not as receipt)
#   boluses    = summed inside the window (deduplicated on time + dose + unit)
#   plausibility caps and unit conversions = the per-drug values from the old code (see med_specs)
# Output column names are unchanged, so everything downstream of summary_meds_data_final still works.

#0) Parameters
grace_hours             <- 1      #rate charted up to 1 h before IMV start is carried in at begin_obs
window_hours            <- 48
min_infusion_mins       <- 60
push_nmba_delay_h       <- 4      #paralytic pushes count only from 4 h after IMV start (excludes RSI)
count_zero_rate_minutes <- FALSE  #old code counted minutes at a charted rate of 0 toward the 60-min rule;
                                  #TRUE reproduces that, FALSE counts only minutes actually infusing

#Cohort (one row per hospitalization = index IMV episode)
coh_src <- if (exists("final_cohort_imv_runs_reduced")) final_cohort_imv_runs_reduced else
           if (exists("final_cohort_imv_runs") && "begin_obs" %in% names(final_cohort_imv_runs)) final_cohort_imv_runs else
           cohort_final_outcomes
coh_meds <- coh_src[, .(hospitalization_id, weight_kg,
                        b_s          = as.numeric(begin_obs),
                        wend_s       = pmin(as.numeric(begin_obs) + window_hours * 3600, as.numeric(end_obs)),
                        hours_capped = pmin(run_hrs, window_hours))]
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(coh_meds$hospitalization_id))
med_cols <- c("hospitalization_id", "admin_dttm", "med_dose", "med_dose_unit", "med_category", "med_group", "med_route_category")

#1) Drug specifications
#   inf   : infusion unit = c(multiplier, weight power) converting the charted rate to AMOUNT PER MINUTE in the
#           drug's total unit (e.g. propofol mcg/kg/min -> mg/min = dose * weight / 1000 -> c(1/1000, 1))
#   bolus : bolus unit = multiplier to the total unit
#   avg   : c(multiplier, weight power): avg = total * mult / (hours_capped * weight^power)
#   max_raw: cap on the charted value in that unit (above it the value is set to NA, as in the old code)
med_specs <- list(
  propofol = list(category = "propofol", sources = c("cont", "int"),
    max_raw = c("mg/hr" = 3000, "mg/kg/hr" = 50, "mcg/kg/min" = 200),
    inf = list("mcg/kg/min" = c(1/1000, 1), "mg/hr" = c(1/60, 0), "mg/kg/hr" = c(1/60, 1)),          #-> mg
    bolus = c("mg" = 1, "mcg" = 1/1000), bolus_max = 2000,
    total = "propofol_total_mg_48", avg_name = "propofol_avg_mcgkgmin_48", avg = c(1000/60, 1),
    receipt = "cont_prop_receipt"),
  dexmedetomidine = list(category = "dexmedetomidine", sources = "cont",
    relabel = c("mcg/kg" = "mcg/kg/hr"),
    max_raw = c("mcg/kg/hr" = 5, "mcg/kg/min" = 0.1, "mcg" = 500, "mcg/hr" = 200),
    inf = list("mcg/kg/hr" = c(1/60, 1), "mcg/kg/min" = c(1, 1), "mcg/hr" = c(1/60, 0)),              #-> mcg
    bolus = c("mcg" = 1),
    total = "dexmedetomidine_total_cont_48", avg_name = "dexmedetomidine_avg_mcgkghr_48", avg = c(1, 1),

#2) Engine: per hospitalization, infusion amount / minutes / start and bolus amount in the window
med_window <- function(spec) {
  pick <- function(tb) {
    x <- if (!is.null(spec$category)) tb[tolower(trimws(med_category)) %in% spec$category]
         else                         tb[tolower(trimws(med_group))    %in% spec$group]
    x[hospitalization_id %in% coh_meds$hospitalization_id, intersect(med_cols, names(x)), with = FALSE]
  }
  d <- rbindlist(list(if ("cont" %in% spec$sources) pick(meds),
                      if ("int"  %in% spec$sources) pick(intermittent_meds)), use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
  if (!nrow(d)) return(NULL)
  d <- unique(d, by = intersect(med_cols, names(d)))            #same row in both tables counted once
  d <- d[coh_meds, on = "hospitalization_id", nomatch = 0L][!is.na(med_dose)]
  d[, `:=`(unit = tolower(trimws(med_dose_unit)), a_s = as.numeric(admin_dttm))]   #normalise units FIRST
  if (length(spec$relabel))    d[unit %in% names(spec$relabel), unit := unname(spec$relabel[unit])]
  if (length(spec$drop_units)) d <- d[!unit %in% spec$drop_units]
  for (uu in names(spec$max_raw)) d[unit == uu & med_dose > spec$max_raw[[uu]], med_dose := NA_real_]

  #Infusions -> amount per minute, then step-function timeline
  inf_res <- NULL
  inf_tab <- data.table(unit = names(spec$inf), mult = vapply(spec$inf, `[`, 0, 1), wpow = vapply(spec$inf, `[`, 0, 2))
  inf <- d[inf_tab, on = "unit", nomatch = 0L]
  if (nrow(inf)) {
    inf[, rate := med_dose * mult * weight_kg^wpow]
    if (!is.null(spec$inf_max))
      inf[rate * spec$inf_max[["mult"]] / weight_kg^spec$inf_max[["wpow"]] > spec$inf_max[["value"]], rate := NA_real_]
    setorder(inf, hospitalization_id, a_s)
    carry <- inf[a_s >= b_s - grace_hours * 3600 & a_s < b_s, .SD[.N], by = hospitalization_id][, a_s := b_s]
    tl <- rbindlist(list(carry, inf[a_s >= b_s & a_s <= wend_s]), use.names = TRUE)
    if (nrow(tl)) {
      setorder(tl, hospitalization_id, a_s)                       #stable: a rate charted exactly at begin_obs
      tl <- tl[, .SD[.N], by = .(hospitalization_id, a_s)]          #beats the carried-in rate
      tl[, dur_min := pmax((pmin(fcoalesce(shift(a_s, type = "lead"), wend_s), wend_s) - a_s) / 60, 0),
         by = hospitalization_id]
      tl[, counts := dur_min > 0 & !is.na(rate) & (count_zero_rate_minutes | rate > 0)]
      inf_res <- tl[dur_min > 0 & !is.na(rate),
                    .(inf_amt     = sum(rate * dur_min),
                      inf_min     = sum(dur_min[counts]),
                      inf_start_s = if (any(counts)) min(a_s[counts]) else NA_real_),
                    by = hospitalization_id]
      inf_res[inf_min < min_infusion_mins, inf_amt := 0]
    }
  }

  #Boluses
  bol_res <- NULL
  if (length(spec$bolus)) {
    bol <- unique(d[unit %in% names(spec$bolus)], by = c("hospitalization_id", "admin_dttm", "med_dose", "unit"))
    if (nrow(bol)) {
      bol[, amt := med_dose * unname(spec$bolus[unit])]
      if (!is.null(spec$enteral_div))
        bol[tolower(trimws(med_route_category)) %in% "enteral", amt := amt / spec$enteral_div]
      if (!is.null(spec$bolus_max)) bol[amt > spec$bolus_max, amt := NA_real_]
      bol_res <- bol[a_s >= b_s & a_s <= wend_s & !is.na(amt), .(bolus_amt = sum(amt)), by = hospitalization_id]
    }
  }

  parts <- Filter(function(x) !is.null(x) && nrow(x) > 0, list(inf_res, bol_res))
  if (!length(parts)) return(NULL)
  r <- Reduce(function(x, y) merge(x, y, by = "hospitalization_id", all = TRUE), parts)
  for (cc in c("inf_amt", "inf_min", "bolus_amt")) {
    if (!cc %in% names(r)) r[, (cc) := 0]
    set(r, which(is.na(r[[cc]])), cc, 0)
  }
  if (!"inf_start_s" %in% names(r)) r[, inf_start_s := NA_real_]
  r[coh_meds, on = "hospitalization_id", `:=`(weight_kg = i.weight_kg, hours_capped = i.hours_capped)]
  r[]
}

#3) Loop over drugs -> one output table per drug, with the old column names
med_tables <- list()
med_status <- list()
for (nm in names(med_specs)) {
  spec <- med_specs[[nm]]
  r <- tryCatch(med_window(spec), error = function(e) {
    warning(sprintf("%s skipped: %s", nm, conditionMessage(e))); structure(list(), class = "med_error") })
  if (inherits(r, "med_error")) { med_status[[nm]] <- data.table(drug = nm, status = "ERROR", n_hosp = NA_integer_, n_receipt = NA_integer_); next }
  if (is.null(r)) { med_status[[nm]] <- data.table(drug = nm, status = "no rows", n_hosp = 0L, n_receipt = 0L); next }

  if (identical(spec$type, "nmba")) {
    ok <- r$inf_min >= min_infusion_mins
    out <- r[, .(hospitalization_id,
                 paralytics_total_cont_48 = inf_amt,
                 continuous_nmba_start_48 = .POSIXct(fifelse(ok, inf_start_s, NA_real_), tz = time_zone),
                 continuous_nmba_hours_48 = fifelse(ok, inf_min / 60, 0))]
  } else {
    r[, total := inf_amt + bolus_amt]
    r[, avg := total * spec$avg[1] / (hours_capped * weight_kg^spec$avg[2])]
    r[hours_capped <= 0 | (spec$avg[2] > 0 & weight_kg <= 0), avg := NA_real_]
    out <- r[, .(hospitalization_id, total, avg, receipt = as.integer(inf_amt > 0))]
    if (!is.null(spec$mme)) out[, mme := total * spec$mme]
    setnames(out, c("total", "avg", "receipt"), c(spec$total, spec$avg_name, spec$receipt))
    if (!is.null(spec$mme)) setnames(out, "mme", spec$mme_name)
  }
  med_tables[[nm]] <- out
  med_status[[nm]] <- data.table(drug = nm, status = "ok", n_hosp = nrow(r), n_receipt = sum(r$inf_amt > 0))
}
med_status <- rbindlist(med_status)
print(med_status)

#4) Paralytic pushes (intermittent, from 4 h after IMV start to the window end) -> binary
push_tbl <- intermittent_meds[hospitalization_id %in% coh_meds$hospitalization_id &
                                tolower(trimws(med_group)) %in% med_specs$paralytics$group &
                                !is.na(med_dose) & med_dose > 0, .(hospitalization_id, a_s = as.numeric(admin_dttm))]
push_tbl <- push_tbl[coh_meds, on = "hospitalization_id", nomatch = 0L][
  a_s >= b_s + push_nmba_delay_h * 3600 & a_s <= wend_s, .(push_paralytics = 1L), by = hospitalization_id]

#5) One row per cohort hospitalization; every expected column exists even if a drug had no rows
summary_meds_data <- Reduce(function(x, y) merge(x, y, by = "hospitalization_id", all.x = TRUE),
                            c(list(coh_meds[, .(hospitalization_id)]), unname(med_tables), list(push_tbl)))
expected_cols <- unlist(lapply(med_specs, function(s) c(s$total, s$avg_name, s$receipt, s$mme_name)))
expected_cols <- c(expected_cols, "paralytics_total_cont_48", "continuous_nmba_start_48", "continuous_nmba_hours_48", "push_paralytics")
for (cc in setdiff(expected_cols, names(summary_meds_data)))
  summary_meds_data[, (cc) := if (cc == "continuous_nmba_start_48") .POSIXct(NA_real_, tz = time_zone) else NA_real_]

#6) Derived variables (unchanged from the old code)
cont_cols <- grep("^cont_", names(summary_meds_data), value = TRUE)
summary_meds_data[, (cont_cols) := lapply(.SD, function(x) as.integer(!is.na(x) & x > 0)), .SDcols = cont_cols]
summary_meds_data[, paralytics_total_cont_48 := fcoalesce(as.numeric(paralytics_total_cont_48), 0)]
summary_meds_data[, continuous_nmba_hours_48 := fcoalesce(as.numeric(continuous_nmba_hours_48), 0)]
summary_meds_data[, continuous_nmba_48 := as.integer(paralytics_total_cont_48 > 0)]
summary_meds_data[, cont_opioids_receipt := as.integer(cont_fent_receipt == 1 | cont_hydro_receipt == 1 |
  cont_morphine_receipt == 1 | cont_remi_receipt == 1 | cont_sufentanil_receipt == 1)]
summary_meds_data[, cont_benzos_receipt := as.integer(cont_midaz_receipt == 1 | cont_loraz_receipt == 1 | cont_diaz_receipt == 1)]
summary_meds_data[, cont_sedation_receipt := as.integer(cont_prop_receipt == 1 | cont_precedex_receipt == 1 |
  cont_ketamine_receipt == 1 | cont_pentobarbital_receipt == 1 | cont_benzos_receipt == 1)]
summary_meds_data[, lorazepam_equiv_total_48 := fcoalesce(loraz_total_48, 0) + fcoalesce(midaz_total_48, 0) / 2 +
                                                fcoalesce(diaz_total_48, 0) / 10]
summary_meds_data[, total_mme := fcoalesce(fentanyl_total_mme_48, 0) + fcoalesce(hydromorphone_total_mme_48, 0) +
  fcoalesce(morphine_total_mme_48, 0) + fcoalesce(remifentanil_total_mme_48, 0) + fcoalesce(sufentanil_total_mme_48, 0)]
summary_meds_data[, cont_analgesia_only := as.integer(cont_opioids_receipt == 1 & cont_sedation_receipt == 0)]
summary_meds_data[, `:=`(propofol_avg_mcgkgmin_48       = fcoalesce(propofol_avg_mcgkgmin_48, 0),
                         dexmedetomidine_avg_mcgkghr_48 = fcoalesce(dexmedetomidine_avg_mcgkghr_48, 0),
                         push_paralytics                = fcoalesce(as.integer(push_paralytics), 0L))]

summary_meds_data_final <- summary_meds_data[, .(hospitalization_id, propofol_avg_mcgkgmin_48,
  dexmedetomidine_avg_mcgkghr_48, cont_prop_receipt, cont_precedex_receipt, cont_opioids_receipt,
  cont_benzos_receipt, cont_ketamine_receipt, cont_pentobarbital_receipt, total_mme, lorazepam_equiv_total_48,
  continuous_nmba_48, continuous_nmba_start_48, continuous_nmba_hours_48, push_paralytics, cont_analgesia_only)]
stopifnot(nrow(summary_meds_data_final) == nrow(coh_meds))

#7) QC (same outputs as before)
qc_vars <- c("cont_prop_receipt", "cont_precedex_receipt", "cont_opioids_receipt", "cont_benzos_receipt",
             "cont_ketamine_receipt", "cont_pentobarbital_receipt", "continuous_nmba_48", "push_paralytics", "cont_analgesia_only")
qc_output_summary <- data.table(variable = qc_vars,
  n_positive = sapply(qc_vars, function(v) sum(summary_meds_data_final[[v]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE)),
  n_total    = nrow(summary_meds_data_final))
qc_dose_summary <- summary_meds_data_final[, .(
  prop_n_nonzero     = sum(propofol_avg_mcgkgmin_48 > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
  prop_median        = median(propofol_avg_mcgkgmin_48[propofol_avg_mcgkgmin_48 > 0], na.rm = TRUE),
  dex_n_nonzero      = sum(dexmedetomidine_avg_mcgkghr_48 > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
  dex_median         = median(dexmedetomidine_avg_mcgkghr_48[dexmedetomidine_avg_mcgkghr_48 > 0], na.rm = TRUE),
  mme_n_nonzero      = sum(total_mme > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
  mme_median         = median(total_mme[total_mme > 0], na.rm = TRUE),
  loraz_eq_n_nonzero = sum(lorazepam_equiv_total_48 > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
  loraz_eq_median    = median(lorazepam_equiv_total_48[lorazepam_equiv_total_48 > 0], na.rm = TRUE),
  nmba_hours_median  = median(continuous_nmba_hours_48[continuous_nmba_48 == 1], na.rm = TRUE))]
print(qc_output_summary); print(qc_dose_summary)
qc_dir_meds <- if (exists("cohort_characteristics")) cohort_characteristics else audit_dir
fwrite(qc_dose_summary, file.path(qc_dir_meds, paste0(institution, "_part_five_qc_dose_summary.csv")))
fwrite(med_status,      file.path(qc_dir_meds, paste0(institution, "_med_status.csv")))
```
