# PART ELEVEN: Identify acute respiratory failure patients
```{r}
# Identify Patients with Acute Respiratory Failure in the 24 hours prior to IMV
# Find SpO2 and RR values from the 24 hours prior to IMV
# Vitals for just required hospitalization_ids
resp_vital_categories <- c("spo2", "respiratory_rate")
vitals_resp <- vitals_time_dependent[vital_category %in% resp_vital_categories]
resp_values <- vitals_resp[hospitalization_id %in% final_cohort_imv_runs_reduced$hospitalization_id]

# Merge vital values and final_imv_runs
merged_resp_values <- merge(resp_values, final_cohort_imv_runs_reduced, by = "hospitalization_id", all.x = TRUE)
setorder(merged_resp_values, hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm)

# Filter for 24-hour pre IMV window values
merged_resp_values_24h <- merged_resp_values %>%
  # CHANGED (R&R): begin_obs (new name); strictly BEFORE IMV start so the ventilator's own first row is excluded
  filter(recorded_dttm >= (begin_obs - lubridate::hours(24)) &
         recorded_dttm <  begin_obs)
setorder(merged_resp_values_24h, hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm)
merged_resp_values_24h_final <- merged_resp_values_24h[, .(hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm, vital_category, vital_value)]
merged_resp_values_24h_final_dedup <- merged_resp_values_24h_final[
  , .(vital_value = first(vital_value)),
  by = .(hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm, vital_category)
]

# Pivot Long to Wide
resp_wide <- merged_resp_values_24h_final_dedup %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols   = c(hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm),
    names_from  = vital_category,
    values_from = vital_value
  )

# Find respiratory support values from the 24 hours prior to IMV
# Resp_supp just for the required hospitalization_ids
respiratory_support_part_three <- respiratory_support[, .(hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm, device_category, fio2_set, lpm_set)][hospitalization_id %in% final_cohort_imv_runs_reduced$hospitalization_id]
# CHANGED (R&R): lower-case devices, drop IMV rows (e.g. an earlier OR intubation in the 24 h is not evidence of
#   respiratory failure) and drop exact duplicate rows so one charted value can't count twice
respiratory_support_part_three[, device_category := tolower(trimws(device_category))]
respiratory_support_part_three <- unique(respiratory_support_part_three[is.na(device_category) | device_category != "imv"])

# Merge resp_supp and final_cohort_imv_runs_reduced
resp_supp_three_merge <- merge(respiratory_support_part_three, final_cohort_imv_runs_reduced, by = "hospitalization_id", all.x = TRUE)
setorder(resp_supp_three_merge, hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm)

# Filter for the 24 hours prior to starting IMV
resp_supp_three_merge_24h <- resp_supp_three_merge %>%
  # CHANGED (R&R): begin_obs (new name); strictly BEFORE IMV start so the ventilator's own first row is excluded
  filter(recorded_dttm >= (begin_obs - lubridate::hours(24)) &
         recorded_dttm <  begin_obs)
setorder(resp_supp_three_merge_24h, hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm)
resp_supp_three_merge_24h_final <- resp_supp_three_merge_24h[, .(hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm, device_category, fio2_set, lpm_set)]

# Find Labs from the 24 hours prior to IMV
# Labs for just the required hosp_ids
resp_labs_categories <- c("pco2_venous", "pco2_arterial", "ph_venous", "ph_arterial")
labs_resp <- labs_time_dependent[lab_category %in% resp_labs_categories]
labs_resp_filt <- labs_resp[hospitalization_id %in% final_cohort_imv_runs_reduced$hospitalization_id]
# CHANGED (R&R): place labs by COLLECTION time (recorded_dttm; Part Seven renamed lab_collect_dttm to this),
#   falling back to result time only when collection time is missing
labs_resp_filt[, lab_time := fcoalesce(recorded_dttm, lab_result_dttm)]

# Merge with Final_cohort_imv_runs
merged_labs_resp <- merge(labs_resp_filt, final_cohort_imv_runs_reduced, by = "hospitalization_id", all = TRUE)
setorder(merged_labs_resp, hospitalization_id, lab_time)

# Filter for the 24 hours prior to starting IMV
merged_labs_values_24h <- merged_labs_resp %>%
  filter(lab_time >= (begin_obs - lubridate::hours(24)) &   # CHANGED (R&R): begin_obs, collection time, strictly before
         lab_time <  begin_obs)
setorder(merged_labs_values_24h, hospitalization_id, lab_time)
merged_labs_values_24h_final <- merged_labs_values_24h[, .(hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm = lab_time, lab_category, lab_value_numeric)]
merged_labs_values_24h_final_dedup <- merged_labs_values_24h_final[
  , .(lab_value_numeric = first(lab_value_numeric)),
  by = .(hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm, lab_category)
]

# Pivot Long to Wide
labs_wide <- merged_labs_values_24h_final_dedup %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols   = c(hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm),
    names_from  = lab_category,
    values_from = lab_value_numeric
  )

# CHANGED (R&R): a lab/vital with no rows in anyone's window creates no column after the pivot - add it as NA
#   (ensure_cols() is defined in Part Seven)
labs_wide <- ensure_cols(labs_wide, resp_labs_categories)
resp_wide <- ensure_cols(resp_wide, resp_vital_categories)

# Clean Up and Merge the Three Time Filtered Tables
merged_all <- resp_supp_three_merge_24h_final %>%
  dplyr::full_join(labs_wide,
                   by = c("hospitalization_id", "recorded_dttm")) %>%
  dplyr::full_join(resp_wide, #Respiratory vitals
                   by = c("hospitalization_id", "recorded_dttm"))


# Use LOCF to fill out spo2, device_category, and pco2
merged_all_locf <- merged_all %>%
  arrange(hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm) %>%
  group_by(hospitalization_id) %>%
  fill(spo2, pco2_arterial, pco2_venous, device_category, .direction = "down") %>%  # LOCF
  ungroup()

# Criteria #1: Single O2 Saturation value of less than or equal to 85% while on supplemental O2
#   Create flag for rows where spo2 values are =<85%
merged_all_locf <- merged_all_locf %>%
  mutate(spo2_low_flag = if_else(spo2 <= 85, TRUE, FALSE, missing = FALSE))

# Create flag for rows where device_category is something other than "room air"
merged_all_locf <- merged_all_locf %>%
  mutate(device_support_flag = if_else(!is.na(device_category) & device_category != "room air",
                                       TRUE, FALSE))

# Create flag for rows that have BOTH the spo2_flag and the non_ra flag
merged_all_locf <- merged_all_locf %>%
  mutate(criteria_one_flag = if_else(spo2_low_flag & device_support_flag, TRUE, FALSE))

# Criteria #2: Receipt of supplemental O2 >= 6 LPM or >= 40% FiO2 on two distinct measurements
#   Flag for hospitalization_ids with 2 or more lpm_set values >= 6
merged_all_locf <- merged_all_locf %>%
  group_by(hospitalization_id) %>%
  mutate(criteria_two_flow_flag = n_distinct(recorded_dttm[!is.na(lpm_set) & lpm_set >= 6]) >= 2) %>%   # CHANGED (R&R): 2 distinct times
  ungroup()

# Flag for hospitalization_ids with 2 or more fio2_set values >= 40
merged_all_locf <- merged_all_locf %>%
  group_by(hospitalization_id) %>%
  mutate(criteria_two_fio2_flag = n_distinct(recorded_dttm[!is.na(fio2_set) & fio2_set >= 0.40]) >= 2) %>%   # CHANGED (R&R): 2 distinct times
  ungroup()

# Criteria #3: Arterial pCO2 >45 and respiratory_rate >= 22 or venous pCO2 >50 and respiratory rate >= 22
#   Arterial Flag
merged_all_locf <- merged_all_locf %>%
  mutate(criteria_three_arterial_flag = if_else(
    pco2_arterial > 45 & respiratory_rate >= 22,
    TRUE, FALSE, missing = FALSE
  ))

# Venous Flag
merged_all_locf <- merged_all_locf %>%
  mutate(criteria_three_venous_flag = if_else(
    pco2_venous > 50 & respiratory_rate >= 22,
    TRUE, FALSE, missing = FALSE
  ))

# Criteria #4: Arterial pCO2 >60 mmHg and pH =< 7.3 or venous pCO2 >65 mmHg and pH =< 7.3
#   Arterial Flag
merged_all_locf <- merged_all_locf %>%
  mutate(criteria_four_arterial_flag = if_else(
    pco2_arterial > 60 & ph_arterial <= 7.3,
    TRUE, FALSE, missing = FALSE
  ))

# Venous Flag
merged_all_locf <- merged_all_locf %>%
  mutate(criteria_four_venous_flag = if_else(
    pco2_venous > 65 & ph_venous <= 7.3,
    TRUE, FALSE, missing = FALSE
  ))

# Criteria #5: Receipt of any non-invasive ventilation
merged_all_locf <- merged_all_locf %>%
  mutate(criteria_five_flag = if_else(
    device_category %in% c("nippv", "cpap"),
    TRUE, FALSE, missing = FALSE
  ))

# FLAG TO IDENTIFY HOSPITALIZATION_IDS with at least 1 criteria flag
merged_all_locf_final <- merged_all_locf %>%
  group_by(hospitalization_id) %>%
  mutate(
    arf_flag = any(
      criteria_one_flag |
      criteria_two_flow_flag |
      criteria_two_fio2_flag |
      criteria_three_arterial_flag |
      criteria_three_venous_flag |
      criteria_four_arterial_flag |
      criteria_four_venous_flag | 
      criteria_five_flag,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    aHrf_flag = any(
      criteria_one_flag |
      criteria_two_flow_flag |
      criteria_two_fio2_flag,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
setDT(merged_all_locf_final)
arf_data <- merged_all_locf_final[, .(hospitalization_id, arf_flag, aHrf_flag)]
arf_data <- unique(arf_data, by = c("hospitalization_id"))

#Default blank arf_flags to FALSE
arf_hosp_ids <- final_cohort_imv_runs_reduced[, .(hospitalization_id)]   # CHANGED (R&R): was all_hosp_ids (name used in Part Three)

arf_data <- merge(arf_hosp_ids, arf_data, by = "hospitalization_id", all.x = TRUE)
arf_data[is.na(arf_flag), arf_flag := FALSE]
arf_data[is.na(aHrf_flag), aHrf_flag := FALSE]
```


#PART TWELVE: Calculate Percent Deep Sedation, Sensitivity Analyses
```{r}
# CHANGED (R&R): type-safe blank -> NA (fifelse(x == "", NA, x) fails on numeric columns in some data.table versions)
blank_to_na <- function(x) if (is.character(x)) fifelse(trimws(x) == "", NA_character_, x) else x

#RASS
# CHANGED (R&R): pat_assess_rass_filt came from the old RASS section and no longer exists. Rebuilt with the same
#   parser and cleaning as Parts Five / Five-B (valid -5..+4, one value per assessment time) so the hourly
#   outcome uses exactly the RASS records that the cohort criteria and rass_weighted_avg used.
pat_assess_rass_time_dependent <- patient_assessments[
  hospitalization_id %in% final_cohort_imv_runs_reduced$hospitalization_id & !is.na(recorded_dttm) &
    tolower(trimws(assessment_category)) == "rass",
  .(hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm,
    rass_value = as.numeric(parse_rass(numerical_value, trimws(as.character(categorical_value)))))]
pat_assess_rass_time_dependent <- pat_assess_rass_time_dependent[!is.na(rass_value) & rass_value >= -5 & rass_value <= 4,
                                                                 .(rass_value = mean(rass_value)), by = .(hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm)]
pat_assess_rass_time_dependent_wide <- pat_assess_rass_time_dependent
setorder(pat_assess_rass_time_dependent_wide, hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm)


# List of tables to merge
tables_merge_wide <- list(pat_assess_rass_time_dependent_wide)

# Iterative Merge on Hospitalization_id and recorded_dttm to form time_dependent_timeline
time_dependent_timeline_all <- Reduce(function(x, y) merge(x, y, by = c("hospitalization_id", "recorded_dttm"), all = TRUE),
                                      tables_merge_wide)   # CHANGED (R&R): base Reduce, no purrr dependency

# Baseline Values from 24 Hours Prior to Begin IMV
# Begin IMV
final_cohort_timestamps <- final_cohort_imv_runs_reduced[, .(hospitalization_id, admission_dttm, discharge_dttm, begin_obs, end_obs, run_hrs)]   # CHANGED (R&R): end_obs, run_hrs

# CHANGED (R&R): min()/max() without na.rm returned NA whenever any row was NA,
#   so the "worst value in the 24 h before IMV" was usually NA. These ignore NA (all-NA stays NA).
safe_min <- function(x) if (all(is.na(x))) x[NA_integer_][1] else min(x, na.rm = TRUE)
safe_max <- function(x) if (all(is.na(x))) x[NA_integer_][1] else max(x, na.rm = TRUE)

# CHANGED (R&R): build the hour-0 row (begin_obs - 15 min) for EVERY cohort hospitalization. The old code only
#   built it for patients with some RASS row in the 24 h before IMV; anyone without one got no
#   imputed RASS, so their hours before the first charted RASS were NA - counted in the denominator of
#   % deep sedation but never in the numerator (or inherited a stale pre-IMV RASS through LOCF).
time_dependent_timeline_last_primary <- final_cohort_timestamps[, .(hospitalization_id,
                                                                    recorded_dttm = begin_obs - minutes(15), hour_imv = 0, rass_value = NA_real_)]

# Primary analysis: impute RASS = -5 at hour 0 (deep sedation assumed at intubation onset)
# LOCF carries this forward until first documented RASS
# First 4 hours excluded from % deep sedation calculation to minimize imputation impact
# Sensitivity analysis uses RASS = -1 (light sedation) to bound imputation effect
time_dependent_timeline_last_sensitivity <- copy(time_dependent_timeline_last_primary)   # CHANGED (R&R): explicit copy
time_dependent_timeline_last_primary[, rass_value := -5]
time_dependent_timeline_last_sensitivity[, rass_value := -1]

# Form Hourly Table
timeline_meta <- final_cohort_timestamps[, .(
  start = min(begin_obs, na.rm=TRUE),
  dur = max(0, pmin(72, min(run_hrs, na.rm=TRUE)))   # CHANGED (R&R): run_hrs
), by = hospitalization_id]

imv_timeline_72h <- timeline_meta[, .(
  recorded_dttm = seq(
    from = start, 
    to = start + dhours(dur), # dhours() gives a lubridate duration
    by = "1 hour"
  )
), by = .(hospitalization_id)]

# Calculate start_time
imv_timeline_72h[, start_time := min(recorded_dttm, na.rm = TRUE), by = hospitalization_id]

# Calculate end_time as the last recorded_dttm for each hospitalization_id
imv_timeline_72h[, end_time := max(recorded_dttm, na.rm = TRUE), by = hospitalization_id]

imv_timeline_72h[, hour_imv := seq_len(.N) - 1, by = hospitalization_id]

start_end_time <- imv_timeline_72h[, .SD[1], by = hospitalization_id]
start_end_time <- start_end_time[, .(hospitalization_id, start_time, end_time)]

imv_timeline_72h[, c("start_time", "end_time") := NULL]

# Merge to timeline
total_timeline <- merge(imv_timeline_72h, time_dependent_timeline_all, by = c("hospitalization_id", "recorded_dttm"), all = TRUE)

setcolorder(total_timeline, c("hospitalization_id", "hour_imv", "recorded_dttm", "rass_value"))

total_timeline_filt <- merge(total_timeline, start_end_time, by = "hospitalization_id", all = TRUE)

#LOCF
cols_to_update_imv_total <- c("hour_imv", "rass_value")

total_timeline_primary <- merge(total_timeline_filt, time_dependent_timeline_last_primary, by = c("hospitalization_id", "recorded_dttm", "hour_imv", "rass_value"), all = TRUE)

total_timeline_primary[, (cols_to_update_imv_total) := lapply(.SD, blank_to_na), .SDcols = cols_to_update_imv_total]

###############################################################################

# NOTE: total_timeline_primary is modified in place by the LOCF step below.
# total_timeline_filt (used as base for sensitivity) must be merged BEFORE
# this line to avoid inheriting the LOCF'd values.
total_timeline_locf_primary <- total_timeline_primary[, (cols_to_update_imv_total) := lapply(.SD, function(x) na.locf(x, na.rm = FALSE)), 
                                                      by = hospitalization_id, .SDcols = cols_to_update_imv_total]

# Filter the table to retain rows where recorded_dttm is within the time range
total_timeline_locf_primary_filt <- total_timeline_locf_primary[recorded_dttm >= start_time & recorded_dttm <= end_time]

# Compute the min and max for each hospitalization_id and hour_imv
total_timeline_hourly_primary <- total_timeline_locf_primary_filt[,
                                                                  .(rass_value = safe_min(rass_value)), by = .(hospitalization_id, hour_imv)]

###############################################################################
#### SENSITIVITY SECTION ###
total_timeline_hourly_primary <- as.data.frame(total_timeline_hourly_primary)

#Sensitivity Analysis Numbers
cols_to_update_imv_sensitivity <- c("hour_imv", "rass_value")

total_timeline_sensitivity <- merge(total_timeline_filt, time_dependent_timeline_last_sensitivity,
                                    by = c("hospitalization_id", "recorded_dttm", "hour_imv", "rass_value"), all = TRUE)

total_timeline_sensitivity[, (cols_to_update_imv_sensitivity) := lapply(.SD, blank_to_na), .SDcols = cols_to_update_imv_sensitivity]

total_timeline_locf_sensitivity <- total_timeline_sensitivity[, (cols_to_update_imv_sensitivity) := lapply(.SD, function(x) na.locf(x, na.rm = FALSE)), 
                                                              by = hospitalization_id, .SDcols = cols_to_update_imv_sensitivity]

# Filter the table to retain rows where recorded_dttm is within the time range
total_timeline_locf_sensitivity_filt <- total_timeline_locf_sensitivity[recorded_dttm >= start_time & recorded_dttm <= end_time]

# Compute the min and max for each hospitalization_id and hour_imv
total_timeline_hourly_sensitivity <- total_timeline_locf_sensitivity_filt[,
                                                                          .(rass_value = safe_min(rass_value)), by = .(hospitalization_id, hour_imv)]

setDT(total_timeline_hourly_sensitivity)

total_timeline_hourly_sensitivity <- total_timeline_hourly_sensitivity[, .(hospitalization_id, hour_imv, rass_value)]

################################################################################

setDT(total_timeline_hourly_primary)

# Deep Sedation Flag 
total_timeline_hourly_rass_filter <- total_timeline_hourly_primary[, 
                                                                   deep_sedation_hourly := fifelse(is.na(rass_value), NA, fifelse(rass_value <= -3, TRUE, FALSE))
]

# Merge with Time Independent Table
independent_dependent_merge <- merge(total_timeline_hourly_rass_filter, final_cohort_imv_runs_reduced, by = "hospitalization_id", all = TRUE)

#Calculate Percent Deep Sedation for total 72 hours
timeline_72h_no_first_four <- independent_dependent_merge[hour_imv < 72] %>%
  filter(hour_imv >= 4)

deep_sedation_count_total_72 <- timeline_72h_no_first_four[
  deep_sedation_hourly == TRUE, 
  .N, 
  by = hospitalization_id
]
setnames(deep_sedation_count_total_72, "N", "deep_sedation_count_total_72")

row_count_minus_one_72 <- timeline_72h_no_first_four[
  , .(hours_mechanically_ventilated_72 = .N), 
  by = hospitalization_id
]

sedation_and_imv_72 <- merge(row_count_minus_one_72, deep_sedation_count_total_72, by = "hospitalization_id", all = TRUE)

# Replace NA values in deep_sedation_count_total_72 with 0
setnafill(sedation_and_imv_72, cols = "deep_sedation_count_total_72", fill = 0)

sedation_and_imv_72[, percent_deep_sedation_72 := (deep_sedation_count_total_72 / hours_mechanically_ventilated_72) * 100]


#Calculate Percent Deep Sedation for First 48 Hours
independent_dependent_merge_48 <- independent_dependent_merge[hour_imv < 48]

timeline_48h_no_first_four <- independent_dependent_merge_48 %>%
  filter(hour_imv >= 4)

deep_sedation_count_total_48 <- timeline_48h_no_first_four[
  deep_sedation_hourly == TRUE,

]
setnames(deep_sedation_count_total_48, "N", "deep_sedation_count_total_48")

row_count_48 <- timeline_48h_no_first_four[

]

sedation_and_imv_48 <- merge(row_count_48, deep_sedation_count_total_48, by = "hospitalization_id", all = TRUE)

# Replace NA values in deep_sedation_count_total_48 with 0
setnafill(sedation_and_imv_48, cols = "deep_sedation_count_total_48", fill = 0)

sedation_and_imv_48[, percent_deep_sedation_48 := (deep_sedation_count_total_48 / hours_mechanically_ventilated_48) * 100]

###############################################################################
#Negative 1 Imputation Sensitivity Analysis
# Deep Sedation Flag
total_timeline_hourly_rass_sensitivity <- total_timeline_hourly_sensitivity[, 
                                                                            deep_sedation_hourly := fifelse(is.na(rass_value), NA, fifelse(rass_value <= -3, TRUE, FALSE))
]

#Calculate Percent Deep Sedation
total_timeline_hourly_rass_sensitivity_48 <- total_timeline_hourly_rass_sensitivity[hour_imv < 48]

timeline_48h_no_first_four_sensitivity <- total_timeline_hourly_rass_sensitivity_48 %>%
  filter(hour_imv >= 4)

deep_sedation_count_total_48_sensitivity <- timeline_48h_no_first_four_sensitivity[
  deep_sedation_hourly == TRUE, 
  .N, 
  by = hospitalization_id
]
setnames(deep_sedation_count_total_48_sensitivity, "N", "deep_sedation_count_total_48_sensitivity")

row_count_minus_one_48_sensitivity <- timeline_48h_no_first_four_sensitivity[
  , .(hours_mechanically_ventilated_48_sensitivity = .N), 
  by = hospitalization_id
]

sedation_and_imv_48_sensitivity <- merge(row_count_minus_one_48_sensitivity, deep_sedation_count_total_48_sensitivity, by = "hospitalization_id", all = TRUE)

# Replace NA values in deep_sedation_count_total_48 with 0
setnafill(sedation_and_imv_48_sensitivity, cols = "deep_sedation_count_total_48_sensitivity", fill = 0)

sedation_and_imv_48_sensitivity[, percent_deep_sedation_48_sensitivity := (deep_sedation_count_total_48_sensitivity / hours_mechanically_ventilated_48_sensitivity) * 100]

sedation_and_imv_48_sensitivity[, .(hospitalization_id, percent_deep_sedation_48_sensitivity)]


################################################################################
# ADDED (R&R): RASS imputation burden per patient
#   imputed hour         = the hour's RASS comes from the hour-0 imputation (-5 primary / -1 sensitivity), i.e. no
#                          RASS had been charted yet at the start of that hour (grid time < first charted RASS)
#   carried-forward hour = after the first charted RASS, an hour with no RASS charted inside it (LOCF of real data)
#   Windows match the % deep sedation outcome: grid hours 4-47 (hour_imv < 48) and 4-71 (hour_imv < 72).
rass_first_hour   <- 4
rass_last_hour_48 <- 47   # hours starting at 4..47 = the 44 hours from 4 to 48 (matches hour_imv < 48)
rass_last_hour_72 <- 71   # matches hour_imv < 72

rass_charted <- merge(pat_assess_rass_time_dependent, final_cohort_timestamps[, .(hospitalization_id, begin_obs)],
                      by = "hospitalization_id")[recorded_dttm >= begin_obs - minutes(15)]   #charted RASS that can replace the imputed value
first_charted <- rass_charted[, .(first_charted_rass = min(recorded_dttm)), by = hospitalization_id]
rass_charted[, hour_imv := floor(as.numeric(difftime(recorded_dttm, begin_obs, units = "hours")))]
charted_hours <- unique(rass_charted[hour_imv >= 0, .(hospitalization_id, hour_imv)])[, has_charted := TRUE]

rass_grid <- imv_timeline_72h[, .(hospitalization_id, hour_imv, grid_time = recorded_dttm)]
rass_grid[first_charted, on = "hospitalization_id", first_charted_rass := i.first_charted_rass]
rass_grid[charted_hours, on = .(hospitalization_id, hour_imv), has_charted_rass := i.has_charted]
rass_grid[is.na(has_charted_rass), has_charted_rass := FALSE]
rass_grid[, rass_source := fcase(is.na(first_charted_rass) | grid_time < first_charted_rass, "imputed",
                                 has_charted_rass,                                         "charted",
                                 default =                                                 "carried_forward")]
rass_grid[, `:=`(in_48 = hour_imv >= rass_first_hour & hour_imv <= rass_last_hour_48,
                 in_72 = hour_imv >= rass_first_hour & hour_imv <= rass_last_hour_72)]

rass_imputation_hours <- rass_grid[, .(
  rass_imputed_hours_total = sum(rass_source == "imputed"),                 #all grid hours, including hours 0-3
  rass_imputed_hours_48    = sum(rass_source == "imputed" & in_48),
  rass_imputed_hours_72    = sum(rass_source == "imputed" & in_72),
  rass_carried_hours_48    = sum(rass_source == "carried_forward" & in_48),
  rass_carried_hours_72    = sum(rass_source == "carried_forward" & in_72),
  rass_analyzed_hours_48   = sum(in_48),
  rass_analyzed_hours_72   = sum(in_72)), by = hospitalization_id]
rass_imputation_hours[, `:=`(
  pct_rass_hours_imputed_48 = fifelse(rass_analyzed_hours_48 > 0, 100 * rass_imputed_hours_48 / rass_analyzed_hours_48, NA_real_),
  pct_rass_hours_imputed_72 = fifelse(rass_analyzed_hours_72 > 0, 100 * rass_imputed_hours_72 / rass_analyzed_hours_72, NA_real_))]

#Check: the analysed hours must be the same hours as the % deep sedation denominators
chk <- merge(rass_imputation_hours[, .(hospitalization_id, rass_analyzed_hours_48, rass_analyzed_hours_72)],
             merge(sedation_and_imv_48[, .(hospitalization_id, hours_mechanically_ventilated_48)],
                   sedation_and_imv_72[, .(hospitalization_id, hours_mechanically_ventilated_72)], by = "hospitalization_id"),
             by = "hospitalization_id")
if (chk[rass_analyzed_hours_48 != hours_mechanically_ventilated_48 | rass_analyzed_hours_72 != hours_mechanically_ventilated_72, .N] > 0)
  warning("RASS imputation hours do not line up with the % deep sedation denominators - check the hour windows")

#Time to first rass
# CHANGED (R&R): time_to_first_rass_final came from the old RASS section; the value is now built in Part Five
#Time to first rass
# CHANGED (R&R): built in Part Five; on cached runs cohort_final_outcomes is not in memory, so read the one
#   column from the cohort cache (it always exists when the LAPS2 cache is used)
tfr_src <- if (exists("cohort_final_outcomes")) cohort_final_outcomes else
  as.data.table(arrow::read_parquet(cohort_cache, col_select = c("hospitalization_id", "time_to_first_rass")))
time_to_first_rass_analysis <- tfr_src[hospitalization_id %in% final_cohort_imv_runs_reduced$hospitalization_id,
                                       .(hospitalization_id, time_to_first_rass)]

# Complete Time_independent_table for primary analysis
# List of tables to merge
primary_analysis_tables <- list(final_cohort_imv_runs_reduced,
                                sedation_and_imv_72,
                                sedation_and_imv_48,
                                sedation_and_imv_48_sensitivity,
                                time_to_first_rass_analysis,
                                summary_meds_data_final,
                                rass_imputation_hours,        # ADDED (R&R)
                                arf_data)

# Iterative Merge on Hospitalization_id to form primary analysis analytic
primary_analysis_raw <- Reduce(function(x, y) merge(x, y, by = "hospitalization_id", all = TRUE), primary_analysis_tables)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(primary_analysis_raw$hospitalization_id),
          nrow(primary_analysis_raw) == nrow(final_cohort_imv_runs_reduced))   # CHANGED (R&R): nobody added or duplicated
# Replace NA values in rass_below_minus_3_count with 0
setnafill(primary_analysis_raw, cols = "rass_below_minus_3_count", fill = 0)

hid_src <- if (exists("cohort_final_outcomes")) cohort_final_outcomes[, .(hospitalization_id, icu_hospital_id)] else
  as.data.table(arrow::read_parquet(cohort_cache, col_select = c("hospitalization_id", "icu_hospital_id")))
primary_analysis_raw[hid_src, on = "hospitalization_id", hospital_id := fcoalesce(hospital_id, i.icu_hospital_id)]

################################################################################
# SARS-CoV-2 FLAGS (R2.1) - Part Twelve, insert BEFORE analytic_cols is applied
# Adapted from the epoch-table viral code: SARS-CoV-2 only, no epochs.
#   covid_at_imv       : positive test collected from lookback_days before begin_obs through 48 h after begin_obs
#   covid_during_hosp  : positive test collected at any point between admission_dttm and discharge_dttm,
#                        OR an ICD-10 U07.1 diagnosis on this hospitalization
#   covid_any          : covid_at_imv OR covid_during_hosp (used by 01_analysis_rr.Rmd)
# Tests are matched by patient_id, so a test filed under another encounter (e.g. a separate ED or
# transfer encounter) still counts if its collection time falls in the window.
################################################################################

#)0 Column names in the viral table
viral_col <- c(hospitalization_id = "hospitalization_id",
               patient_id         = NA,                     # set if viral has its own patient_id column
               collect_dttm       = "collect_dttm",
               organism           = "organism_category",
               result             = "result_category")
missing_cols <- setdiff(na.omit(viral_col), names(viral))
if (length(missing_cols)) stop("Not in viral: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))

# Parameters
sars_category      <- "sars_cov2"   # organism_category value for SARS-CoV-2
positive_value     <- "detected"    # result_category value for a positive test
lookback_days      <- 14            # covid_at_imv: earliest collection, days before begin_obs
post_imv_hours     <- 48            # covid_at_imv: latest collection, hours after begin_obs
pre_admit_hours    <- 0             # covid_during_hosp: set > 0 to also count tests collected just before admission_dttm

#)1 Standardize the viral table and keep positive SARS-CoV-2 tests
v <- data.table(
  hospitalization_id = as.character(viral[[viral_col[["hospitalization_id"]]]]),
  collect_s = as.numeric(viral[[viral_col[["collect_dttm"]]]]),
  organism  = tolower(trimws(as.character(viral[[viral_col[["organism"]]]]))),
  result    = tolower(trimws(as.character(viral[[viral_col[["result"]]]]))))
n_viral_rows <- nrow(v)
if (!is.na(viral_col[["patient_id"]])) {
  v[, patient_id := as.character(viral[[viral_col[["patient_id"]]]])]
} else {
  v <- merge(v, hospitalization[, .(hospitalization_id = as.character(hospitalization_id),
                                    patient_id = as.character(patient_id))], by = "hospitalization_id")   # all encounters
}
n_unmapped <- n_viral_rows - nrow(v)

# CHECK at each site: which result values exist for SARS-CoV-2 and which count as positive
sars_result_map <- v[organism == sars_category, .N, by = .(result, positive = result == positive_value)][order(-N)]
print(sars_result_map)
if (!nrow(sars_result_map)) warning("No rows with organism_category == '", sars_category, "': check viral_organism_map")

pos <- unique(v[organism == sars_category & result == positive_value & !is.na(collect_s), .(patient_id, collect_s)])

#)2 Cohort windows (one row per index episode)
cw <- unique(primary_analysis_raw[, .(hospitalization_id = as.character(hospitalization_id),
                                      begin_s = as.numeric(begin_obs),
                                      admit_s = as.numeric(admission_dttm),
                                      disch_s = as.numeric(discharge_dttm))])
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(cw$hospitalization_id))
cw <- merge(cw, hospitalization[, .(hospitalization_id = as.character(hospitalization_id),
                                    patient_id = as.character(patient_id))], by = "hospitalization_id", all.x = TRUE)
cw[, `:=`(imv_lo = begin_s - lookback_days * 86400,
          imv_hi = begin_s + post_imv_hours * 3600,
          hosp_lo = admit_s - pre_admit_hours * 3600,
          hosp_hi = disch_s)]

#)3 Flags (non-equi joins on patient_id; TRUE if at least one positive in the window)
at_imv <- pos[cw, on = .(patient_id, collect_s >= imv_lo, collect_s <= imv_hi), nomatch = 0L,
              .(hospitalization_id = i.hospitalization_id)]
in_hosp <- pos[cw, on = .(patient_id, collect_s >= hosp_lo, collect_s <= hosp_hi), nomatch = 0L,
               .(hospitalization_id = i.hospitalization_id)]

#)4 Combine tests with ICD-10 U07.1
covid_dx_ids <- unique(as.character(hospital_diagnosis[
  grepl("ICD10", toupper(diagnosis_code_format)) &
    toupper(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "", diagnosis_code)) == "U071", hospitalization_id]))   # U07.1 (in use from 1 Apr 2020)

primary_analysis_raw[, hid_chr := as.character(hospitalization_id)]
primary_analysis_raw[, `:=`(
  covid_test_at_imv  = hid_chr %in% at_imv$hospitalization_id,    # kept for the audit only
  covid_test_in_hosp = hid_chr %in% in_hosp$hospitalization_id,
  covid_dx_u071      = hid_chr %in% covid_dx_ids)]
primary_analysis_raw[, covid_at_imv      := covid_test_at_imv]
primary_analysis_raw[, covid_during_hosp := covid_test_in_hosp | covid_dx_u071]
primary_analysis_raw[, covid_any         := covid_at_imv | covid_during_hosp]

#)5 Audit
audit_covid <- primary_analysis_raw[, .(
  n                        = .N,
  n_covid_at_imv           = sum(covid_at_imv),
  n_covid_during_hosp      = sum(covid_during_hosp),
  n_covid_any              = sum(covid_any),
  n_during_hosp_test       = sum(covid_test_in_hosp),
  n_during_hosp_u071       = sum(covid_dx_u071),
  n_during_hosp_u071_only  = sum(covid_dx_u071 & !covid_test_in_hosp),   # U07.1 with no positive test found
  n_at_imv_only            = sum(covid_at_imv & !covid_during_hosp)),    # positive in the lookback, before admission
  by = .(language = tolower(trimws(language_category)))]
cnt <- setdiff(names(audit_covid), c("language", "n"))
for (cc in cnt) set(audit_covid, i = which(audit_covid[[cc]] > 0 & audit_covid[[cc]] < 10), j = cc, value = NA)   # small-cell rule
print(audit_covid)
c(viral_rows = n_viral_rows, rows_without_patient_id = n_unmapped, positive_sars_tests = nrow(pos))
fwrite(sars_result_map, file.path(audit_dir, paste0("sars_cov2_result_map_", stamp, institution, ".csv")))
fwrite(audit_covid,     file.path(audit_dir, paste0("covid_flags_audit_",   stamp, institution, ".csv")))
primary_analysis_raw[, c("hid_chr", "covid_test_at_imv", "covid_test_in_hosp", "covid_dx_u071") := NULL]
rm(v, pos, cw, at_imv, in_hosp)


################################################################################
# CARDIAC SURGERY FROM hospital_diagnosis (R4.5) - Part Twelve, before analytic_cols
# (ICD-10-PCS / CPT) and is not coded here. Diagnosis codes can only flag cardiac surgery INDIRECTLY, through
# complication codes that name cardiac surgery / bypass. Step 1 shows what exists at your site; decide from it.
################################################################################

cohort_ids <- unique(as.character(primary_analysis_raw$hospitalization_id))
hd <- as.data.table(hospital_diagnosis)[as.character(hospitalization_id) %in% cohort_ids]
hd[, code := toupper(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "", diagnosis_code))]
hd[, poa := suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(poa_present)))]

#)1 SEARCH - what is in the table?
# a) Code formats: some sites file procedure codes (ICD-10-PCS) here too. If "pcs" shows up, the open-heart
#    PCS rule (see C4 in pipeline_additions_rr.R) can be applied to those rows instead.
print(hd[, .N, by = diagnosis_code_format][order(-N)])

# b) Candidate ICD-10-CM codes
cardiac_dx_codes <- data.table(
  code = c(# complications that NAME cardiac surgery / bypass -> surgery during (or shortly before) this stay
    "I970",                                   # postcardiotomy syndrome
    "I97110", "I97120", "I97130", "I97190",   # postprocedural cardiac insufficiency / arrest / heart failure / other, following cardiac surgery
    "I97710", "I97790",                       # intraoperative cardiac arrest / other functional disturbance during cardiac surgery
    "I97411", "I97611",                       # intraoperative / postprocedural hemorrhage complicating cardiac bypass
    # status codes = surgery at SOME time (usually a past one: a status code is not assigned in the stay
    # where the operation happens) - shown for information, NOT used for the flag by default
    "Z951", "Z952", "Z953", "Z954", "Z95811", "Z95812", "Z941"),
  meaning = c("postcardiotomy syndrome", "postproc cardiac insufficiency after cardiac surgery",
              "postproc cardiac arrest after cardiac surgery", "postproc heart failure after cardiac surgery",
              "other postproc cardiac disturbance after cardiac surgery", "intraop cardiac arrest during cardiac surgery",
              "other intraop cardiac disturbance during cardiac surgery", "intraop hemorrhage complicating cardiac bypass",
              "postproc hemorrhage after cardiac bypass", "status: CABG", "status: prosthetic heart valve",
              "status: xenogenic heart valve", "status: other heart valve replacement", "status: heart assist device",
              "status: artificial heart", "status: heart transplant"),
  use_for_flag = c(rep(TRUE, 9), rep(FALSE, 7)))

dx_search <- hd[code %in% cardiac_dx_codes$code, .(
  n_encounters        = uniqueN(hospitalization_id),
  n_encounters_poa    = uniqueN(hospitalization_id[poa %in% 1]),
  n_encounters_notpoa = uniqueN(hospitalization_id[poa %in% 0])), by = code]
dx_search <- merge(cardiac_dx_codes, dx_search, by = "code", all.x = TRUE)
for (cc in c("n_encounters", "n_encounters_poa", "n_encounters_notpoa")) set(dx_search, which(is.na(dx_search[[cc]])), cc, 0L)
print(dx_search[order(-use_for_flag, -n_encounters)])
fwrite(dx_search, file.path(audit_dir, paste0("cardiac_surgery_dx_search_", stamp, institution, ".csv")))   # local audit

# c) How do these patients line up with the ICU they were ventilated in? (CT ICUs are already excluded in 9i,
#    so the flag only adds patients from OTHER ICUs)
flag_ids <- unique(hd[code %in% cardiac_dx_codes[use_for_flag == TRUE, code], hospitalization_id])
print(primary_analysis_raw[, .(n = .N, n_flagged = sum(as.character(hospitalization_id) %in% flag_ids)),
                           by = icu_imv][order(-n_flagged)])

#)2 FLAG (complication codes only; edit use_for_flag above if Step 1 suggests otherwise)
primary_analysis_raw[, cardiac_surgery_flag := as.character(hospitalization_id) %in% flag_ids]
message(length(flag_ids), " encounters flagged as cardiac surgery from diagnosis codes")
rm(hd)


# CHANGED (R&R): new-pipeline names (old name in the comment); time_from_begin_imv_to_icu_hours is renamed to the
#   time_from_begin_obs_to_icu_hours you used
analytic_cols <- c("hospitalization_id",
                   "begin_obs", "end_obs", "run_hrs",                                   # begin_obs, end_imv, imv_duration_hours_final
                   "admission_dttm", "discharge_dttm", "death_dttm", "hospital_id", "icu_imv", "hospital_icu_id",
                   "location_of_intubation_adj", "intubation_site", "first_location_category",   # location_of_intubation
                   "age_at_admission", "age_category", "admission_type_category", "discharge_category", "sex_category",
                   "race_category", "ethnicity_category", "ethnicity_category_final", "SVM_SCORE", "language_name", "language_category",
                   "elixhauser_score", "weight_kg", "height_cm", "bmi", "trached", "reintubation",   # admission_height, reintubation_final
                   "mortality_28day", "death_during_admission", "hospital_free_days_6mo", "hospital_free_days_28",
                   "hospital_free_days_28_alt", "icu_free_days_28", "icu_free_days_28_alt", "vent_free_days_28",
                   "vent_free_days_28_alt", "vent_free_days_28_hours", "laps2", "deep_sedation_weighted", "sedation_index_score",
                   "sedation_index_tertiles", "rass_weighted_avg", "median_rass_binary", "median_rass_cont", "rass_frequency_hrs",
                   "time_from_begin_imv_to_icu_hours", "time_to_first_rass", "hours_mechanically_ventilated_72",
                   "percent_deep_sedation_48", "percent_deep_sedation_72", "percent_deep_sedation_48_sensitivity",
                   "deep_sedation_count_total_48", "propofol_avg_mcgkgmin_48", "dexmedetomidine_avg_mcgkghr_48",
                   "cont_opioids_receipt", "cont_benzos_receipt", "cont_prop_receipt", "cont_precedex_receipt",
                   "cont_ketamine_receipt", "cont_pentobarbital_receipt", "total_mme", "lorazepam_equiv_total_48",
                   "continuous_nmba_48", "continuous_nmba_start_48", "continuous_nmba_hours_48", "push_paralytics",
                   "cont_analgesia_only", "arf_flag", "aHrf_flag",
                   "rass_imputed_hours_total", "rass_imputed_hours_48", "rass_imputed_hours_72",   # ADDED (R&R): RASS imputation
                   "rass_carried_hours_48", "rass_carried_hours_72", "rass_analyzed_hours_48", "rass_analyzed_hours_72",
                   "pct_rass_hours_imputed_48", "pct_rass_hours_imputed_72", "rass_count_4_48", "covid_at_imv", "covid_during_hosp", "covid_any",
                   "icu_hospital_id", "rass_count", "sens_only_icu_late", "cardiac_surgery_flag", "procedural_stay_found", 
                   "procedural_stay_hours", "pre_icu_procedural_hours", "procedure_end_to_icu_hours",
                   "post_procedure_location", "post_procedure_icu_type")
absent_cols <- setdiff(analytic_cols, names(primary_analysis_raw))
if (length(absent_cols)) warning("Not built in this pipeline run, left out of the analytic file: ", paste(absent_cols, collapse = ", "))
primary_analysis_analytic <- primary_analysis_raw[, intersect(analytic_cols, names(primary_analysis_raw)), with = FALSE]
setnames(primary_analysis_analytic, "time_from_begin_imv_to_icu_hours", "time_from_begin_obs_to_icu_hours", skip_absent = TRUE)

# If 01_analysis still uses the old names, uncomment to restore them in the saved file:
# setnames(primary_analysis_analytic,
#          c("end_obs", "run_hrs", "location_of_intubation_adj", "height_cm", "reintubation"),
#          c("end_imv", "imv_duration_hours_final", "location_of_intubation", "admission_height", "reintubation_final"),
#          skip_absent = TRUE)

# Add Observation Year
primary_analysis_analytic[, observation_year := year(admission_dttm)]
primary_analysis_analytic[, observation_year := as.double(observation_year)]

################################################################################
# ADDED (R&R): RASS imputation summary - whole cohort, English, Spanish (+ English vs Spanish tests)
imp <- copy(primary_analysis_analytic)[sens_only_icu_late == FALSE][, lang := tolower(trimws(language_category))]
summ_imp <- function(d, label) d[, .(
  group                         = label,
  n_patients                    = .N,
  n_any_imputed_48              = sum(rass_imputed_hours_48 > 0),
  pct_any_imputed_48            = round(100 * mean(rass_imputed_hours_48 > 0), 1),
  total_imputed_hours_48        = sum(rass_imputed_hours_48),
  total_analyzed_hours_48       = sum(rass_analyzed_hours_48),
  pct_analyzed_hours_imputed_48 = round(100 * sum(rass_imputed_hours_48) / sum(rass_analyzed_hours_48), 2),
  mean_imputed_hours_48         = round(mean(rass_imputed_hours_48), 2),
  median_imputed_hours_48       = as.numeric(median(rass_imputed_hours_48)),
  q1_imputed_hours_48           = as.numeric(quantile(rass_imputed_hours_48, 0.25)),
  q3_imputed_hours_48           = as.numeric(quantile(rass_imputed_hours_48, 0.75)),
  max_imputed_hours_48          = as.numeric(max(rass_imputed_hours_48)),
  total_imputed_hours_72        = sum(rass_imputed_hours_72),
  pct_analyzed_hours_imputed_72 = round(100 * sum(rass_imputed_hours_72) / sum(rass_analyzed_hours_72), 2),
  mean_imputed_hours_72         = round(mean(rass_imputed_hours_72), 2),
  mean_imputed_hours_total      = round(mean(rass_imputed_hours_total), 2),   #includes the excluded hours 0-3
  pct_analyzed_hours_carried_48 = round(100 * sum(rass_carried_hours_48) / sum(rass_analyzed_hours_48), 2))]
rass_imputation_summary <- rbindlist(list(
  summ_imp(imp, "all"),
  summ_imp(imp[lang == "english"], "english"),
  summ_imp(imp[lang == "spanish"], "spanish")))

#English vs Spanish: imputed hours (Wilcoxon) and any imputed hour (Fisher); NA if a group is empty
en <- imp[lang == "english"]; es <- imp[lang == "spanish"]
safe_p <- function(expr) tryCatch(signif(expr, 3), error = function(e) NA_real_)
rass_imputation_summary[, `:=`(
  p_imputed_hours_48_en_vs_es = safe_p(wilcox.test(en$rass_imputed_hours_48, es$rass_imputed_hours_48, exact = FALSE)$p.value),
  p_any_imputed_48_en_vs_es   = safe_p(fisher.test(table(factor(c(rep("en", nrow(en)), rep("es", nrow(es)))),
                                                         c(en$rass_imputed_hours_48 > 0, es$rass_imputed_hours_48 > 0)))$p.value))]
print(rass_imputation_summary)
fwrite(rass_imputation_summary, file.path(audit_dir, paste0("rass_imputation_summary_", stamp, institution, ".csv")))
suppressWarnings(rm(imp, en, es))

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# QUALITY CHECK: Missingness in key variables (primary_analysis_analytic)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
vars_to_check <- c(
  #Key covariates/Table 1 variables
  "sex_category", "ethnicity_category", "language_category", "language_name",
  "race_category", "hospital_id", "icu_imv", "location_of_intubation_adj",   # CHANGED (R&R)
  "admission_type_category", "arf_flag", "aHrf_flag", "hospital_icu_id",
  "age_at_admission", "bmi", "elixhauser_score", "SVM_SCORE", "laps2",
  "time_to_first_rass", "rass_frequency_hrs", "observation_year", 
  "time_from_begin_obs_to_icu_hours",
  # Outcomes
  "run_hrs", "trached", "vent_free_days_28", "vent_free_days_28_alt",   # CHANGED (R&R): was imv_duration_hours_final
  "vent_free_days_28_hours", "deep_sedation_weighted", "sedation_index_score", "sedation_index_tertiles",
  "percent_deep_sedation_48", "percent_deep_sedation_72", "percent_deep_sedation_48_sensitivity",
  "deep_sedation_count_total_48", "cont_opioids_receipt", "cont_benzos_receipt", 
  "total_mme", "lorazepam_equiv_total_48", "continuous_nmba_48", "push_paralytics",
  "cont_analgesia_only", "median_rass_binary", "median_rass_cont", "rass_weighted_avg"
)

missing_from_data <- setdiff(vars_to_check, names(primary_analysis_analytic))
if (length(missing_from_data) > 0) {
  warning(
    "The following key variables are ABSENT from primary_analysis_analytic entirely:\n  ",
    paste(missing_from_data, collapse = ", "), "\n",
    "Missing or NA values seen in key variables - please contact Alex Ortiz on Slack for troubleshooting and evaluation."
  )
}

vars_present <- intersect(vars_to_check, names(primary_analysis_analytic))

missingness_summary <- data.table(
  variable    = vars_present,
  n_missing   = sapply(vars_present, function(v) {
    col <- primary_analysis_analytic[[v]]
    sum(is.na(col) | (is.character(col) & trimws(col) == ""))
  }),
  pct_missing = sapply(vars_present, function(v) {
    col <- primary_analysis_analytic[[v]]
    n_miss <- sum(is.na(col) | (is.character(col) & trimws(col) == ""))
    round(100 * n_miss / nrow(primary_analysis_analytic), 2)
  })
)

message("── Key Variable Missingness Report ──────────────────────────────")
print(missingness_summary[order(-n_missing)])
message("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────")

vars_with_missing <- missingness_summary[n_missing > 0, variable]
if (length(vars_with_missing) > 0) {
  warning(
    "Missing or NA values seen in the following key variables:\n  ",
    paste(
      sapply(vars_with_missing, function(v) {
        row <- missingness_summary[variable == v]
        sprintf("%s (n=%d, %.1f%%)", v, row$n_missing, row$pct_missing)
      }),
      collapse = "\n  "
    ), "\n\n",
    "Please contact Alex Ortiz on Slack for troubleshooting and evaluation."
  )
}

if (length(vars_with_missing) == 0 && length(missing_from_data) == 0) {
  message("✓ Your table is clean - proceed to 01_analysis!")
}

# Clean up temporary QC objects from the environment.
# suppressWarnings() prevents "object not found" errors if a collaborator's
# run errored mid-block and some of these were never created.
suppressWarnings(rm(vars_to_check, missing_from_data, vars_present, 
                    missingness_summary, vars_with_missing))
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# CHANGED (R&R): file.path (paste0 without a separator wrote next to intermediate_dir) - update the path in 01_analysis
arrow::write_parquet(primary_analysis_analytic, file.path(intermediate_dir, paste0("analytic_file", institution, ".parquet")))
```
